text: Que lugar verdadeiramente peculiar. Em outra cidade, você veria este lugar e diria: "Eles estão tentando demais ser diferentes/modernos". Aqui, em Charlotte, posso dizer que é o lugar de verdade. Eles cumprem o que prometem e servem excelentes produtos de panificação e cafés/chás. 24 horas por dia, 7 dias por semana. Não esperava encontrar algo tão autêntico durante uma breve visita, mas este é exatamente o que encontrei. Não perca a oportunidade se você vier para Charlotte.
original: What a truly unusual place. In another town you'd see this place and say "they are trying too hard to be funky/cool." Here in Charlotte I'm here to tell you is the real deal. They walk the talk and just serve up great baked goods and coffees/teas. 24/7. Didn't expect to find something so authentic to itself while on a short trip but this is it. Don't miss it if you come to Charlotte.

text: Volví por segunda vez, ¡tenía que probar mi plato de langosta! Es adictivo. El brownie estaba bien, pero el cannoli normal estaba bueno, no me gustó el cannoli de chocolate. Lo mejor es consultar las fotos en Yelp, así sabrás exactamente lo que quieres cuando llegue tu turno. Es difícil ver cuando estás en la fila, ya que las personas que están delante te impiden ver la vitrina. Es caro, pero bueno, es Cake Boss, ¡jajaja!... y estás en Las Vegas. ¡Disfruta!
original: Second time visiting, had to get my Lobster Tail fix! Those suckers are addicting. The brownie was just okay and the regular cannoli was good, didn't care for the chocolate cannoli. It's best to go on Yelp to check out the pics, that way when it's your turn to order you pretty much know what you want. It's hard to see when you're in line because the people ahead of you are blocking the display case. It is pricey but hey it's the Cake Boss, lol.......and you are in Vegas. Enjoy!

text: Allana fue excelente. Mi esposa y yo celebramos nuestro 7º aniversario y su actitud hizo que nuestra noche fuera inolvidable. La tranquilidad y encanto de este lugar son realmente memorables. Gracias, Allana. Recomendaríamos este lugar a nuestros amigos.
original: Allana was wonderful. My wife and I had our 7 year anniversary and her attitude made our evening. The quietness and quaintness in this place is so memorable. Thank you Allana. We would recommend this place to our friends.

text: Had the s'mores sundae here which was not all that great considering how hyped this place is. Just because the items that go into this sundae are sweet doesn't mean that they should go together. The Belgian chocolate ice cream is actually good however. Service here is also extremely lacking; manager had an attitude from the get-go. It seems her priority was training her employees, as a simple question I had was the biggest burden to her and she was quick to turn back around and get back to training on how to make cones.

¡Increíble! ¡Este lugar es increíble! Probamos el donut de "French Toast" y ¡no nos decepcionó! El personal es muy amable y atento, y el lugar en sí es precioso. Hay una zona de terraza muy agradable, por lo que nunca te sientes agobiado. Incluso el chef Jeff se acercó personalmente para preguntarnos cómo estábamos. ¡La mejor manera de celebrar los 27! Volveremos.
original: Hot damn! This place is unreallllllll! We had the French Toast donut and it does NOT disappoint! The staff is so patient and welcoming and the place itself is so cute! There's such a cute outdoor seating area so you never feel crowded. Chef Jeff came out PERSONALLY to ask us how we are doing. Best way to celebrate turning 27! Will be back!

text: Na minha primeira visita a este lugar, fiquei impressionado com a qualidade da comida ou do pão. Esperei 15 minutos para pagar, pois só havia um caixa atendendo. A explicação deles é que alguns de seus caixas estão estudando.
original: first time at this place all I could say this food or bread should be good waited 15 minutes to pay for my bread they only have one cashier working the counter. their reasoning is some of their cashiers are in school.

text: AMAZING! AWESOME! A whole new level in donuts... Very friendly, customer oriented staff, easy street parking but I live close and walk... Get in early because the line begins at 7am. Definitely a pilgrimage for donut connoisseurs!

Aqui estão os pontos negativos: A Bouchon Bakery é cara e não oferece assentos. Os pontos positivos são praticamente tudo o mais. Em termos de ambiente, o local é um pequeno quiosque cheio de uma variedade de doces deliciosamente apresentados. Uma equipe enérgica lida com uma boa quantidade de clientes de forma amigável e eficiente. É possível pedir bebidas quentes e também doces. Experimentei um chocolate quente com especiarias, que estava um pouco ralo e não era exatamente irresistível, mas ainda assim gostoso. Os doces eram incríveis. Comprei um croissant, um danés de queijo e um TKO. O croissant era crocante, com camadas infinitas e rico em sabor de manteiga. Foi um dos melhores croissants que já provei. O danés de queijo foi, sem dúvida, o melhor danés de queijo que já provei, uma massa dourada e deliciosa, perfeita em todos os aspectos, complementada por um recheio de queijo delicioso e realçado com limão. O TKO correspondeu às suas raízes humildes de Oreo, elevando o chocolate e o branco a um esplendor celestial, com sua superfície úmida e crocante e um recheio cremoso. Também comprei algumas caixas de macarons, uma como presente e outra para comer o mais rápido possível. A caixa continha seis sabores - framboesa, limão, baunilha, espresso, chocolate e pistache. Fiquei um pouco decepcionado por não ter caramelo salgado, mas é difícil ficar triste com bons macarons. Os macarons da Bouchon não eram os melhores que já provei, mas eram muito bons, com cascas macias e um interior leve que entregava açúcar sem ficar enjoativo. Pelo que entendo, há planos para a abertura de uma Bouchon Bakery em Los Angeles. Quase espero que não more perto, pois acho que não conseguirei manter o peso com esses doces em um raio de cinco milhas.
original: Here are the cons: Bouchon Bakery is expensive and provides zero seating. The pros are just about everything else. In terms of setting, the place is a cute little stand overflowing with all manner of sweet treats palatably displayed. An energetic staff deals with a fair crowd in a friendly, efficient manner. You can order hot drinks as well as pastries. I tried a spiced hot chocolate, which was a bit thin and not quite irresistible, but tasty nonetheless. The pastries were phenomenal. I picked up a croissant, a cheese danish, and a TKO. The croissant was flaky, endlessly layered, and rich with buttery flavor. It was one of the best croissants I've ever tasted. The cheese danish was easily the best cheese danish I've ever tasted, a luscious golden pastry perfect in every way, completed by a delectable cheese filling heightened with lemon. The TKO was true to its humble Oreo roots yet elevated chocolate and white stuff to heavenly splendor with its moist cakey outsides and fluffy cream. I also bought a couple boxes of macarons, one as a gift and one to eat as soon as possible. The box came with six flavors - raspberry, lemon, vanilla, espresso, chocolate, and pistachio. I was a little bit disappointed not to have a salted caramel, but it's hard to be sad in the face of good macarons. Bouchon's were not the best I've had, but they were very good, with great yielding shells and light insides that delivered sugar without getting saccharine. From what I understand, there are plans for a Bouchon Bakery in Los Angeles. I almost hope I don't live near it, as I don't think I'll keep off weight with those pastries within a five mile radius.

text: Novel Ice Cream es increíble. Ofrecían muchas opciones, y el helado era único y sabroso. Se nota que hay mucha dedicación en la elaboración de su helado.
original: Novel Ice Cream is amazing! They had many options, and the ice cream was unique and flavorful. You can tell that there is effort put in to making their ice cream.

text: Helado, galletas, macarons, conos de waffle... ¡todo delicioso! Nuestro nuevo lugar favorito para disfrutar del helado.
original: Delicious ice cream, cookies, macarons, waffle cones...everything. Our new favorite ice cream spot

text: Came here per friends' recommendation since I was on a business trip in Decatur, which is 30 min away from Champaign. I had my doubts at first because who would have thought any food could would be this good in a small college town. Boy was I in for a treat. Strawberry shortcake snowstorm was my choice based on my friend's yelp review and it was AMAZING. The portion for was quite large for a small cup too. DEFINITELY going to come back again in my future trips.

Este tiene que ser el mejor lugar de helados en el que he estado, ¡y viniendo de una mujer embarazada, eso dice mucho! El ambiente era realmente agradable, con la fábrica justo detrás de la tienda, donde se puede ver a través de una pared de vidrio. Pedí un "float" de refresco de raíz y usaron crema batida casera, que fue absolutamente INCREÍBLE. ¡El mejor de todos! Sin duda. ¡Un lugar imprescindible en el centro de Cleveland!
original: This has to be the best ice cream place I've ever been to, and coming from a pregnant woman, that says a lot! It was a really cool environment inside with the factory right behind the store where you can look in through a glass wall. I got a root beer float and they use homemade whipped cream which was absolutely INCREDIBLE. Best ever. Hands down. Staple of downtown Cleveland!

text: Vinimos aquí para disfrutar de algunos postres durante nuestro décimo aniversario de boda en Las Vegas. No nos decepcionaron; pudimos hacer nuestro pedido y salimos del lugar en un abrir y cerrar de ojos.
original: Came here for some dessert treats during our 10-Year Wedding Anniversary in Las Vegas. They didn't disappoint, we were able to make our order and were out the door in no time at all.

text: Sorvete com preço muito alto. Pedi um sorvete de cone com duas bolas, mas não fiquei nada satisfeito. A bola de chocolate tinha um sabor apenas aceitável, e a de baunilha era ainda pior. O cone de bolo era muito pequeno para duas bolas. No entanto, isso não foi um problema, pois não me preocupei em terminar.
original: Overpriced ice cream. Ordered 2 scoop cone ice cream but was not at all impressed. The chocolate scoop tasted barely ok and the vanila scoop was worse. The cake cone was way too small for two scoops. However, that was not a problem as I didn't bother finishing.

text: Chocolate por todas partes, y te ofrecen una muestra gratuita al entrar. Pedí un batido de galletas y crema, y es muy cremoso. Hay muchos lugares para sentarse, por lo que puedes relajarte con comodidad. Hay muchos lugares de postres en el Linq, pero este es un lugar imprescindible para los amantes del chocolate.
original: Chocolate everywhere and they offer you a free sample when you walk in. Ordered cookies and cream shake and it's so creamy. There's lots of seating so you can relax in comfort. There are so many dessert place at the Linq but this one is a must stop for chocolate lovers

text: This is pretty much the best place for hand made ice cream. If you are going there one should definitely try their dough melt. It is the best concept ever. They will put a scoop of your choice of flavor between a hot bun. The combination is OMG! This is a must try if you are in the city.
Jesse and Helen have created such a great culture with their venture going out of their way to make people comfortable while providing some of the best / unique ice cream (vegan options also).

This place has tasty items but they are extremely expensive. I totally believe you get what you paid for but this is extreme. $17 for a slice of cake with taxes. The lease at the Cosmopolitan can't be that high.

Pequeña tienda, llena de dulces y productos únicos, donde ofrecen galletas caseras e helado artesanal. Mis favoritas son las galletas de avena y las de nuez pecan. La de avena tiene trozos grandes de avena y canela. Muy deliciosas. La de nuez pecan también es buena y tiene una buena cantidad de nueces. Siempre añado un topping de caramelo salado, que combina perfectamente con ambos helados. Definitivamente recomiendo este lugar, lo encontramos en la parte trasera y disfrutamos de un poco de sombra mientras saboreábamos nuestros dulces.
original: Small shop, full of unique candies and such, they offer homemade cookies and artesian ice cream. My favorites are either the oatmeal cookie dough and the butter pecan. The oatmeal is cinnamon has big chunks of oatmeal. Very yummy. Butter pecan is also good and had a good amount of pecans. I always add a topping of salted caramel, it goes perfectly with the two ice creams. I definitely recommend this place, we saw let in the back and enjoyed some shade while eating out sweet treats!

text: Ok. Não tenho muito mais a dizer, além de que este é o sorvete mais delicioso que já provei na minha vida. Fiquei impressionado com o sorvete de menta, e até com o de baunilha: como se pode melhorar o sorvete de baunilha? Eles conseguiram! É imperdível quando estiver em Scottsdale.
original: Okay. There's not much I can write other than this is the best ice cream I have ever had in my life. I was blown away by the mint ice cream and even the vanilla: how can you improve on vanilla? They have! A must try while in Scottsdale.

text: Fast and friendly service.....and the most delicious Birthday Cake Shake. Wow! What a treat. I like this place and will happily return next time I am in Vegas.

Wow what a super cute business property of 5-6 colorful "little homes" selling different stuff but sharing a nice shady space to chill. This place has legit ice cream and I'm sure if the owners are ambitious it can be in more places in AZ. Had the cookie monster to share with kiddo and hubby chose some alcoholic one (boubon? It was delicious). The cookie monster ice cream is really blue so beware you'll really look goth after eating it. But so worth it.

Um ótimo sobremesa! Nunca experimentei algo tão gostoso há tanto tempo. Sou exigente quando se trata de sobremesas, e esta definitivamente é uma que eu recomendaria a um amigo. Ótimo trabalho, proprietário!
original: great dessertï¼haven't try something thisgoodï¼ for soooo longï¼i am picky on my dessert, and this is definitely sth I would recommend a friend. Great job owner!

text: Não fiquei muito impressionado. Pedimos uma fatia de torta de nozes, um cheesecake com cobertura de chocolate, um cupcake de biscoito e creme, e uma fatia de bolo de glacê colorido. A torta de nozes foi a única coisa com um bom sabor. O cheesecake com cobertura de chocolate foi medíocre. O cupcake de biscoito e creme era um cupcake de chocolate ligeiramente seco e sem sabor, com um glacê granulado por cima que não lembrava nada de biscoito e creme. O bolo colorido também não tinha sabor e não era nada impressionante. Sinceramente, estou bastante decepcionado com os preços inflacionados que pagamos por produtos de confeitaria medíocres. Não se deixe enganar pelo nome "Carlos" e pela foto do "Buddy" em todos os lugares. Você pode comprar um bolo melhor em uma caixa na loja por $2 e economizar $20. A única razão pela qual esta não é uma avaliação de uma estrela é porque a equipe foi ótima.
original: Not Impressed. We got a wedge of pecan pie, a chocolate dipped cheesecake, a cookie and cream cupcake, and a slice of rainbow buttercream cake. The pecan pie was the only thing with good flavor. The chocolate dipped cheesecake was mediocre. The cookie and cream cupcake was a slightly dry underflavored chocolate cupcake with some gritty speckled frosting on top that tasted nothing like cookies and cream. The rainbow cake was equally flavorless and unimpressive. I'm honestly pretty upset with the inflated prices we paid for underwhelming bakery goods. Don't get lured in by the Carlos name and Buddy's face everywhere. You can get a better cake out of a box at the store for $2 and save yourself $20. The only reason this isn't a one star review is because the staff were great.

text: Después de leer otras reseñas (y la experiencia personal de mi hermana), me preocupaba que la cola fuera muy larga, pero en una noche de viernes alrededor de las 20:45, tardamos solo unos 15 minutos. Pedimos MUCHOS postres: éclair de chocolate ($3.49), tartaleta de crema ($2.09), tartaleta de frutos rojos de 4 pulgadas ($4.89), tartaleta de limón y frambuesa ($4.89), pastelito de ganache de chocolate pequeño (?), brownies de caramelo salado ($2.29), galletas de coco ($1.59), petit-four de pistacho ($2.09), mini vasos de mousse de espresso ($1.59) y todos los sabores de macarons franceses que tenían disponibles ($2.29). Había muchos trabajadores reponiendo, pero solo 1 persona atendiendo pedidos y 1 trabajando en la caja. ¿Es esto para regular el flujo de la cola? Debería ralentizar la cola, ya que la persona que toma los pedidos tiene que decirle al cajero todo lo que hay en el pedido, y si el cajero no escucha todo, entonces es un caos. De todas formas, personalmente no probé todo lo que pedimos, así que solo puedo dar mi opinión, basada en mi gusto por los dulces, sobre algunos de los artículos... pero el pastelito de ganache de chocolate es altamente recomendable. No es demasiado dulce y me encantó el relleno. Se puede compartir entre dos personas. El mini vaso de mousse de espresso no fue tan bueno como parece. Es de tamaño pequeño y no es tan esponjoso como yo quería. Los brownies de caramelo salado, si no son los mejores (como se lee en muchas otras reseñas), son uno de los artículos más populares... pero me pareció que el caramelo era demasiado. Por supuesto, es lo que contiene la sal, y el brownie sería simplemente un brownie de chocolate normal sin él... porque el brownie solo no tenía un sabor de chocolate que recordara. Por último, la tartaleta de crema está rellena de crema pastelera, lo cual es algo que me encanta, pero no vale $2. Quiero decir, es grande, así que si realmente te gustan las tartaletas de crema, adelante. Pídelo solo o compártelo con alguien y pide otro artículo.
original: From reading other reviews (and my sister's personal experience), I was worried the line would be extremely long but we waited only about 15 minutes on a Friday night around 8:45pm. We ordered LOTS of desserts - chocolate eclair ($3.49), cream puff ($2.09), mixed berry 4" tart ($4.89), lemon raspberry fruit tart ($4.89), mini chocolate ganache cake (?), salted caramel brownies ($2.29), coconut macaroons ($1.59), pistachio flavored petit-four ($2.09), espresso mini mousse cups ($1.59), and every flavor of french macarons they had available ($2.29).. They had many workers restocking, but only 1 person taking orders and 1 person working the cash register. Is this to regulate the flow of the line? It must slow down the line because the person taking the order has to tell the cashier everything in the order, and if the cashier doesn't hear everything, then it's just chaos. Any way, I personally didn't try everything we ordered so I can only give my sweet-tooth loving opinion on some of the items..but the chocolate ganache cake is highly recommendable. Not too rich and I loved the filling. It can be split between two people. The espresso mini mousse cup was not as great as it sounds. Bite-size and not as fluffy as I wanted. The salted caramel brownie is, if not the best (read in many other reviews), one of the most popular items.. but I thought the caramel was way too much. It is what contains the salt of course and the brownie would just be a normal chocolate brownie without it.. because the brownie alone did not taste like any chocolate worth remembering. Lastly, the cream puff is filled with custard which is something I love, but it isn't worth $2. I mean, it's huge, so if you really love cream puffs, have at it. Order it alone or split it with someone and order one other item.

text: Prós: Tem o sabor do sorvete. Contras: O creme cai muito rápido, atendimento lento, funcionários incompetentes. Minha sugestão: Vale a pena experimentar, mas no futuro provavelmente optarei pela DQ. Visitamos o Jarling's pela primeira vez na noite passada, após ler todas as ótimas avaliações. Não correspondeu às expectativas. Quando chegamos, a fila já estava para a porta, então tínhamos cerca de 6 ou 7 pessoas atrás da nossa janela. Mesmo com 2 funcionários trabalhando naquela janela, demorou cerca de 25 minutos para chegar à frente. Quando finalmente tivemos a oportunidade, pedimos duas tigelas de sorvete para as crianças, um cono de waffle com sorvete para meu noivo e uma "neve" de chocolate com pasta de amendoim (o equivalente ao "blizzard" da DQ) para mim. O funcionário que pegou nosso pedido claramente não tinha ideia do que estava fazendo. Após vagar sem rumo por vários minutos, ele finalmente passou nosso pedido para outra pessoa. Mesmo assim, demorou muito para que nosso pedido fosse preparado. Enquanto isso, o homem que presumo ser o gerente apenas ficou de pé, observando e gritando periodicamente para os clientes na fila para entrarem ou saírem, mas para fecharem a porta. Quando finalmente o pedido chegou à janela, já estava derretido. Então, a moça não conseguiu operar o caixa, então demorou bastante para eu receber meu troco. Quando finalmente consegui meu pedido, meu troco e caminhar até as mesas de piquenique do lado de fora, já havia creme derretido por toda parte. O sorvete (ou creme) estava bom, mas não excelente, e certamente não valeu o preço. A "neve" estava saborosa e tinha um sabor rico de pasta de amendoim. Por outro lado, acabei bebendo quase tudo. Não fiquei impressionado.
original: Pros: Tastes like ice cream Cons: Custard melts too quickly, slow service, incompetent staff My Advice: It's worth a try, but in the future I'll likely just opt for DQ We visited Jarling's last night for the first time after reading all the raving reviews. It did not live up to all the fuss. When we got there, the line was to the door, so we were about 6 or 7 people back at our window. Even with 2 employees working that window it took a good 25 minutes or so to get to the front. When we finally got a chance, we ordered two single dip cups for the kids, a single dip waffle cone for my fiance and a peanut butter fudge snowstorm (their equivalent to DQ's blizzard) for me. They guy that took our order clearly had no clue what he was doing. After wandering around aimlessly for several minutes, he finally passed our order on to someone else. Even then it took forever for our order to be made. Meanwhile, the man who I presume was the manager just stood around watching and periodically yelling at customers in line to either come inside or go outside, but to close the door. When they finally got the order up to the window it was already melting. Then the girl couldn't figure out how to work the cash register, so it took quite a while to get my change back. By the time I was able to get my order, get my change and walk to the picnic tables outside, there was melted custard dripping all over the place. The ice cream (or custard) was good, but not great and certainly not worth the price. The snowstorm was smooth and had a rich peanut butter flavor to it. On the other hand, I ended up literally drinking it. I wasn't impressed.

text: Eu vim aqui pela primeira vez ontem à noite e estava delicioso! Ao entrar, havia uma pequena fila, mas ela se moveu rapidamente. Eu pedi o "ahboong" de cabeça para baixo com recheio de Nutella e sorvete de creme com biscoitos, finalizado com pedaços de Oreo e pó de biscoito Graham. Meus irmãos pediram o "ahboong" de cabeça para baixo com recheio de feijão vermelho e sorvete de Ube. Todos nós ficamos muito satisfeitos e definitivamente voltaremos!
original: I came here last night for the first time and it was delicious! Upon entry there was a short line but it moved pretty quickly. I ordered the upside down ahboong with Nutella filling and cookies and cream soft serve, topped with Oreo crumbles and graham cracker dust. My siblings ordered the upside down ahboong with red bean filling and Ube soft serve. We were all happily satisfied and will definitely come back!

text: O Mitchell's Homemade Ice Cream foi uma ótima opção para o almoço durante nossa viagem a Cleveland. Eles têm uma variedade enorme de sabores! Eu gostei do sabor Café com Chocolate e meu marido escolheu o sabor Chocolate com Porter. Ambos os sabores estavam muito bons. Se eu voltar a essa região, certamente voltarei!
original: Mitchell's Homemade Ice Cream was a great mid day treat on our trip to Cleveland. They have so many flavors! I enjoyed the Coffee Chocolate Chunk and my husband had the Porter Chocolate Chunk. Both flavors were pretty good. I'd stop back if I'm ever in the area!

text: Este lugar es muy agradable y los dueños son maravillosos. Ofrecen excelentes opciones sin lácteos, así que no dejes que eso te impida visitarlos. Hay muchísimos sabores y opciones deliciosas, y puedes probarlos antes de decidirte por un helado o dos. Un día, les dije que probablemente podían hacer que el kale (col rizada) tuviera un buen sabor, y ¡apareció un delicioso helado de mango y kale!
original: This place is so nice and the owners are wonderful. They have great dairy free options so don't let that stop you from visiting. So many great flavors and options and you can try them before committing to a scoop or two. One day I said they could probably make kale taste good, and out from the back came a yummy mango and kale ice cream!

text: Este lugar não se destaca muito, é apenas uma padaria comum que se encontra no final de cada rua nos Estados Unidos. A variedade de doces é bastante limitada, e o sabor não é muito especial. Os bolos não estavam perfeitamente decorados e escorriam. Não sou muito fã do trabalho deles. É caro e a publicidade não corresponde à qualidade.
original: This place is nothing great than a regular bakery you find at the end of every street in america. They have very limited selection of pastries and they tasted mediocre. The cup cakes werent perfectly iced and they were sliding . Not a big fan of their work.overpriced and over hyped

text: ¡Me encanta este lugar! La masa de los "monstruos de galletas" es la mejor, sin duda. Excelente servicio, gente amable y helado increíble.
original: Love this place!! Cookie monsters dough melt is the best hands down! Great service, great people and amazing ice cream!

text: Sprinkles fue, en gran medida, lo que inició la fiebre por los cupcakes, y ya era hora de tener uno aquí en Las Vegas. He visitado algunas de las sucursales de California, así que sabía qué esperar. Sin embargo, si es la primera vez que visitas Sprinkles, le aconsejo que gestione sus expectativas. Los cupcakes no son baratos, unos $4 por uno, y un poco más baratos si compras una docena. Aunque esto pueda parecer caro, los cupcakes aquí son, por supuesto, mucho mejores que los que se pueden encontrar en el supermercado local. Cuando visité esta sucursal, había una fila larga tanto para la tienda de cupcakes como para la de helados. Aunque había unas 20 personas delante de nosotros, la fila se movía bastante rápido, unos 20 minutos hasta que entramos. Ofrecen un menú rotativo de lo que se ofrece cada día, pero, por supuesto, tienen algunos clásicos disponibles todos los días. La "caja dispensadora" de cupcakes justo al lado ayuda a ahorrar tiempo si sabes qué quieres. El cupcake más popular es el de "red velvet", pero creo que el glaseado es un poco demasiado dulce para mi gusto. Evita el caramelo duro en la parte superior, ya que solo es para decorar. Los utensilios de madera son un detalle agradable, y el personal es excelente. ¡Sé aventurero y prueba algunos sabores diferentes para ver cuál te gusta más!
original: Sprinkles is pretty much what started the cupcake craze and its about time we got one here in Vegas. I've been to a couple of the California locations so I knew what to expect. However, if its your first time visiting Sprinkles, I'd advise you to manage your expectations. The cupcakes are not cheap, about $4 for one and slightly cheaper if you buy a dozen. While that might seem overpriced, the cupcakes here are of course much better than what you would pick up at the local supermarket. When I visited this location, there was a line out the door for both the cupcake and ice cream shop. Though there were probably 20 people in front of us, the line moved pretty quickly, about 20 minutes til we were inside. They have a rotating menu of whats offered each day but they of course have a couple staples available every day. The cupcake ATM right next to is helps save some time if you know what you want. The standard most people get is the red velvet, I find the frosting to be a little too sweet for my tastes. Avoid the rock hard sugar candy on the top, its just there for decoration. The wooden utensils are a nice touch and the people working are top notch. Be adventurous and try a couple different flavors to see what ya like the most.

text: Eu adoro sorvete, mas não este sorvete. Tem uma textura um pouco gordurosa e os sabores não são muito interessantes. Eu experimentei o "Hailley's Comet" (com caramelo e chocolate) e um amigo experimentou o de biscoito. Nenhum dos dois gostou. Joguei fora cerca de 1/4 do meu sorvete. Custa US$ 3,64 por colher. Não vale a pena o preço ou as calorias.
original: I love ice cream--But NOT their ice cream. Kind of greasy with flat flavors. I had Hailley's Comet (caramel and chocolate swirl) and a friend had the cookie dough. He didn't like his either. I threw about 1/4 of mine away. $3.64 per scoop. Not worth the money or the calories.

text: Estou adorando todas as novas empresas que estão abrindo no meu bairro. Finalmente consegui visitar este lugar outro dia. Fiquei impressionado com a variedade de sabores que eles oferecem. Tudo, desde Oreo de baunilha até Graham Central Station, os clássicos e tudo mais. Tantas opções!! (Referência a Shaqtin' A Fool) Eles têm sundes, milkshakes, cones e, acredito que, outras opções também. Os preços são razoáveis. Paguei menos de cinco dólares por um cone de waffle com uma grande quantidade de sorvete. O jovem na janela foi muito educado! Estou muito satisfeito e pretendo frequentar este pequeno lugar, especialmente agora que o verão está chegando.
original: Loving all the new businesses opening in my hood. Finally got to check this place out the other day. I couldn't believe the variety of flavors they offered. Everything from vanilla Oreo to Graham Central Station, the classics, and everything in between. Sooooooo many options!! (Reference to Shaqtin' A Fool ) They have sundaes, shakes, cones and I believe some other options. Prices are reasonable. I paid less than five dollars for a waffle cone with a large amount of ice cream. The young man at the window was so polite! I'm a happy camper and will frequent this little find especially now that summer is quickly approaching.

text: Durante las 48 horas que estuve en Cleveland, visité Mitchell's dos veces… lo que, creo, dice mucho. El helado es INCREÍBLE y puedes probar diferentes sabores sin límite. Probé el "Wildberry Crumble", que estaba delicioso. Lo que realmente es genial es que puedes ver cómo se elabora el helado en la "fábrica". La tienda está ubicada en un antiguo teatro, lo que también le añade encanto. Incluso como visitante, pude notar que Mitchell's es un lugar favorito tanto para los locales como para los turistas; siempre estaba lleno. Dato curioso: Los "C" de Ohio tienen heladerías competidoras: Cleveland-Mitchell's, Cincinnati-Graeter's, Columbus-Jeni's.
original: In the 48 hours I was in Cleveland, I went to Mitchell's twice...which I think speaks for itself. The ice cream is AMAZING and you get unlimited samples. I tried the Wildberry Crumble, which was wonderful. What's really cool is that you can see into the "factory" and watch how everything is made. The store is held in an old theatre, which really adds to the charm too. Even as a visitor, I could tell that Mitchell's is a definite favorite for locals and tourists; the place was always packed. Fun Fact: The "C's" of Ohio have competing ice cream stores: Cleveland-Mitchell's Cincinnati-Graeter's Columbus-Jeni's

text: Está bien, hemos estado viniendo mucho desde que abrimos. La principal queja es la lentitud, incluso cuando no hay una cola. Se tarda mucho en conseguir un café o una taza de té. Definitivamente, vale la pena visitarlo. Pero asegúrate de no tener prisa. Estarás aquí un tiempo.
original: It's ok, we've been going a lot since opening. Main complaint is the efficiency even when there isn't a line around the door. Takes a long time to get coffee or tea. Definitely go and check it out. But make sure you're not in a hurry. You'll be here a while

text: Nossa! O "crack pie" e o bolo de aniversário são obrigatórios aqui! Meu marido veio aqui algumas semanas antes, trazendo um pedaço do "crack pie" depois de jantar com os amigos no Momofuku. Eu comi um pedaço e fiquei chocada... que é isso?!?! Precisávamos voltar. Mal posso esperar para experimentar o sorvete deles na próxima vez. O atendimento é lento... é o único ponto negativo. Levaram mais de 15 minutos para cortar o bolo de aniversário e colocá-lo na caixa, e até chamá-lo. Mas voltaremos!
original: Oh man! Crack pie and birthday cake is a must here! My husband came here a few weeks before with a piece of crack pie after his dinner with his friends at Momofuku. I took one bite out of it and it was like....what is this?!?! We had to come back together. I can't wait to try their soft serve next time. Service is slow....it's the only downfall. It took them over 15 minutes to slice the birthday cake and put it in the box and call it out. We'll still be back!

text: Gracias a su opción de pedidos en línea, pude ordenar algunos artículos para el desayuno esta mañana y luego ir a recogerlos, lo cual fue muy conveniente. Pedí un "pear bostock" (una especie de panecillo con pera), una "cinnamon roll" (un rollo de canela), un "croissant" con jamón y queso, y un huevo dentro de un "croissant". Me alegra ver que siguen abiertos y que pueden atender a los clientes de forma segura y conveniente durante la pandemia.
original: Thanks to their online ordering option I was able to order a few breakfast items this morning and then swing by to pick them up, which was very convenient. Ordered the pear bostock, a cinnamon roll, a ham and cheese croissant, and an egg in a croissant. Glad to see them still open and able to serve customers safely and conveniently during COVID.

text: MILK BAR is next door to Momofuku at the Cosmo hotel. Come here for unique treats such as their famous "crack pie!" It's a buttery shortbread crust with a dense chewy butter cake that is out of this world! If you get one thing there, get that! But of course they sell individual cookies from chocolate chip cornflake cookies, confetti cookies to their "compost cookie" which I bought as souvenirs!

I really wasn't impressed. I shared three different mini cupcakes with my friend. Red velvet, black & white and vanilla. The after taste was the worst part! I won't go out of my way to return. The cupcake ATM was a hoot and I will post photo.

Jarling's is easily one of the most famous establishments in all of C-U. There is always an absolutely gigantic line to get the frozen treats they provide. Though I don't go often, because of the aforementioned long lines, I always enjoy their custard and the general experience of going to Jarling's. I'll keep stopping in...as long as the lines aren't long! Definitely a must-go when you're in C-U.

A experiência mais incrível que já tive. Tenho desejado isso todos os dias desde a minha primeira visita na semana passada. Eu comi um donut recheado com manteiga e nozes, com cobertura de cereal. Meu marido comeu a waffle, e tudo estava realmente delicioso. Eles dedicaram tempo para atender cada cliente individualmente, sem pressa. Uma experiência maravilhosa.
original: The experience I've ever had. I have craved this everyday since I went for the first time last week. I had butter pecan inside of a donut with cereal topping. My husband had the waffle & everything was really delicious. They took the time to take care of customers one at a time not feeling rushed. Wonderful experience.

text: Esta avaliação é sobre o donut com creme brulée. A textura era ótima: uma cobertura crocante e caramelizada, com um recheio cremoso. No entanto, o sabor estava muito fraco. O açúcar caramelizado tinha um gosto queimado e um leve amargor. Tanto o donut quanto o creme não tinham muito sabor. Não era excessivamente doce (o que é um ponto positivo para mim), mas também não tinha nenhum sabor marcante. Estou um pouco decepcionado, e já comi donuts melhores por preços mais baixos. No lado positivo, o interior é muito charmoso e o atendimento foi excelente! O estacionamento pode ser um pouco complicado, pois as vagas paralelas perto da loja são pagas.
original: This review is for the Creme brÃ»lÃ©e donut. Texture was great---crisp caramelized sugar glaze with a creamy center. However, the taste was very lacking. The caramelized sugar tasted burnt and had a slight bitterness to it. The donut itself and the creme barely had any taste. It wasn't too sweet (which is a bonus for me) but it wasn't too ANYTHING. Im kind of disappointed and I've definitely had better donuts for cheaper prices. On a positive note, very cute inside and service was great! Parking can be a bit tricky--the parallel parking available near the store is all pay-to-park

text: El helado de vainilla es el mejor!!!!!!!!
original: The vanilla ice cream is the best!!!!!!!!

text: Adorei! Estava muito animada para experimentar e provar alguns dos doces deles, e fico feliz por ter compartilhado com meus primos. Eles não sabem quem é o Buddy, mas gostaram muito das amostras. Eles me agradecerão mais tarde se algum dia assistirem ao programa que experimentamos: cannoli de chocolate, merengue de chocolate com, acredito, nozes, profiterole de café e rabo de lagosta! Meu irmão e um dos meus primos preferiram o cannoli, enquanto o outro primo e eu preferimos o rabo de lagosta. Estou com muita vontade de experimentar mais!
original: Completely love this! I was excited to try and sample some of their desserts, and I'm happy to have shared them with my cousins~! They do not know who Buddy is, but they did enjoy the samples. They'll thank me later if they ever watch the show what we sampled: chocolate cannoli, chocolate merengue with I believe walnut?, coffee cream puff, and lobster tail! My brother and one of my cousin favored the cannoli, while my other cousin and I favored the lobster tail. I am craving to have some more!

text: Es decir. Sí. Es Jeni's. Los helados son increíbles. El personal es súper amable. El espacio es pequeño y puede haber cola (perdón, ¡habrá cola!). Pero eso no me hará quitar una estrella. Hay cola porque los productos de Jeni's valen la pena esperar. Mi amiga y yo, después de probar Jeni's por primera vez con una porción de Earth Fare y luego probar su heladería en Nashville, estábamos muy emocionadas cuando nos enteramos de que Jeni's iba a abrir. Los sabores siguen siendo innovadores y es genial poder finalmente tener la opción de a) comprar un helado de Jeni's – ¡pruébalo!, y b) no tener que comprar una porción entera. Pero, siendo realistas, después de probarlo, querrás comprar una porción entera. Y luego nos invitarás a ayudarte a terminarla. ¿No?
original: I mean. Yea. It's Jeni's. The ice cream rocks. The employees are super super friendly. The space is small and they can have a line (pardon - there WILL be a line. Expect a line), but that won't make me knock a star off. There's a line because Jeni's product is worth waiting in line for. The Lady and I, after trying Jeni's for the first time out of a pint from Earth Fare and then trying her scoop shop in Nashville, were SO excited when we heard the news that Jeni's was coming. The flavors are still innovative and it's so nice to finally have an option to a) have a Jeni's cone - try it, and b) not have to commit to purchasing an entire pint. But let's be real, after trying it, you're going to want to commit to purchase an entire pint. And then you'll invite us over to help you demolish it. Right?

text: Personal amable y deliciosos postres. Pedí el helado con brownie (no recuerdo el nombre exacto). El chocolate caliente que lo acompañaba estaba delicioso. El brownie en sí no era tan bueno, pero era perfecto para agregar al helado. El helado cuesta $10 y es bastante grande, considerando lo dulce y rico que son los sabores; es mejor compartirlo con amigos. Definitivamente volveré aquí la próxima vez que esté en Las Vegas.
original: Super friendly staff and yummy treats! I had the brownie sundae (can't recall the actual name). The hot fudge in it was delicious. The brownie was not that great on its own, but perfect for crumbling up into your ice cream. The sundae is $10 and big for how sweet and rich the flavors are; you're better off splitting it with friends. I will definitely return here next time I'm in Vegas.

text: Estaba muy emocionado por probar este lugar, pero no fue como esperaba. Al ver la larga fila, pensé que la comida sería excelente, pero una vez que entré, los productos de la panadería parecían bastante mediocres. Sabía que, por su apariencia, los postres no serían tan buenos como decían, pero realmente quería probarlo, pensando que algo debía ser realmente bueno, considerando que todos estaban esperando ansiosamente algo delicioso. Pedí el producto más popular de la tienda y, créanme, definitivamente no estaba a la altura. Pedí dos raciones de langosta, un pastel de fresas y un cupcake de chocolate y avellanas, y después de gastar 27 dólares, me quedé bastante insatisfecho. Lo único positivo fue la muy amable cajera.
original: I was very excited to try this place but it was not like I expected it to be. Seeing the long line I thought it would taste great, but once I entered the location, the bakery items looked very average. I knew by its appearance that desserts would not be what the hype was about but I really wanted to give it a try telling myself that something has to be great with everyone sanding in line for a treat. I ordered the most popular thing on their shelf and let me tell you, it was most definitely not good at all. I ordered 2 lobster tails, 1 strawberry shortcake and 1 chocolate hazelnut cupcake - $27 later I am left unpleasantly dissatisfied. One plus was the very helpful clerk behind the counter.

text: The line was long to get in this place and it surely did not disappoint. We picked up mini chocolate mouse cake, red velvet cupcake, cannoli, lobster tail and some kind of cookie bar. Everything was awesome and so fresh! This place is a must try when you're in Vegas!

A MUST in Cleveland. A great place for a quick coffee or snack. All of their desserts and pastries look amazing but I just can't stop myself from getting a cannoli. The filling is so creamy and has the perfect amount of sweetness. I've also tried the tiramisu and cannoli chocolate cake, both of which are delicious. It's a popular place so it can get crowded but there's a ton of space inside. When it's not as busy, it's a good place for some light studying or work.

Siempre he querido visitar el icónico Momofuku Milk Bar, desde que vi fotos de él en Tumblr y descubrí que la tienda estaba en Nueva York. Soy de California, así que nunca pensé que tendría la oportunidad de visitarlo. Mientras estábamos en Eggslut, nos encontramos casualmente con este lugar y pedimos lo básico: helado de vainilla con copos de maíz (creo que tiene un nombre específico, pero probablemente sea "helado suave") y fue como comer nubes o aire, ¡pero de la mejor manera posible!
original: I've always wanted to visit the iconic momofuku milk bar ever since I've seen pictures of it on Tumblr and realized that the store was located in New York. I am from California so I never thought I would ever be able to visit. While We were at eggslut, I serendipitously stumbled upon this place and we got the basic order which was the vanilla ice cream with corn flakes (there's an actual name for that but i think it's soft serve) and it was just like eating clouds or air in the best way.

text: Estive procurando incessantemente por seus biscoitos, brownies e bolos de "s'mores" por muito tempo. Mas, finalmente, consegui alguns. Não são exatamente o que eu esperava, mas é algo. Então, comprei o bolo de "s'mores" e um bolo de "tres Leche". Minha amiga adora o bolo de "tres Leche". E eu gosto do de "s'mores". É muito úmido e delicioso. Não posso dizer que o atendimento ao cliente foi perfeito. As respostas foram muito rápidas, tanto na primeira quanto na segunda vez. Então, não tentei insistir ou ser muito informal. Foi a primeira vez. Estava bastante cheio. Na segunda vez, foi a primeira quarta-feira após a abertura, e parecia que havia um evento privado acontecendo ao mesmo tempo. Então, me senti um pouco pressionada. No geral, adoraria voltar e comprar os biscoitos de "s'mores" e mais bolos.
original: I have been chasing their s'mores cookies, brownies and cakes for what seem to be an eternity. But finally I got some. It's not what I wanted but it's something. So I got the s'mores cake, and a tres Leche cake. My friend loves the tres Leche. And I like the s'mores. It's very moist and heavenly. I can't say their customer service was 5 stars. They were very short wirh their answers both times. So I didn't try to push it or overly chatty. First time. It was packed in there. 2nd time. It was the first Wednesday at they opened in the evening. And it seem like there were a private event going on at the same time.. So I felt a bit rushed. All in all. I would love to come back and get the s'mores cookies, and more cakes

text: I had their pink sprinkles and creme brulee. There was nothing special about them. The filling for the creme brulee was one sided and minimal. The pink sprinkles one was not even moist on the inside. It was very dry. And even with a mustache, the lady called me ma'am lol.

My cousins Christina and Manny favorite spot, this place is amazing and delicious!! The donut melt is to die for with the banana ice cream and the cookie monster is out of this world!! (Warning it will turn your mouth blue ) give them a try and it's reasonable priced

Se você adora sorvete cremoso, este é o lugar ideal. Há história, tradição, a beleza das luzes de neon, e, claro, sorvetes deliciosos. Você realmente precisa experimentar o sorvete de blueberry, que geralmente é uma oferta por tempo limitado (não tenho certeza de quando está disponível, mas eles tinham na noite passada, 8 de junho). O local aceita apenas dinheiro, então esteja ciente disso. É definitivamente uma viagem que vale a pena. Há um pequeno estacionamento, para que você possa sentar e saborear seu sorvete, já que talvez precise dedicar toda a sua atenção a ele. De qualquer forma, vá por nostalgia ou por causa do ótimo sorvete, de qualquer forma você vai se divertir!
original: If you love soft serve, this is the place to go. There's history, tradition, the beauty of neon lights, plus really wonderful ice cream. You simply must experience the blueberry soft serve which is usually a limited time offering (not sure when it runs, but they had it there last night, June 8). Page is cash only, just so you know. It's definitely worth the trip. There's a small parking lot, so you can sit and eat your ice cream, as you may need to give it your full attention. Anyway, go for the nostalgia or go for the great ice cream, either way you win!

text: My most frequented place in Madison. It's legitimately embarrassing how often I end up here when I'm too lazy to cook. Delicious savory pastries. I am not one for sweets, so I'm the wrong person to evaluate their desserts; but everyone I know who has had them says they are great too. Try the gruyere and savory cream cheese croissant!
The most mediocre place ever... smelled like chemicals when we walked in. A SMALL ass scoop for $5? And $1 for every topping? Gee thanks for my 4 sprinkles.... Never coming back here again.
El croissant de chocolate es increíble. Combinado con el chai cremoso tailandés, ¡me encantó! La panadería tiene un ambiente muy agradable.
original: Chocolate croissant is to die for. I had the Thai chai creme with it and loved the combo! The bakery has a very charming atmosphere.

text: VARIETY!! This spot is awesome! They have a large variety of flavors including some interesting savory flavors such as Dill Pickle and Blue Cheese! I ordered a scoop of the Coconut Sorbet, the employee told me it's made with real coconut milk which is what makes it so smooth and creamy. Watching them scoop it out was sooo smooth and satisfying! I also sampled the Honey Lavender flavor, which did not disappoint! There is some grass and areas to sit outside, so we enjoyed our dessert under the stars laying in the grass. I'd definitely return for dessert if I'm in the area.

Este lugar tiene donuts increíbles, aunque es un poco caro para una panadería de donuts, ¡pero los donuts son enormes! Pedimos una docena y nos dieron una gratis. Eran realmente abundantes y un poco dulces, así que solo pude comer un par de bocados, pero quedaron sobras para mañana. Mi favorito fue el donut de Oreo, que tenía un relleno de Oreo suave, ¡estaba delicioso! Diría que su café es muy fuerte, así que solo cómalo si te gusta el sabor del café. En general, es una panadería de donuts muy buena.
original: This place has amazing donuts, it was kind of expensive for a donut shop but there donuts are huge! We ordered a dozen and got one free. They were really filling and kind of sweet so I could only eat like a couple bites but more leftovers for tomorrow. My favorite was the Oreo donut that had a soft oreo inside, it was so good! I would say there coffee is really strong so only get it if you like the taste of coffee. Overall a really good donut shop!

text: Esta era uma padaria realmente boa! Definitivamente um lugar onde você gostaria de ir com amigos, a qualquer hora do dia ou da noite. Eu vim aqui às 2:30 da manhã uma noite e ainda havia muitas pessoas por lá. Sem dúvida, um lugar mais seguro em um bairro que, de resto, não é muito confiável. Eu pessoalmente AMO a torta de nozes! É incrível. Também provei o café gelado deles. Estava bom, mas não é nada excepcional. A única coisa que me impede de dar 5 estrelas é o fato de que eles não têm tanta variedade de doces à noite. Caso contrário, um lugar excelente.
original: This was a really good bakery! Definitely somewhere you'd want to go with friends, no matter the time of day or night. I came here at 2:30am one night and there were still so many people there. Definitely a safer spot in an otherwise sketchy neighborhood. I personally LOVE LOVE LOVE the pecan tart! It's amazing. I had their iced coffee, too. It was pretty good, nothing to rave about though. The only thing holding me back from giving this place 5 stars is the fact that they don't have as much of an array of treats later at night. Otherwise, a solid spot.

text: I love ice cream no matter what but this place was amazing to me because of the people behind the counter. So fun! So cute! So nice! The guy was really excited to torch the marshmallow fluff i ordered and it was perfect. Ice cream was amazing as expected. I got a double scoop because my eyes are bigger than my stomach and it was too much. Peanut butter tastes like a cookie as opposed to from out the jar. Tiramisu has the right hint of amaretto. Oh I also grabbed one of those salted caramel things in the front. I assume it's house made but wow it's so buttery salty and 50 cents! Hehe get one on the go. So worth it if you're a caramel lover like me. Can't wait to go back. It's a really hip and crowded place.

I'm not sure if this place used to be better or what but we went tonight and we're so disappointed! We got the cookie ice cream cup, ice cream was flavorless and icey, macaron was hard and the marshmallow was burned. It was also 8 dollars for a single scoop of ice cream! The girl working was extremely unfriendly and service was sooo slow.

Este lugar vale a pena procurar! Suba em um elevador e siga por um corredor que leva para fora, e você encontrará o Carlo's. É pequeno? Sim, é bem pequeno, mas do tamanho ideal para entrar e sair com facilidade. Considero que é um pouco caro, mas tudo estava excelente. Eu voltaria, mas deixarei algumas pistas para me guiar de volta para o cassino.
original: This place is worth finding! Up an escalator and down a hallway that leads outside is where you'll find Carlo's. Small? Yes, it's very small, but kust the right size to get in and out. A little pricey IMO, but everything was fantastic. I would go again, but i'll leave a trail of breadcrumbs to find my way back to the casino.

text: Duas palavras: Toffee Banofi. Compramos um e desejamos ter quatro. Incrivelmente delicioso. Alton Brown está certo ao dizer que este é um dos "melhores sabores que já experimentei". Sorvete com pedaços de toffee, amendoim, caramelo, banana, chantilly e uma tigela de waffle crocante... como alguém poderia errar? Os outros sabores de sorvete também eram deliciosos, mas acabaram sendo ofuscados pelos sundes. Nosso garçom foi muito paciente com nossa degustação excessiva e dedicou tempo para transformar nosso sundae em uma obra de arte. Sweet Republic está no mesmo nível de outros sorvetarias renomadas que já visitei: Bi-Rite, Ici, Salt & Straw, Creole Creamery, etc. Voltarei se alguma vez estiver na área!
original: Two words: Toffee Banofi We got one and wished we actually got four. So, so good. Alton Brown is right on about this being one of the "best things I ever ate". Delicious almond brittle ice cream, toffee chunks, caramel, bananas, whipped cream, and a crispy waffle bowl...how can you even go wrong? The other ice cream flavors were pretty delicious too, but in the end overshadowed by the sundaes. Our server was very patient with our excessive sampling, and took time to make our sundae into a work of art. Sweet Republic is in the same league as many other ice cream greats I've been to: Bi-Rite, Ici, Salt & Straw, Creole Creamery, etc. I will return if I'm ever in the area again!

text: Amazing chocolate and ice cream, in a fun little corner off the strip. Nice gift shop also.

Estou visitando de Califórnia e precisava de algo para me refrescar, porque está absurdamente quente aqui! Decidi experimentar a Novel Ice Cream, devido às ótimas avaliações, e estou muito feliz por ter feito isso! Experimentei o sorvete de mimosa e foi muito refrescante em um dia tão quente. No entanto, a melhor parte foi o atendimento ao cliente! O Jalen foi extremamente simpático, divertido e prestativo. Se eu voltar a este lugar quente algum dia, certamente voltarei à Novel Ice Cream.
original: I'm visiting from California and needed something to help cool me off because it's so damn HOT out here! I decided to try out Novel Ice Cream because of the great reviews and I'm happy I tried it out! I had the mimosa sorbet and it was very refreshing on a very hot day. However, my favorite part was the customer service! Jalen was extremely nice, funny, and helpful. If I ever come back to the this hot ass desert again, I will Forsure come back to Novel Ice cream

text: Yum. Even though I have one in my backyard in Newport, I still have to stop here when I'm at the LINQ Promenade. The best thing about this place is it has the cupcake ATM ! Its always busy but believe the hype. The cupcakes are all made with high quality ingredients that you can taste and the ice cream is just so creamy and their specialty flavors are my fave. I got the Lemon meringue ice cream and a cupcake with it on the side (I can never eat them together) HEAVEN. I also got a cookie cupcake to go and ate it this morning with my coffee. Out of the park good. My kid got the red velvet waffle cone with Cap'n Crunch ice cream. SOOO good. Service was nice, and helpful OH and don't forget to sign up for the rewards program!

Finally opened in Vegas! I've been going to the 85 bakeries in California and I have always wanted one here in Vegas. Now that they're opened (Grand opening Dec 6.) I always look forward to getting my fix. The quality of bread is amazing and the variety they have is immense. If you look for something savory, sweet, or decadent this bakery has it all. I always get the Hawaiian chicken and garlic bread. The service is excellent, cashiers are fully attentive and are always accommodating. If you need a quick fix of delicious baked goods definitely try this place out!

El ambiente es agradable, el horario extendido es una gran ventaja, pero las multitudes pueden ser un problema. Además, nunca tienen cafeteras francesas disponibles, aunque están en el menú (¿es una panadería francesa?). La comida es deliciosa si puedes aguantar la espera.
original: The atmosphere is nice, the all hours thing is great, but the crowds can be a mess. Also they never have French presses available but they're on the menu (it's a French bakery?) The food is yummy if you can bear the wait.

text: They do not make this location easy for you to find! It's tucked around and underneath a set of escalators. I asked 3 different workers of the Venetian and it was the security guard that finally pointed me to the right direction. The first person I asked was from Guest Services too! We were disappointed to find that they did not have the lemon macaron here. My fiancee absolutely loves Bouchon's lemon macaron from Napa. We ended up settling for chocolate and salted caramel. Both were delicious, as expected.

Este lugar tiene un ambiente excelente y un personal maravilloso. El heladero, con su cabello afro rizado y rubio, hizo que mi experiencia fuera aún mejor gracias a su actitud positiva. De hecho, dejé una propina, algo que nunca haría en un lugar similar de helados.
original: This place has a great atmosphere and wonderful staff. The ice cream professional with a stringy curly blonde Afro made the experience for me with his positive attitude! I even left a tip- something I would never do in a similar ice cream shop setting.

text: I love the different varieties of chocolate covered pretzels they have. The chocolate to pretzel ratio is what it like lol (if that makes sense). It's not too much chocolate coated on the pretzel. They have this Turtle Pretzel that is sooo freakin' yummy. They only thing I craved today was pretzels lol and I ran there to pick up a few...it was hard to leave the place because everything look so dee-lish. The popcorn they have can be a little daring. I tried I think some kind of Jalapeno popcorn and even though I love hot and spicy stuff...that left me in tears lol really! But the carmel corn, when it's warm, is really good!

O melhor lugar para se deliciar. Fiquei impressionado ao ver a Ghirardelli em Las Vegas. Eles têm uma grande variedade de doces. Nós experimentamos os de domingo, e eu escolhi o de chocolate amargo. Certifique-se de ir com fome, pois depois de experimentar um desses, você provavelmente não terá vontade de comer mais nada.
original: Best place to sin. I was amazed to see Ghirardelli in Vegas. You have. A large variety to eat from . We took the Sunday's and I took the dark chocolate Sunday.. Make sure to go here hungry as after having one of these babies you'll have to say good bye to food.

text: Updated review. Ice cream is still good... but for the price of a simple shake you'd expect it to come with standard whip cream. This place is overpriced. I'll stick with Novel on grand Ave.  Also if your staff is going to expect tips then they should have a better attitude.

Conheci um amigo aqui para colocar o papo em dia e experimentar os donuts veganos deles. O local fica na 6ª e na Carson, e há bastante estacionamento... traga moedas ou um cartão de crédito. Todas as vagas são pagas. Entrei e fui recebido por uma equipe muito simpática. Todos foram muito gentis e acolhedores. Meu amigo já estava lá, esperando com um donut vegano de matcha verde, um creme brûlée e um donut de maçã. Fomos para o pátio e começamos a comer. O donut de maçã foi o melhor que já comi. Era crocante por fora e macio e quente por dentro. Havia pedaços de maçã reais espalhados por todo o donut. O matcha verde foi um delicioso donut de bolo que não era muito doce e tinha raspas de laranja. Ficou delicioso. O creme brûlée era macio e tinha um creme delicioso e espesso. Fiquei realmente impressionado... na verdade, quando terminamos, era horário de happy hour, então comprei uma caixa inteira por 5 dólares e dei para minha família e amigos. Definitivamente, este é o meu novo lugar favorito para comprar donuts. Mal posso esperar para voltar e experimentar mais opções veganas!
original: I met a friend here to play catch up and try their vegan doughnuts. It's located on 6th and Carson and parking is plentiful... bring change or a credit card. All parking is metered. I walked in and was greeted by a super friendly staff. Everyone was so nice and welcoming. My friend was there waiting with a vegan green matcha tea doughnut, a creme brÃ»lÃ©e, and a apple fritter. We headed outside to the court yard and went to town. The apple fritter was the best donut I've ever eaten. It was crispy on the outside and soft and warm on the inside. There was real apples scattered throughout the donut. The green matcha tea was a delicious cake donut that wasn't overly sweet and had orange zest. It was delicious. The creme brÃ»lÃ©e was soft and oozed out a delicious and thick creme. I was thoroughly impressed... in fact... it was happy hour when we were done so I got an entire variety box for 5 dollars and gave them to my family and friends. This is definitely my new favorite donut place. I can't wait to come back and try more of their vegan options!

text: Employee refused to give me water. Food is average for the high price point. The study environment is decent.
Um lugar agradável para fazer uma pausa rápida e saborear um lanche, além de deliciosos donuts. As fotos não fazem jus – é realmente melhor e maior do que parece.
original: Neat place to drop in for a quick snack & indulging on good donuts. Pictures doesn't do justice- definitely better & bigger than it looks.

text: Foi muito divertido fazer o pedido desses donuts, haha! Fui lá para encomendar donuts especiais para o aniversário do meu namorado e acabei fazendo pedidos para todo o escritório! Primeiro, precisei tirar fotos de todas as opções disponíveis e, em seguida, ESPERAR que me respondessem. Os funcionários foram muito simpáticos e pacientes comigo. Agora, os donuts... Eles estavam bons! Não eram tão bons quanto os "Donut Man" de Los Angeles, mas estavam realmente deliciosos. Acho que o meu favorito foi o donut de Caramelo Latte. Era doce e cremoso! O "Strawberry Split" estava um pouco seco. O "Chocolate Euphoria" estava apenas ok. O "Creme Brulee" estava realmente bom, mas precisava de mais creme no meio. Acho que o meu favorito da turma foi o "Old Fashion". Estou me arrependendo de não ter pedido aquele último donut de Nutella, acho que teria adorado! Voltarei, mas estou sentindo falta muito dos donuts de qualidade do "Donut Man" aqui em Las Vegas.
original: I had a fun time ordering these donuts, lol! I went there to get Birthday donuts for my guy and ended up taking orders for the whole office! I first had to take pix of all that was available and then WAIT for them to get back to me. The employees were very cool and very patient with me. Now the donuts... They were good! They weren't L.A.'s Donut Man good but they were really good. I think m favorite was the Caramel Latte donut. It was sweet and creamy! The Strawberry Split was a little dry. Chocolate Euphoria was just okay. The Creme Brulee was really good but it needed more cream in the middle. I think my favorite of the group was the old fashion. I'm kicking myself for not grabbing that last Nutella donut, I think I would have loved it!! I'll go back again but I'm really missing Donut Man caliber donuts here in Vegas.

text: Una palabra: Delicioso. Dos palabras: Gran ambiente. Mi opinión: ¡Delicioso en mi estómago! Todos deberían visitar Amelie's Bakery, ubicada en NoDa. Es mucho más que una panadería, y una vez que la prueben, entenderán por qué lo digo. Es casi como estar en la casa de una tía genial (pero ecléctica) que disfruta preparando tartas, croissants, sándwiches para el desayuno y mucho más para tentar su paladar. Les hablo de este lugar porque pueden considerarlo una experiencia y visitarlo cuando quieran para disfrutar de un momento casi épico (¡como en la película "HOT!") con una pareja, o para comprar algo para un día a día o una ocasión especial. Ahora mismo, seguro que tienen agua en la boca. Simplemente recuerden que estos deliciosos productos se pueden adquirir en cualquier momento, ya que está abierto las 24 horas del día (¡qué suerte!).
original: One word: Delicious Two words: Great atmosphere My Two cents: Yummy in my tummy! Everyone should check out Amelie's Bakery located in NoDa. It's really more than a bakery and once you check it out you will understand why I say this. It's almost like hanging out at your cool (but eclectic) aunt's house who likes to whip up tarts, bear claws, breakfast sandwiches and more to tempt your tastebuds. I'm telling you about this place because you can treat it as an experience and swing by anytime to have an almost 9 1/2 weeks (remember that movie...HOT!) moment with a date or pick up treats for an everyday or special occasion. By now your mouth should be watering. Just remember these delicious items could be picked up at anytime since its open 24 hours a day (winning!!).

text: 85C is a mandatory stop at Shanghai Plaza. My family, friends and colleagues love the pastries. We would have a box of 85°C at my work's break room and conference room at least twice a month lol. Selection: Assorted pastries are freshly baked and more affordable than other bakeries. It seems like there are always new goodies every time we visit. The beverage menu was just decent, we enjoyed the iced coffee and sea salt jasmine iced tea. We really just come here for the pastries lol Service: Staff is friendly, also hardworking! They would come in and out to restock the pastries as some of the goodies get sold within minutes of after the previous restock lol! Parking: FREE. Shanghai Plaza parking lot just outside the bakery. We prefer parking in the back at W Pioneer Ave. & Arville St. then just stroll around the plaza since it gets really packed in the front. Highly recommend!

Si buscas helado suave en Pittsburgh, este es el lugar ideal. Además de los sabores habituales como vainilla y chocolate, que se encuentran en la mayoría de los lugares, Page's ofrece una gran variedad de otros sabores, como naranja, chocolate con menta, amaretto, calabaza y muchos más. De verdad, no puedes equivocarte con ninguno de los sabores de helado suave. Parece que estos sabores varían según la temporada; por ejemplo, la calabaza solo aparece en el menú en otoño. Normalmente, me decanto por un pequeño cono sencillo, pero tienen una gran variedad de helados y otras formas de disfrutar de todos los sabores de helado suave. Además, también ofrecen algunos platos salados, que aún no he probado. Las colas pueden ser largas, pero no dejes que eso te detenga, porque la espera vale la pena. Ah, y solo aceptan efectivo, pero tienen un cajero automático al lado del edificio.
original: When you want soft-serve ice cream in Pittsburgh, this is where to go! In addition to the usual vanilla and chocolate you'd find at most places, Page's has a slew of other flavors like orange, mint chocolate chip, amaretto, pumpkin, and many more! You really can't go wrong with any soft serve flavor. It seems that these flavors rotate depending on the season as well; for instance, pumpkin only appears on the menu in the fall. I tend to stick to the simple small cone, but they have a huge variety of sundaes and other ways to enjoy the many soft serve flavors. Not to mention, they have a few savory food items too, which I have yet to try. The lines are long, but don't let that stop you because the wait is worth it. Oh, and it's cash only, but they have an atm to the side of the building!

text: Sabores incríveis e atendimento excelente. Pedí um sundae com sorvete de leite e biscoitos, com cobertura de marshmallow assado e calda de chocolate quente. O cone de waffle também estava delicioso! Há uma grande variedade de sobremesas para escolher. Voltarei!
original: Fantastic flavors and staff. I got a sundae with milk and cookies ice cream, topped with a roasted marshmallow topping and hot fudge. The waffle cone was delicious too! There are a huge variety of desserts to choose from. I will be back!

text: I have eaten here three times and they never disappoint. Staff are friendly and make an effort to talk and get your order correct. Ghirardelli chocolate is my favorite, so I am some biased, but the ice cream, chocolate chip cookies and candy selection are out of this world. The first time I go, was sundae with Ghirardelli fudge and two kinds of ice cream. Of course I also bought a bag of assorted Ghirardelli squares to go. The second time I tried the large chocolate chip cookie. It was warm and filled with huge chocolate chips, tasting as freshly baked. Third time was waffle bowl sundae, with hot fudge and of course waffle bowl is fudge dipped as well. Had to have another one of those cookies too. This sundae was so big I nearly didn't finish all, but was worth every bite. My favorite part is how they give a free promotional flavor chocolate square at the door. Definitely recommend anyone in the area try this place for ice cream, cookies or brownies. And of course, chocolate!

Mis amigos y mi esposo me trajeron aquí hoy. Ellos ya habían estado antes. Mis amigos me dijeron que íbamos por el croissant de almendras, horneado dos veces. Y estaba increíble. Sí, claro que tenía que probarlo... y era el último. No puedo ni empezar a describir la perfección que encontré en este postre. (Mi esposo me había traído macarrones franceses de aquí antes. Y estaban deliciosos). Pero, ¡ay!, el croissant de almendras. Tendré sueños sobre el croissant de almendras. Y eso no es todo. Rebecca fue increíble, ayudándome a encontrar la bebida perfecta. Le dije: "algo con cafeína, caliente, dulce pero no demasiado". Ella respondió sin dudar: "café mocha con caramelo salado". Vale, suena genial. No, "genial" ni siquiera empieza a describir lo perfecta que era esa bebida. Cremosa, suave, perfecta. En el coche, de camino a casa (vivimos a una hora de aquí), le dije a mi esposo: "cualquier día que quieras venir aquí, solo dímelo y ya". Gracias. Gracias por existir.
original: My friends and husband brought me here today. They had all been here before. The friends said we are going for the twice baked almond croissant. And it was amazing. Yes of course I had to get one......and it was the last one. I can't even begin to describe the perfection that I found in this pastry. (My husband had brought me French macaroons from here before. And they were lovely). But my god the almond croissant. I will have dreams about the almond croissant. And that's not all. Rebecca was so amazing helping me find the perfect drink. I said, "caffeine, hot, sweet but not too sweet. " "salted caramel brownie cafÃ© mocha", she says without hesitation. Ok, sounds great. No, great doesn't even begin to describe how perfect this drink was. Milky, smooth, perfection. In the car on the way home (we live an hour away) I told my husband, anytime you want to come here. Just say so and we are on our way. Thank you. Thank you for existing.

text: Um cupcake vegano realmente delicioso! A cobertura é de coco, mas ainda é DELICIOSA! Muito macio, adoraria que tivessem mais opções veganas!
original: Really good vegan cupcake! The icing is coconut but still DELICIOUS! Very moist wish they had more vegan options!

text: Minha família inteira realmente gosta do Jack Frost, porque eles não são muito doces. Os donuts são feitos com uma massa de boa qualidade, e não apenas com ar e açúcar.
original: My whole family really likes Jack Frost because they aren't too sweet. Doughnuts are made from good dough, not just air and sugar.

text: Uma das minhas guloseimas favoritas! Tenho certeza que você também vai adorar. O pão quente com o sorvete gelado é simplesmente divino.
original: One of my favorite snacks! You'll love it too!! The warm bun with the cold ice cream is just heaven.

text: I was visiting Charlotte for my best friend's birthday weekend. We stopped in twice this weekend and I really enjoyed this bakery. The staff was nice and very helpful and patient explaining what the items were. I ended up buying a raspberry fruit tart, pistachio macarons, and their seasonal passion fruit strawberry lemonade to drink. All were really good! The tart was sweet, but not too sugary. Just enough tartness to it! I just recently started enjoying macarons and this was so fresh. The passion fruit strawberry lemonade had stronger hints of passion fruit and sparkling fruit soda, the strawberry lemonade taste was not as strong on my order. It was really great!!! I hope I can come back before I leave tomorrow night. I hope to find something similar to this bakery back home in the Philadelphia area.

Llevé al jugador a la aeropuerto y pensé que sería bueno comer algo antes de regresar a casa, y este lugar estaba casi en el camino... No hay mucho espacio entre las puertas y la vitrina de pasteles, lo cual es una excelente planificación, ¡muy conveniente para conseguir un macaron de naranja mientras decido qué comer! Según la leyenda, este es el lugar original, el hogar del estilo de los trailers provenzales, que todos conocen y aman. Un "croque monsieur" a la mitad, acompañado de sopa de tomate y hinojo y agua helada, parecía perfecto. Normalmente no soy muy fan de las sopas rojas, pero esta tiene hinojo... ¡y eso lo arregló todo, muchas gracias! Una sopa roja sabrosa, con textura y sustancia, ¡no como las sopas de la infancia! Mi sándwich fue excelente: una generosa capa de mostaza de Dijon picante complementaba la sutileza del queso gruyere en jamón en rodajas finas, todo ello dentro de un cruasán tostado, crujiente y con mantequilla. ¡Salud por un buen sándwich de jamón!
original: Took MLB to the airport and figured I could use a meal before heading home and this was almost nearly on the way... Not much space between the doors and the pastry case which is great planning in my book; way convenient to get an orange macaron while deciding on snacks. According to legend this is ground zero, the home of the provencal trailer park motif seen and loved by all. Half a Croque Monsieur plus tomato fennel soup and icy water sounded about right. Usually not a fan of the red soup but it's got fennel...! which fixed everything up nicely thank you very much. Hot vermilion soup abounding with flavor, texture, and substance - not the feeble stuff of childhood. My sandwich was superb! a healthy smear of spicy dijon zip complementing the subtle dignity of gruyere on thin sliced hams nestled in a flakey buttery toasted croissant. Yea for a ham sammich!

text: When we go to West Side Market, we have to visit this place. Located right in the middle of it, makes one of the best crepes around, made fresh right in front of you. Asked them to give extra Nutella for my son and they happily obliged. My wife went for the basic crepe, well done, and it was very good as well.

Este local está localizado no hotel Cosmopolitan. Na minha primeira visita, pedi a torta de biscoito, e quando voltei para o hotel, percebi que estava derretida dentro do papel alumínio e da caixa, e estava bem mole. Não consegui aproveitar, mesmo depois de tentar colocá-la na geladeira e comer mais tarde. Na segunda visita, pedi um biscoito de marshmallow de milho. Estava muito doce, e eu esperava que fosse uma experiência interessante em termos de textura, mas acabou sendo decepcionante. Preciso voltar para experimentar outros itens e dar uma avaliação mais completa.
original: This is located in the Cosmopolitan hotel. I ordered the crack pie the first visit and when I got back to my hotel it was greasing through the wax paper and box and was quite melted. I didn't get to enjoy this, even after I tried to put it in the fridge and eat it later. The 2nd visit I got a cornflake marshmallow cookie. It was overly sweet and I thought it would be a textural mindblow, but it was quite underwhelming. I have to return to try more items to give this a real review....

text: Acabo de comprar una tanda de croissants de chocolate... ¡Aunque son la versión pequeña, son enormes! Y son deliciosos y muy bonitos. Todo lo que he probado aquí ha sido excelente.
original: Just picked up a batch of chocolate croissant... For being the mini version, these things are huge! And they are amazing tasting and gorgeous. Everything I've tasted from here has been delightful.

text: Entramos no Churn quando vimos um sorvete de bolo de cenoura que eles estavam divulgando. Precisávamos experimentar e não nos arrependemos. Um lugar muito charmoso, com atendimento atencioso. Esse sabor específico está disponível apenas em abril, mas eles também oferecem outros sabores sazonais, além de um cardápio regular de sorvetes. Também têm muitos doces retrô!
original: Stopped into Churn when we saw a carrot cake ice cream that they posted about. Just had to have it and not disappointed. Such a cute place with friendly service. This is only available for the month of April, but they bring in other seasonal flavors along with a regular menu of ice cream. Lots of retro candy too!

text:
Base para minhas avaliações com estrelas (que se concentram principalmente na comida ou bebida):

1 estrela: Nunca mais.
2 estrelas: Comida e experiência ruins, medidas extraordinárias para que eu voltasse.
3 estrelas: Regular, nada muito especial, nada particularmente ruim.
4 estrelas: Muito bom, definitivamente voltaria.
5 estrelas: Um favorito, um dos melhores. Apenas uma atualização após um longo período. Ainda um dos melhores lugares para comer sorvete no país. Ainda oferece combinações de sabores originais e interessantes, sem exageros ou ser excessivamente experimental como outros lugares. Sem truques, apenas sorvete de qualidade. Desta vez, experimentei o sabor de pêssego e creme. A beleza está na simplicidade. Sorvete de creme doce com pedaços de pêssego. O creme doce tinha o sabor do leite que eu comi na França. Rico, doce e realmente parecia leite. Era cremoso, indulgente, até. Os pedaços de pêssego estavam um pouco pequenos, mas ainda adicionaram sabor e um leve contraste ácido ao creme doce.
original: Basis for my starred ratings (which skews heavily to the food or drink): 1 star: Never again. 2 stars: Poor food, poor experience, extraordinary measures in order for me to come back. 3 stars: Average, nothing really special, nothing particularly bad. 4 stars: Very good, would definitely return. 5 stars: A favorite, one of the best. Just an update review after a long while. Still one of the best ice cream places in the country. Still do original and interesting flavor combinations without going overboard or too experimental like some other ice cream places. No gimmicks here, just quality ice cream. This time had the peaches and cream. Beauty in simplicity. Sweet cream ice cream with chunks of peaches. The sweet cream base tasted like the milk I had in France. Rich, sweet, and actually tasting like dairy. It is unctuous, decadent, even.
