The chunks of peaches were a biiiiit undersized, but still added flavor and a slightly tart counterbalance to the sweet cream.

text: Viajei de Texas para trabalhar e encontrei esta recomendação. Sem dúvida, é o sorvete mais delicioso que já experimentei. Na primeira vez, experimentei o red velvet e o "Cookie Monster". Na segunda vez, levei um colega de trabalho e os donos me reconheceram! Experimentei o baklava e o "Cookie Monster". Um lugar excelente e sorvetes ótimos. Normalmente não escrevo avaliações, mas esses caras merecem!!!
original: Came from Texas for work and found this suggestion. This is hands down the best ice cream I've ever had. First time I had the red velvet and cookie monster. Second time I took my coworker and the owners remembered me! I had the baklava and cookie monster. Great place and great ice cream. Don't usually give reviews, but these guys deserve it!!!

text: Como es obvio, el helado es increíble. La razón principal por la que le he dado una estrella es que la "gestión/propietarios" tratan a sus empleados de manera completamente poco profesional. Por ejemplo, he visto a empleados regañados por "llenar los boles demasiado". En cuanto al precio, las porciones no son proporcionales a lo que se paga. Le recomiendo que vaya a Whole Foods; allí tienen el mismo helado, pero sin la falta de profesionalidad y con porciones más generosas.
original: Needless to say, the ice cream is amazing!! The reason as to why I gave it one star primarily deals with the fact that the "management/ownership" treat their employees in a completely unprofessional manner. For example, on multiple occasions, I have seen employees scolded for "over-scooping." With regards to the price, the portions are not proportional to what you pay. I suggest you go to Whole Foods; they have the same ice cream without the lack of professionalism and skimpy portions.

text: I wouldn't say I'm an ice cream connoisseur... but I also wouldn't say I'm not one. With that in mind, believe me when I say Churn is always a great choice for dessert. Their ice cream is delectable. The strawberry shortcake sundae is unbelievable. The cookies tho, that's where the money's at. The salted chocolate chip cookie is legitimately one of the best cookies I have ever consumed. Minus 1 star bc I wish the flavors were a little more fun and flirty, but you can't beat the classics so I get it.

En cuanto a helados, este lugar es bastante normal. Los sabores no tienen muchos ingredientes adicionales como los que se encuentran en un helado de Ben & Jerry's. Tampoco hay muchas opciones de cobertura. Tres estrellas simplemente por ser normal, pero una estrella menos por su política de uso de mascarillas. En mi opinión, exigir el uso de mascarillas en una heladería es ridículo.
original: As far as ice cream goes, this place is pretty average. The flavors don't have a lot of mix-ins like you might find in a pint of Ben & Jerry's. Not many toppings either. Three stars for just being average, with one more star knocked off for their mask policy. Enforcing a mask policy at an ice cream parlor is, in my opinion, laughable.

text: Hands down the best ice cream ever! It's a good thing that their Horchata ice cream is a seasonal flavor otherwise I'd be eating it daily!

Era mi cumpleaños y mi esposo me compró un batido de cumpleaños con helado y alcohol. No soy muy fan de los pasteles, así que este batido fue perfecto como sustituto de mi pastel de cumpleaños. El sabor era realmente bueno, pero el vodka era demasiado fuerte porque el batido tenía una consistencia muy líquida. Necesitaba ser más espeso para considerarse un batido. Parecía más bien un cóctel de leche. En general, este batido era encantador, con los chispas encima, y exactamente lo que quería.
original: It was my birthday and my husband bought me a birthday cake milk shake with booze in it. I am not a huge cake fan, so this was perfect for my birthday cake substitution. The flavor was really good, but the vodka was so strong because the shake consistency was so liquidity. It needed to be thicker to be considered a shake. It just seemed like a milky cocktail. Other than that, this drink was cute with the sprinkles on top and just what I wanted.

text: Amelie's era aceptable, pero en mi opinión, no valía la pena el precio ni la espera en la cola. Fui con mi novia, su madre y mi madre, y pudimos probar varios pasteles diferentes. El brownie de caramelo salado estaba bueno. Realmente me gustó el brownie, y la cobertura de caramelo era aceptable, aunque no era exactamente lo que buscaba. Sin embargo, por 2,50 dólares, esperaría algo más que el pequeño brownie de 1 onza. Los eclairs también estaban bien. No me gustó mucho la parte del pastel, pero los cremas de vainilla y chocolate eran bastante sabrosas. Mi novia y su madre estaban decepcionadas de que el relleno fuera crema, en lugar de nata, pero las disfrutaron de todos modos. Probé un trozo de pastel de chocolate y también estaba bastante bien, pero no valía 5 dólares por un trozo del tamaño de un cupcake. Después de esperar 10 minutos en la cola (era un sábado por la noche, y eso es justo), y al ver los precios muy elevados para las porciones, asumí que estos postres debían ser increíbles, pero todos en mi grupo coincidieron en que eran simplemente aceptables, y nada más.
original: Amelie's was decent but not worth the price or wait in line in my opinion. I went with my girlfriend, her mom, and my mom and was able to try a few different pastries. The salted caramel brownie was good. I really liked the brownie, and the caramel topping was okay although not really my thing. For $2.50 though, I would expect more than the tiny 1 oz brownie you get. The eclairs were decent too. I didn't really like the pastry part, but the vanilla and chocolate custards were both pretty tasty. My girlfriend and her mom were both disappointed that it was a custard filling rather than cream but enjoyed them nonetheless. I had one bite of a piece of chocolate cake and it was pretty good as well, but not anything worth $5 for a cupcake sized piece. After waiting in line for 10 minutes (it was Saturday evening, I'll give them that) and seeing the really high prices for the portions, I assumed these desserts must be heaven, but everyone in my group agreed they were just decent and nothing more.

text: LOVE this delightful little place except on Friday & Saturday nights!! - SO busy but still worth it. ;)

Esta é a minha padaria favorita de todos os tempos (e eu já experimentei muitas!). Acho que a grande quantidade de pessoas em todos os horários do dia é a prova de que este lugar é incrível! Quando entrei pela primeira vez, fiquei impressionado e minhas glândulas salivares entraram em ação ao ver a longa vitrine de doces. Todos eram lindos e, obviamente, feitos com arte por pessoas que sabem o que estão fazendo. Se você não encontrasse um doce aqui para satisfazer completamente seus sentidos visuais e gustativos, talvez haja algo errado com você. Além disso, o ambiente eclético é muito acolhedor e certamente fará você se sentir como se tivesse viajado para Paris. Mas não se engane, não são apenas os doces que fazem as pessoas voltarem para a Amelie's, a comida em si também é deliciosa! Experimentei a torta de presunto e queijo e a sopa de batata doce. A torta tinha a quantidade perfeita de queijo de excelente qualidade e o pão que a sustentava era crocante e saboroso. Também é uma porção perfeita e não é muito cara. A sopa era muito cremosa e tinha um equilíbrio perfeito de sabores. Adoro batata doce e acho que eles acertaram na versão desta sopa. É perfeita para um dia frio! Experimentei o éclair de baunilha e uma mini torta de frutas variadas. A torta tinha o tamanho perfeito e havia tantas variedades que todas pareciam perfeitas e frescas. A crosta não era muito doce, mas perfeita para complementar o recheio de creme e as frutas frescas por cima. O éclair de chocolate era muito grande e não tinha a forma de outros que já experimentei. No entanto, o creme era delicioso e havia bastante! Você também pode pedir um éclair personalizado para o Dia dos Namorados, o que posso solicitar no próximo ano. Ouvi dizer que o brownie de caramelo salgado é incrível, e com certeza farei a viagem em breve para experimentar isso e alguns outros doces! Espero me tornar uma apreciadora da Amelie's!
original: This is my favorite bakery of all time (and I have tried many!). I think that the constant crowd at all hours of the day is proof that this place is amazing! When I first walked in, my eyes almost glazed over and my salivary glands kicked into overdrive at the sight of the very long glass display case of pastries. They were all beautiful and obviously artfully made by people that know what they are doing. If you couldn't find a pastry here to completely satisfy your visual and gustatory senses, there might just be something wrong with you. Also, the eclectic feel is very welcoming and sure to make you feel like have teleported to Paris. But don't be fooled, it isn't just the pastries that have people coming back to Amelie's, the actual food is to die for too! I have tried the ham and gruyere tartine and the sweet potato soup. The tartine had the perfect amount of very good quality cheese and the baguette that supported it was crispy but delicious. It is also a perfect portion and not very expensive. The soup was very smooth and had a perfect balance of flavors. I love sweet potatoes and I think they nailed this variation of sweet potato soup. It is perfect for a cold day! I tried the vanilla eclair and an assorted fruit mini tart. The tart was the perfect size and there were so many varieties that all looked picture perfect and fresh. The crust was not too sweet but perfect to compliment the custard interior and the fresh fruit on top. The chocolate eclair was very large and not quite the shape of others I have had before. However, the custard was delicious and there was lots of it! You can even have an eclair customized for Valentine's Day which I might be requesting next year. I have heard that the salted caramel brownie is out of this world from all of my friends and I will definitely be making the trip soon to try this and a few more of their pastries! I hope to become an Amelie's connoisseur!

text: Los macarons eran bastante estándar, y de precio elevado, a menos que se compre un paquete de 5 unidades. Les daría 4 estrellas, pero la primera vez que intentamos ir allí, fue una pesadilla. Preguntamos a dos empleados de Venecia dónde estaba; uno nos dio indicaciones para "la más cercana" y dijo que había tres ubicaciones, mientras que el otro dijo que solo había una y nos indicó la que estaba debajo de las escaleras, cerca de Grand Lux. Llegamos a esa ubicación 7 minutos antes de las 9 (hora de cierre) y el lugar estaba vacío. Por suerte, llegamos a la que daba a la Strip unos 3 minutos después, y también estaba cerrada. Esa ubicación también abrió más tarde la mañana siguiente cuando volvimos, y hubiera preferido no ir en absoluto, si no fuera porque realmente quería los macarons antes de mi vuelo de regreso. Por otro lado, no había ninguna cola y realmente me gustó el empaque del paquete de 5 para el avión.
original: The macarons were pretty standard, and on the pricey side unless you get a 5 pack. Would give them 4 stars, but the first time we tried to go there, it was an absolute nightmare. We asked two Venetian employees where it was; one gave directions to the "closest one" and said there were three locations, the other said there was only one location and directed us to the one under the escalators by the Grand Lux. We arrived at that location 7 minutes before 9 (closing time) and the place was abandoned. We made it to the one facing the Strip about 3 minutes later just by chance and it was also closed. That location also opened late the next morning when we went back and I would have foregone the entire thing had I not wanted macarons so badly before my flight home. On the plus side, there was no line at all and I really liked the packaging of the 5-pack for the airplane.

text: ¡La verdad, estaba súper emocionado de probar una galleta con chispas de chocolate de Thomas Keller. Se supone que son las MEJORES. Estaban buenas. Simplemente buenas. No eran mejores ni peores que una galleta de Starbucks. Estoy bastante decepcionado. Pero son grandes, están rellenas de chocolate y siguen siendo galletas, así que... ***/*****
original: Man, I was super pumped to eat a Thomas Keller chocolate chip cookie. They're supposed to be THE BEST. It was good. Just good. It wasn't any better or worse than a cookie from Starbucks. I'm pretty disappointed. But they're big and chocolatey and still cookies so... ***/*****

text: Alrededor de la época de Acción de Gracias de 2019, llamé para pedir un pastel de zanahoria y este lugar apareció en mi radar. No pregunté y asumí que tenían pasteles de zanahoria disponibles ese día. Cuando llegué, me dijeron que era un producto de fin de semana, pero disponible los días laborables si se reservaba con antelación. Uno de los miembros del personal me ayudó y preparó uno para mí. Me indicó que volviera más tarde. Estaba encantado. El pastel de zanahoria fue muy apreciado por la persona que lo iba a recibir, y a todos les encantó. Hay una capa de chocolate blanco que atraviesa el centro del pastel y le da un toque crujiente. ¡Fue increíble en textura y sabor! Diría que la tartaleta de langosta estaba un poco seca, pero eso no me impidió comprar más en el futuro. Unos días después, fuimos a tomar un café y postre. Todos los postres eran de la misma calidad que el pastel de zanahoria. Todos estuvieron de acuerdo en que el café no era exactamente el mejor. Seguiré volviendo por sus postres, pero probablemente compraré mi café en otro lugar. Hay aparcamiento en la calle.
original: Back around Thanksgiving 2019 I called around for a carrot cake and this place popped up on my radar. What I didn't ask and assumed was that they had carrot cakes available the day of. When i arrived, i was told it's a weekend item and available on weekdays if you call ahead. One of the team members did me a solid and whipped one up for me. Instructed me to come back later. I was more than happy. The carrot cake was well received by the birthday person and everyone loved it. There's a white chocolate sheet that runs through the middle of the cake and gives it a crunch. That was amazing in texture and flavor. I would say the lobster tail pastry was just a tad stale but nothing to stop me from buying more in the future. A few days later we stopped in for coffee and dessert. All the desserts were on par to the quality of the carrot cake. It was unanimous the coffees were not exactly the best. I'll keep coming back for their dessert but probably get my coffee fix elsewhere. It's street parking.

text: Este es un lugar ideal para familias para disfrutar de un helado o incluso un buen lugar para una cita y dar un paseo por el paseo marítimo. Pedí un batido de bizcocho de fresas. Me hubiera encantado que realmente contuviera trozos de cheesecake, pero aparte de eso, estaba excelente. También sería genial si pudieran poner música y añadir un poco más de decoración.
original: This is a great family spot to grab some ice cream or even a great spot for a little date and walk around the boardwalk. I ordered the strawberry shortcake milkshake . I would have loved for it to actually have cheesecake pieces in it but other than that it was great. It would also be great if they were to play music and also include a little more decor .

text: The French Toast ice cream was EXTREMELY salty to the point where a few bites in could give you hypertension. We also tried the Birthday Cake Milkshake that was also bad. It seemed like the milk or cream had gone bad. On top of that it's odd that an ice cream place in a casino wouldn't offer tap or iced water.

Valor: ***** Macarrones: ***** Servicio: (estábamos tan disfrutando que ni siquiera nos preocupamos) ***** Fui a Bouchon Bakery por primera vez hace 7 años durante una visita a Manhattan y me enamoré de sus macarrones. Cada visita a Manhattan requiere una parada en Bouchon. Estaba emocionado de ver que tienen una ubicación en Las Vegas, así que cuando planeamos un viaje a Las Vegas, nos aseguramos de estar cerca de Bouchon. ¡Nos encantó que estuviera en el Venetian, donde nos alojábamos! He visitado muchas otras panaderías y he probado muchos macarrones, pero, en mi opinión, ninguno se acerca a Bouchon Bakery. Ahora, esto puede ser una cuestión de opinión, ya que yo no soy un chef de pastelería, pero los sabores del vainilla, el caramelo y la almendra (mis favoritos) son excepcionales, pero no demasiado dulces. La galleta es suave y masticable, con una ligera capa dura. Pero es el sabor de los macarrones lo que me impresiona, y los suyos son el doble de grandes que los de otras panaderías. Y, a $3.50 cada uno, creo que es una excelente relación calidad-precio. Nos detuvimos todos los días de nuestro viaje para comprar macarrones. Espero visitar otras ubicaciones, como Yountville. ¡Macarrones y vino! Para los amantes del dulce, este es un lugar imprescindible, que hay que visitar y experimentar.
original: Value: ***** Macaroons: ***** Service: (we were indulging to even care) ***** I was introduced to Bouchon Bakery 7 years on a visit to Manhattan and fell in love with their macaroons. Every visit to Manhattan requires a stop at Bouchon. I was excited to see they have a location in Vegas so when we planned a trip to Vegas, we had to make sure we were close to Bouchon. We loved the fact it was in the Venitian where we were staying! I have visited many other bakeries and consumed many macaroons and none in my opinion even comes close to Bouchon Bakery. Now this may be a matter of opinion as I am not a pastry chef but the flavors of vanilla, caramel and pistachio (my favorites) are outstanding but not over the top sweet. The biscuit is soft and chewy and a slight hard coating. But it's the flavor of the macaroons that astounds me, and theirs are twice the size of other bakeries. And for $3.50 each, I feel it is an outstanding value. We stopped every day of our trip here to get macaroons. I look forward to visiting other locations such as Yountville! Macaroons and wine! For the sweet tooth, this is a must stop, must visit, must experience!

text: Sus macarons son fantásticos: recomiendo especialmente los de frambuesa. Fueron los mejores macarons que he probado en Las Vegas (y los he probado en unas cuatro tiendas diferentes).
original: Their macarons are fantastic - I highly recommend the raspberry. These were the best macaroons I had in Vegas (and I tried them at about four places).

text: Not a place you stumble on by accident. It's tucked away. But so worth the effort ! Delicious ice cream. Be sure to do yourself a favor and get it in the warm doughnut ! Wasn't planning on it but when the owner described it I thought why not I'm here. Glad I did. We will be back next time we are in town .
Each individual donut is an edible work of art... ALMOST as good to look at as they are to eat (ALMOST)! Fair prices, cite place, friendly welcoming staff... It's a winner!

839 avaliações de 5 estrelas... vale a pena conferir. Tornando-se 840! Vimos muitas avaliações mencionando o Brandon, mas o Travis (seu irmão) nos apresentou a todos os seus deliciosos sabores. Venha experimentar um sorvete, e leve o seu cachorro!
original: 839 5-star reviews... gotta check it out. Make that 840! We saw tons of reviews mentioning Brandon, but Travis (his brother) hooked us up with tastes of all their delicious flavors. Come get some ice cream, and bring the dog!

text: Gran variedad de donuts. Llegue antes de las 10 de la mañana para encontrar la mejor selección. También puede hacer un pedido anticipado el día anterior para recogerlo al día siguiente. Donuts que he probado: Crème brûlée - Es vegano, pero yo no lo soy, y estaba delicioso. Chocolate mexicano - contiene una especia de pimienta; diferente y sabroso. Snickers - no hace falta decir nada más. Cheesecake de fresa - una excelente versión del clásico donut de mermelada.
original: Great selection of donuts. Get there before 10am for best selection. You can also pre-order the day before for next-day pick-up. Donuts I've had: Creme Brulee - It's vegan, but I'm not, and it was good. Mexican Hot Chocolate - has a cayenne spice in it's chocolate; different and good. Snickers - say no more Strawberry Cheescake - great take on traditional jelly donut

text: Certo, então, duas semanas depois, quase todas as suas bolachas acabaram? Hoje, eles só tinham bolachas de chocolate e milho... Embora eu soubesse que era improvável que eles fizessem as bolachas no local (elas estão todas embaladas), o fato de terem esgotado as mercadorias confirma isso. Espero que consigam organizar o fornecimento. Eles estão perdendo muitas vendas.
original: Okay, so two weeks later almost all their cookies are sold out? Today they only had Chocolate Chocolate and Corn Cookies... While I knew it was wishful thinking to think they made the cookies onsite (they are all packaged), selling out confirms it. I hope they get their supply figured out. They are missing out on a lot of business.

text: Este lugar estava movimentado e o atendimento foi bom. A pessoa que nos atendeu era muito eficiente e experiente. Ela conhecia bem os produtos e sabia como vendê-los. Levamos nossas compras para o quarto. Tudo estava excelente. Os preços dos produtos estão em linha com os preços dos estabelecimentos próximos ao hotel e das padarias. Eu voltaria com certeza.
original: This place was busy and the service was good, our counter person was good at what he does. He knows the product and how to sell it. We took our goodies back to our room. Everything I had was excellent. The items price wise are in line with the hotels on the strip pastry shops. I would go back again.

text: Bomb AF. ¡Prueba un batido con helado de vainilla, café con leche y frambuesa con chocolate blanco!
original: Bomb AF. Try a milkshake with vanilla bean, mocha java, and white chocolate raspberry ice creams!!

text: Estoy visitando la zona de Phoenix para ver la pretemporada de los Dodgers con mi hija. Decidimos parar a tomar un helado en el camino de regreso al hotel. Ella buscó en Yelp y encontró Novel, y tuvimos mucha suerte de haberlo encontrado. En primer lugar, es una tienda muy encantadora con un amplio patio cubierto con mesas y sillas. Es más grande de lo que parecía. En segundo lugar, había muchos sabores únicos para elegir, y los dueños nos animaron a probarlos todos. Sabía lo que quería después del segundo bocado: "Tangerine Dream". Mi hija eligió "Panna Cherry". Ambos estaban deliciosos. En tercer lugar, los dueños fueron muy amables y charlamos con ellos mientras esperábamos nuestro helado. Nos sorprendió que solo estuvieran abiertos hace 10 días. Celebrarían su gran inauguración en dos días y estaban muy contentos con los resultados de su "pre-apertura". Tienen todo lo necesario para tener éxito. Les deseamos lo mejor.
original: I'm visiting the Phoenix area for Dodgers Spring Training with my daughter. We decided to stop for ice cream on the way back to the hotel. She Yelped and found Novel, and were very lucky that she did. First, it's a very cute store with a large covered patio with tables and chairs attached. It's larger than the store. Secondly there were many unique flavors to choose from and the owners were encouraging to try them all. I knew what I wanted after the second taste - Tangerine Dream. My daughter decided on Panna Cherry. They were both delicious. Thirdly, the owners were super friendly and we chatted with them while waiting for our ice cream. We were surprised that they had only been open 10 days!! They were going to have their Grand Opening in two days and very pleased with the results of their "soft" opening. They have what it takes to be successful. We wish them all the best!!

text: Very much craft ice cream with some very unique flavors. I enjoyed it, but there is a lot going on, maybe too much in the flavors. Biggest pros were the fresh waffle cones (although they were very buttery) and the very friendly employees who had a well prepared statement about each flavor and made them all sound delicious. Biggest cons were, well the ice cream itself. Some of the flavors kind of gave me a food truck "we are trying really hard to be extremely unique" kind of vibe. Bangkok peanut ice cream is actually very spicy with a strong cayenne flavor. The sweet corn with blackberry tasted exactly how it sounds. I am definitely a fan of the brown butter almond brittle but a whole scoop of it is just too much. All in all, I would go back but I wouldn't seek it out or go out of my way, I certainly wouldn't wait in a line for 30 minutes again.
Never a bad experience here! Love this place because of their mind blowing donuts!! I definitely recommend going right before they open because they do sell out pretty fast!

Visitei o Amelie's na noite passada. Fazia um tempo desde que não ia, e adorei as mudanças. Tem um ambiente muito aconchegante, diferentes níveis para sentar e um bar agradável que serve cerveja e vinho. Definitivamente, é muito mais do que apenas uma padaria!
original: Visited Amelie's the other night. Hadn't been there in awhile and loved the changes. Great cozy atmosphere, different levels to sit and a nice bar serving beer and wine. Much more than just a bakery for sure!

text: The Ohio City store is so much fun to eat at and watch them make ice cream. They have fantastic ice cream.
Precisava de um bolo de última hora para celebrar o aniversário de um amigo, e a Milk Bar não decepcionou! O atendimento ao cliente é excelente neste local. Todos adoraram o bolo.
original: I needed a cake last minute to celebrate a friend's birthday and Milk Bar did not disappoint! Customer service is amazing at this location. Everyone enjoyed the cake.

text: O "Dichotomy Popcorn" é tudo o que você precisa saber. Os chocolates e os cupcakes também são deliciosos, mas o "Dichotomy Popcorn" é o que vai me fazer continuar a amar a Campbell's para sempre. E concordo totalmente com a pessoa que disse que a legalização da cannabis em Ohio deve ser acompanhada pela abertura de várias lojas da Campbell's na cidade.
original: Dichotomy Popcorn is the only thing you need to know. The chocolates and cupcakes re delicious as well, but the dichotomy popcorn is the thing that will keep me loving Campbell's forever. And I totally Agree with the person who said that legalization of cannabis in Ohio should be followed closely by the opening of several Campbell's stores around the city.

text: Um lugar confuso para quem está pela primeira vez. Entrei por volta das 7h30 e havia um fluxo constante de clientes, que pareciam ser frequentadores. É definitivamente um ambiente agradável para sentar e ler, ou passar algum tempo trabalhando, longe do escritório. A equipe não era acolhedora ou amigável, mas sim pretensiosa e snob. Apesar disso, ainda pedi uma fatia de quiche e duas macarons, que custaram um pouco mais de 10 dólares. As macarons estavam deliciosas, mas a quiche era bastante simples.
original: Confusing place for a 1st timer. I went in a little after 7:30 and it had a steady flow of customers that seemed to be regulars. It is a nice atmosphere for sure to sit and read or spend some time working away from the office. The staff was not welcoming or warm but rather snobby and pretentious. Having said that I still ordered a slice of quiche and 2 macaroons which was a little over $10. The macaroons were delicious but the quiche was very plain.

text: É claro que tínhamos que ir lá, já que sou fã de "Cake Boss" e companhia. Mas, sem dúvidas, eles fazem um trabalho excelente! Fomos lá 3 dos 4 dias em Las Vegas, e tudo estava delicioso! Eles combinam perfeitamente os sabores salgados e doces. Experimentamos um pastel tipo croissant com espinafre e queijo feta, um camarão caramelizado e um croissant de chocolate. Tudo estava incrivelmente saboroso e memorável, para dizer o mínimo. A equipe é extremamente atenciosa e simpática! Voltaremos quando voltarmos a Las Vegas!
original: We had to go her for our pasties of course, being a fan of Cake Boss and all. Well needless to say they do a wonderful job!!! We went 3 out of 4 days of being in Vegas, yummy all the way!! They do it right savory and sweet, we got a spinach feta croissant type pastry, caramel lobster tail, and chocolate croissant. Everything was so delicious and very memorable to say the least. The staff extremely knowledgeable and kind!! We will be back when we go back to Vegas!!

text: Adoro este lugar, não tenho palavras para descrever! A equipe é muito simpática, o local é limpo e os donuts são incríveis. Recomendo muito que você venha e experimente um.
original: Love this place can't say enough about it friendly staff clean location Donuts amazing highly recommend you should stop in and try a donut

text: El "Donut de Hunter S. Thompson" en conmemoración del aniversario de la publicación de su libro sobre Las Vegas en la revista Rolling Stone de Hunter en noviembre de 1971 ("Fear and Loathing in Las Vegas") fue elaborado en Donut Bar, ya que este establecimiento es conocido por hacer los donuts más creativos de Las Vegas, Nevada. Además, los padres suelen apreciar este tipo de iniciativas, ya que los niños reciben donuts gratis los sábados y domingos, antes de ir al parque.
original: The Hunter S. Thompson Donut for the anniversary of Hunter's Rolling Stone Magazine publication in November 1971 of his Vegas book, Fear and Loathing in Las Vegas - The Hunter donut was made at Donut Bar, because donut bar makes the most creative donuts in Las Vegas, Nevada. Plus parents love the leaders, because children are given free donuts on Saturday and Sunday, before they play at the park.

text: No se van a decepcionar. El plato de Napoleón es excelente, y el "tail" de langosta es enorme y delicioso. El dueño es de Teaneck, Nueva Jersey, así que entiende lo que significa la satisfacción del cliente.
original: You will not be disappointed. Napoleon is fantastic, lobster tail is awesome and huge! The owner is from Teaneck, NJ, my neck of the woods so he understands customer satisfaction.

text: Si te encanta el crème brûlée, corre a Sprinkles antes del 31 de julio para probar su helado de temporada. Esta fue la segunda vez que probé el helado de Sprinkles. Decidí probar uno de sus cupcakes, así como un helado esta vez. Quería probar su helado de Cap n Crunch, pero descubrí que su sabor de temporada era crème brûlée. No pude resistirme. Pedí un helado con un cupcake, donde eliges un cupcake y lo cortan por la mitad para poner una bola de helado entre las dos mitades. ¡Delicioso! También probé el pastel de vainilla con glaseado de chocolate y chispas. Mi novio pidió el helado de Cap n Crunch y café en un cono de waffle rojo. Todo estaba muy rico. Los precios no eran excesivos, considerando que están en la zona turística. Normalmente hay que esperar un poco, así que tenlo en cuenta. Si no quieres esperar, siempre puedes ir a la parte lateral y usar su máquina de cupcakes. Es una experiencia divertida. Es un lugar pequeño y acogedor. El personal es amable y puedes probar diferentes sabores de helado. Todo es bastante dulce, pero de una forma agradable. Quizás quieras pedir una bebida para acompañar los cupcakes, ya que tienen una buena cantidad de glaseado.
original: If you love creme brulee, then run to Sprinkles before July 31 for their seasonal ice cream. This was the second time that ice had Sprinkles. I decided I was going to try one of their cupcakes as well as some ice cream this time. I was going to get their Cap n Crunch ice cream, until I saw that their seasonal flavor was creme brulee. I couldn't pass that up. I got the ice cream sundae where you pick out a cupcake and they cut it in half and put a scoop of ice cream in between. Delicious! I tried the vanilla cake with chocolate frosting and sprinkles. My boyfriend got the Cap n Crunch and coffee ice cream in a red velvet waffle cone. Everything was really good. Prices weren't too bad, considering they're on the strip. There's usually a long wait so be prepared for that. If you don't want to wait, you can always go around to the side and use their cupcake atm. That's a fun experience. It's a cute little place. The staff is nice and you can get samples of the ice cream. Everything is pretty sweet, but not in a bad way. You may want to get a drink to go with the cupcakes since they have a generous amount of icing on them.

text:
ATUALIZAÇÃO: Visitei a Milk Bar novamente e tive uma experiência melhor. Ainda parece um pouco caro, mas desta vez experimentei o sorvete de "crack pie" com crocantes de milho, e estava realmente delicioso!! Também provei o sorvete de leite com cereal. Definitivamente, era diferente do que experimentei antes. O sabor estava muito melhor!

Eu estava realmente animado para experimentar isso. Assisti ao episódio da "Chef's Table" sobre este lugar e achei que parecia muito bom. Infelizmente, não correspondeu às expectativas. O sorvete de leite com cereal estava muito "forte" em sabor, se isso faz sentido. Acho que deveria ser mais sutil. Essa foi a maior decepção. Eu não gostei muito. Além disso, eu realmente gostei do "crack pie" e voltamos para experimentar outro dia. Estou desapontado com os preços tão altos. 6 dólares por um sorvete pequeno? 6,50 dólares por uma fatia de "crack pie"? Eu faço bolos em casa e sei que esses ingredientes não são caros nem difíceis de preparar. Os preços precisam ser reduzidos.
original: UPDATE: I visited Milk bar again and had a better experience. It still seems too expensive but I had the crack pie soft serve with corn flake crunchies this time and it was really yummy!! I also sampled the cereal milk soft serve. It was definitely different than last time. Tasted a lot better! ---- I was really excited to try this. I have watched the chef's table episode about this place and thought it looked so good. Unfortunately it just didn't live up to the hype. The cereal milk soft serve was too cereal-y if that makes sense. I think it should be more subtle. This was the biggest disappointment. I didn't like it very much. Besides that, I DID really like the crack pie and we went back for another the next day. I'm bummed their prices are so high. $6 for a small soft serve? $6.50 for one slice of crack pie? I bake and I know these ingredients are not pricey or extremely difficult to make. The prices need to come down.

text: Lugar agradable. Buena comida. Servicio realmente malo. Hemos estado aquí unas 6-8 veces, y nunca hemos experimentado un servicio decente. Seguimos volviendo, porque realmente nos gusta el ambiente y la comida, pero creo que ya no vamos a darles más oportunidades. Los empleados detrás de la barra parecen estar completamente descontentos con su trabajo, y su trato con los clientes refleja eso. Durante nuestra última visita, salí después de esperar 5 minutos en la barra para pedir un refresco... y había 2 personas trabajando en esa área sin ningún otro cliente. Simplemente estaban completamente ajenos a la situación.
original: Cool place. Good food. Really bad service. We've been here 6 - 8 times, and we've never experienced even decent service. We keep going back, because we really like the atmosphere and the food - but I think we're done giving it more chances. The employees behind the counter all seem completely miserable to be working there, and attitudes towards customers reflect that. During our most recent visit, I walked out after standing and waiting at the drink counter for 5 minutes for a drink refill ... and there were 2 people working this area with no other customers. They were just completely oblivious.

text: My favorite little treat in Phoenix! Incredibly decadent ice creams, (but, still appropriate for the kiddies) , Shave Ice, and fun specially items. The sweetest part is the STAFF, who all treat us like family every time we stop by!

Got CRACK? I stopped by Milk Bar this evening before dinner because I enjoy my "dessert FIRST"... Awkward?! I dig the bakeries store front it's pretty hip and kind of reminds me of a food truck vibe. I ordered (2) corn cookies and (2) quakes CRACK PIE & BIRTHDAY CAKE for a total about $29 bucks. The corn cookies were amazing and full of flavor. I enjoyed the buttery cornbread tamale-like taste!Worth $3 bucks and definitely a must order. The Crack Pie Quake was sweet and delicious! Highly recommended if your a sweets junkie like myself. I was extremely disappointed in the Birthday cake quake. It was bland/flavorless I'm curious if an ingredient was skipped!! Considering the fresh products and local dairy used the pricing is decent. Regrettably, most people are use to Jack N The Box pricing which is pretty harsh to compare to an award winning pastry chefs recipes. My one gripe is it took exactly 15 minutes to prepare my two quakes with three employees on staff (I was the only person in line by the way). Two of the girls appeared very unsure of the ingredients. I witnessed a few people walking away because of the obnoxiously long wait without even being acknowledged. I'm likely to return I have a few more cookies with my name on them!!!
Os donuts são bons, mas não posso afirmar que são os melhores do mundo, como afirmam. A equipe é enérgica e atenciosa.
original: Good donuts, but I can't say that they are the best in the world, as they claim. The staff is energetic and personable.

text: ¿Bacon cubierto de chocolate a pocos pasos de mi oficina? ¡Increíble! Gran variedad de opciones y una gran selección de bolitas de pastel. Me encanta este lugar y se ha convertido en mi lugar favorito para disfrutar los viernes.
original: Chocolate covered bacon within steps of my office? Woohoo! Lots of selection and a myriad of cake balls. I dig this spot and its become my Friday treat spot.

text: Fue elegido "Lo mejor de Cleveland" por una razón. Aunque no he ido personalmente a la panadería, alguien trajo estos donuts al trabajo y ¡son una delicia! Estos donuts son lo suficientemente densos como para soportar los increíbles ingredientes. No voy a mentir, los probé varios y ¡definitivamente valieron la pena!
original: Voted 'Best of Cleveland' for a reason. I haven't actually been to the bakery, but someone brought these into the office and what a great treat!! These donuts where dense enough to support the incredible toppings. I wont lie - i had more than one and it was soooooo worth it!

text: Uma fila longa, mas o atendimento foi rápido. O croissant com queijo e presunto estava muito bom, mas o croissant com queijo e presunto do Fontainebleau em Miami é definitivamente melhor. O TKO é exagerado, definitivamente não seria necessário comprá-lo novamente, não tinha muito sabor. Mas o macaron de maracujá foi um dos melhores macarons que já experimentamos. No começo, não tem muito sabor, mas quando você come o interior, que é levemente úmido, você sente uma explosão de sabores. Além disso, os macarons são muito grandes. Minha única sugestão é adicionar o matcha ao cardápio. Atualmente, só oferecem café ou um suco de laranja caro, vendido em garrafa.
original: A long line but it went quick. The ham cheese croissant was very good, but the ham and cheese croissant at the Fontainebleau in Miami is definitely better. The TKO is overhyped, def wouldn't need to get it again, lacked flavor. But the passion fruit macaron was one of the best macarons we've had. At first it doesn't have much flavor, then the semi moist inside hits you with a ton of flavor. Also they are massive macarons. My one recommendation is adding Matcha to the menu. It's either coffee or a overpriced orange juice from a bottle.

text: Un lugar excelente para conseguir unos donuts deliciosos. Cuando descubrí este lugar, dejé de comprar donuts en ningún otro sitio.
original: Great place to get some boom donuts from when I found this place I hate eating donuts from anywhere else

text: Se ha nombrado uno de los mejores lugares para comer helado, y puedo entender por qué. Su helado es casero y los sabores son diferentes a cualquier otro lugar. Han perfeccionado las donas que utilizan para sus sándwiches de donas, no son demasiado dulces ni demasiado poco dulces. Me encanta el helado de lavanda y miel, ¡y también el de taro! Delicioso, y el patio es muy bonito. Perfecto para pasar un día con la familia o la pareja. Gente amable, servicial y puedo asegurar que volverán después de la primera visita.
original: Named one of the best spots for ice-cream and I can see why! Their ice-cream is homemade and the flavors unlike any other spot. They've perfected the donuts they use for their donuts sandwhich it's not too sweet not too un-sweet. I love the lavender honey ice-cream and the taro! Super yummy and the patio is so cute! Perfect for a day out with fam or partner. Lovely people nice and friendly and I guarantee you'll come back after the first time!

text: Modern but feels old fashion. I ordered the rocky road sundae. How rocky was this road? Well if I were driving Grandma around, her dentures would be rattling and once we get to the destination, she may have lost them somewhere between here and there. So if you can't picture it, the rocky road is loaded with almonds. I loved the almonds and was the best part of the sundae. The chocolate ice cream was creamy but too sweet for me. The flambÃ© marshmallow fluff was beautiful and enticing, but too sweet for me. I ordered a pretzel cone on the side to try as I read good reviews... it was kind of ehh. I would absolutely come back to try more of their imaginative menu. I was surprised at the sticker price on the menu, so be prepared. I came late at night so parking wasn't an issue, but it may be an issue during prime time. Oh those nuts... Grandma, can we go on another ride?

So hopeful when they were doing the Red Velvet cupcake drive, so I got the RV. It was dry and too light and frankly small for the price . The top separated when I was peeling off the paper. This is your specialty so you should have the best. The set up was also confusing. Much better choices for the money.

Oh my goodness! What a gem. I had the dough melt with sweet cream and honey. Whoever thought of using a donut for an ice cream sandwich is a genius. Best dessert I've had in Phoenix. Love the small and fresh batches of ice cream, which when paired with a warm donut is heavenly. Great service from the owner's too. I will be back again.

Ugh! This was so disappointing! For someone to be the boss of all cakes, you'd think the cake would blow your mind, or at the absolute least, be some of the better cake you've ever tasted. Unfortunately that is not the case. My sister and I both got to-go items from here after a late night dinner at Buddy V's at the Venetian. We took them back to our hotel. I opted for the funfetti cake. It ended up being too late to eat mine and I don't like cold cake anyways (they refrigerate their cake which I get why they do it, but I prefer it be room temperature when I dine on it). I ended up eating it the next night and I took the first bite and must have made a face because my sister said "what's wrong?" and I said "Hmmm nothing... this just tastes like boxed cake. It's not really that good at all." I mean really, I can name NUMEROUS bakeries in Columbus, Oh (including our grocery store bakery, Giant Eagle) that are better than this place. I would say the cake part tasted like boxed funfetti cake and the frosting tasted cheaper than canned icing. So all in all, I think I'd actually prefer Pillsbury and would label it a tad better than this cake. I can't say for sure if the cake in their Hoboken location would be better, but I think it's safe to assume they'd use all the same ingredients because it's the same ownership. After this visit, I am wondering if the Cake Boss only became famous for his presentation of cakes, and not the actual taste. Anyways, main positive about this place is the line management. We were there so late on a Sunday that there wasn't much of a line, but there is someone waiting right there with an Ipad helping you out as soon as you walk in. Friendly, helpful staff. Anyways, I'd recommend passing on this. Take a walk down to The Linq and opt for a Sprinkles cupcake instead...

Visitando o Arizona e o clima está incrivelmente quente, então fomos experimentar o sorvete de limão e manjericão. Encontramos que estava disponível apenas em potes, o que nos desapontou. No final, pedimos o sorvete de morango, que é delicioso. Não é muito doce e é completamente refrescante! Gostaria de mencionar que eles usam colheres de metal, caso queira experimentar sabores específicos. É uma opção ecologicamente correta!
original: Touring Arizona and it is incredibly HOT out so we came to try their lime basil sorbet having it bookmarked only to find it's available in pints :(((( Ended up getting the strawberry sorbet and it's delicious. Not too sweet and completely refreshing ! Would like to mention that they use metal spoons if you want to try certain flavors. Eco-friendly !

text: Na Jeni's, não existe escolha ruim. Eu peguei uma porção de sorvete de framboesa e meu namorado pegou uma porção de "Brambleberry Crisp". Ambos são deliciosos. Não há nada de negativo a dizer sobre este lugar! Vá conferir!
original: No such thing as a bad choice at Jeni's. I got one scoop of FroÅ›e Sorbet and my boyfriend got one scoop of Brambleberry Crisp. Both are very delicious. Absolutely nothing negative to report about this place! Go check it out.

text: Ambiente agradable, pero la comida no justifica la fama que tiene. En absoluto.
original: Cool vibe but the food isn't worth the hype. At all.

text: Amazing! I am not an ice cream person but I will make an exception for Sweet Republic. I love the Toffee Banofi Sundae. Also the Salted Butter Carmel and Almond Buttercruch ice cream are just wonderful.

Compramos los batidos en los partidos de los "Knights". Eran caros y, al final, terminábamos con cereales blandos. El sabor a chocolate era mejor que el de fresa, pero en general, no nos gustaron mucho. Al beber el batido, se mezclaban los trozos de batido y cereal.
original: We got the milkshakes at the knights games. They were expensive and ended up with soggy cereal at the end. The chocolate was better than the strawberry combination, but overall we were not a fan. You would get milkshake and cereal chunks as you drank it.

text: ¡Los mejores de todos! Mi familia solía comprar estos donuts en la ubicación original hace más de 50 años, y siguen siendo deliciosos.
original: The BEST ever! My family used to get these donuts from original location 50+ years ago and they are still great.

text: Very friendly atmosphere and owners. They have a great selection of ice cream flavors, and their halo halo tastes amazing! Definitely will be visiting this place often.
Por que eu não pensei nisso antes?!? Quem não gosta de cereal? Experimentei o shake Cosmo e Wanda sem chantilly – a especial do Lamelo – e adorei! Atendimento super atencioso, lugar divertido!
original: Why didn't I think of this concept?!? Who doesn't like cereal? Had the Cosmo and Wanda shake with no whip - the Lamelo special - da bomb! Super friendly staff, fun place!

text: Una selección excelente de toppings, salsas y frutas, sobre una base de helado realmente deliciosa. Disfruté del combo de café y chispas de chocolate, en parte porque fue una forma rápida y sencilla de elegir la combinación perfecta. Además, los precios son muy buenos.
original: Such a great selection of toppings, sauces, and fruit on top of really tasty frozen custard. I enjoyed the Coffee Chocolate Chip combo - partially because it was a quick and easy way to choose a perfect mix. Great prices, too.

text: Best cupcakes in LV! I ordered the cupcake sundae: cupcake: red velvet ice cream: salted carmel. So they serve it in a cup cut the cupcake in half and serve the ice cream in the middle. Very interesting and tasty!

Sí, estoy de acuerdo con todos en que este lugar es solo publicidad. Lo único positivo fue que no tuve que esperar en la fila. La primera vez que lo intenté, tuve que esperar más de una hora, así que me fui.
original: Yeah,I'm going to have to agree with everyone that this place is all hype...only good thing was that I didn't have to wait in line..the first time I tried it was more than an hour wait so I left...

text: I'm definitely a new fan of AmÃ©lie's! We came in at 3:30am in the late Saturday/early Sunday morning for a late night snack. This location of AmÃ©lie's is opened 24 hours. AmÃ©lie's is probably the cutest coffee, sandwich, dessert, and hangout store. It has lots of personality with the decor. The staff are really nice and will help with any questions you may have and offer suggestions depending on what you like. What We Ordered: - CrÃ¨me BrÃ»lÃ©e || So good. They of course torch the sugar top of the dessert. This dessert is just delectable. Probably the beset creme brulee I have ever had. - Fruit Danish || they are generous with the amount of fruits on this danish. It was very colorful - Salted Caramel Brownie || this is a pretty popular item and has equal parts brownie and caramel on top of the brownie. If you're a fan of caramel, you will LOVE this. - Raspberry Lemonade Tea || fresh raspberries are crushed and placed into the tea. The drink is good, but a little too sweet for my taste buds. Overall, I am happy to find out that AmÃ©lie's just recently open another location in Atlanta which is closer to me. I'll stop by this location the next time I'm in Charlotte.
¡El helado de pistacho es el mejor que he probado! Recomiendo encarecidamente este lugar. Los batidos son espectaculares.
original: Best pistachio ice cream ever! Highly recommend this place. The milkshakes are phenomenal.

text: Actualización de enero de 2017: Este lugar sigue impresionando. La comida siempre es buena, y lo peor que puedo decir es que a veces se quedan sin cosas. Cuando pregunté sobre esto, me dijeron que solo compran productos de ciertos proveedores (específicamente, solo compran costillas de res de otro puesto). Esto parece indicar un buen control de calidad. Y su higiene es excelente: recientemente vi a una clienta (que parecía ser una empleada de West Side Market, lo que hace que la situación sea aún más desagradable) tirar su pedido de comida de nuevo a la sartén porque estaba molesta por no recibir un descuento. Descartaron el artículo y luego limpiaron y recalentaron la sartén, aunque eso tomó unos minutos más en un día ajetreado. ¡Excelente trabajo! Para aquellos que se quejan de las largas colas y el servicio al cliente, ¡este es un puesto en un bullicioso mercado! Si no quieren esperar en la cola, simplemente evítelo. Es evidente que el puesto está diseñado para funcionar, y no para reemplazar la experiencia de un restaurante con un camarero atento. Reseña anterior de agosto de 2015: Las crepes siempre son increíbles, aunque la cola puede ser bastante larga durante los momentos de mayor afluencia. Simplemente, ¡calma y espera a que llegue la comida!
original: Jan 2017 Update: This place continues to impress. The food is always good, and the worst thing I can say is that they run out of stuff - when I inquired about this, they said they only buy items from certain purveyors (specifically, they will only buy beef brisket from one other stand). Seems indicative of good quality control. And their hygiene is outstanding - I recently saw a customer (who appeared to be a West SIde Market employee, making this especially gross) throw her food order back onto their skillet because she was annoyed that she didn't receive a discount. They thew away the offending item and then tore down, cleaned, and reheated that skillet even though it took an extra few minutes on a busy day. Great job. For those people that complain about the long lines and customer service, this is a kiosk in a bustling city market!!! If you don't want to wait in the line, then skip it. The stand is very obviously meant to function, and not meant to replace the experience of a sit down venue with a doting waiter. Previous review from Aug 2015: The crepes are always amazing, although the line is quite long during busy times. Just calm down and wait for the goodness!

text: Every Sprinkles is good. Oh so good. Mmmmmm. (recommend the dark chocolate, and if you want to try a ton of cupcakes, get all the minis). PLUS THERES A SPRINKLES ICE CREAM SHOP TO THE RIGHT.
Una masa de galletas excelente, chocolate delicioso y cupcakes increíblemente húmedos y deliciosos.
original: Great cookie dough, delicious chocolate and out of this world amazingly moist cupcakes!

text: Estaba muy emocionado por probar esto, pero la emoción pronto se desvaneció. Compré una porción de tarta de nueces a un precio de unos 6-7 dólares. Si esa es una porción, ¡me encantaría ver su versión de una porción pequeña, porque eso es lo que realmente era! A ese precio, deberían ofrecer una porción generosa. Estaba bien, como una tarta de nueces fría sin las nueces. Pedí que la prepararan "al estilo", pero me dijeron que no era posible, así que compré un helado pequeño de chocolate con pretzels y leche de cereal, por otros 6-7 dólares. La consistencia era buena, pero prácticamente no había sabor. Noté sal en el chocolate, pero en realidad no había chocolate. Por lo tanto, les doy una calificación A por su estrategia de marketing y una C- por su producto. Una buena estrategia de marketing puede hacer que cualquier cosa parezca buena, ¡tened cuidado! :)
original: Was excited to try this but the excitement soon waned. I purchased a slice of crack pie for like $6-7. Well if that's a slice I'd sure hate to see their version of a sliver because that's what it really was. For that price you should get a generous slice. It was okay, kinda like cold pecan pie without the pecans. I asked for it alamode but was told that wasn't an option so I purchased a small ice cream of chocolate covered pretzel and cereal milk., for another $6-7 I might add. Consistency was good but there was virtually no flavor. I tasted salt in the chocolate but really no chocolate. So I give them A for marketing and C- for their product. Great marketing can make anything look good - beware. :)

text: Vá, simplesmente vá! Pagar cinco dólares por um donut e um mocha gelado em Las Vegas é um luxo; no entanto, donuts aprovados pelos órgãos locais são um sinal claro de que você encontrou a melhor confeitaria de donuts em Las Vegas. A equipe simpática tem motivos para sorrir, pois sabem que você está prestes a desfrutar de uma experiência realmente deliciosa ao pedir qualquer um dos seus donuts!
original: Go, just go! Five bucks a donut and iced mocha in Vegas is a treat; however, donuts approved by local deputies is a sure sign you have found the best donut shop in Vegas. The friendly staff has reason to smile because they know you are in for a real treat when you order any of their donut creations!

text: First time here tonight and the ice cream was crazy good. You're frozen treat comes in a Chinese takeout box which is cool. You also get a little fortune cookie on top and that's always a nice touch

What a charming bakery! They really have delicious desserts. Love their lemon bar, sfingi, pistachio cheesecake, lobster roll, cream puffs. Their tiramisu and Napoleon are also delicious. There is no place to sit but you can't wait to go home and stuff your face with sweets after coming here ! Owners and cashiers are super nice. Come and support your local bakery !

Sloan's é definitivamente um lugar que me lembra da Flórida. Três dos meus locais de encontro na escola, Clematis Street, City Place e Mizner Park, têm esta sorveteria: Sloan's. Este local, dentro do Venetian's Grand Canal Shoppes, oferece muitos dos mesmos doces, mas você não encontrará os característicos banheiros transparentes da Sloan's. Há um sabor de sorvete para qualquer desejo, desde café e donuts até torta de maçã. Por cerca de 10 dólares, pedi um sundae com três bolas, chantilly, calda de chocolate quente e uma cobertura. A calda de chocolate quente deixou a desejar. O "Luv It" em Las Vegas faz este sundae de forma muito melhor. Um brownie "Kitchen Sink" que parecia bom atrás do vidro pode ter sido previamente congelado. Seria muito melhor apreciado fresco, direto do forno, enquanto as coberturas estivessem derretidas e pegajosas, em vez de estar duro. Eles também oferecem donuts grandes da Donut Bar, maçãs caramelizadas, calda de chocolate e muito mais. Mas, eu venho aqui apenas pelo sorvete e para sentir um pouco da Flórida.
original: Sloan's is definitely a place that reminds me of Florida. Three of my old high school hangouts feature this ice cream parlor: Clematis Street, City Place, and Mizner Park. This location inside Venetian's Grand Canal Shoppes has many of the same sweet treats, but you won't find Sloan's signature see-through bathrooms. There's an ice cream flavor for any craving, from coffee and doughnuts to apple pie. For around $10, I got a sundae with three scoops, whipped cream, hot fudge, and a topping. The hot fudge was disappointing. Las Vegas's Luv It does this sundae staple much better. A Kitchen Sink brownie that looked good behind the glass may have been previously frozen. It would have been much better enjoyed fresh from the oven while the toppings were melted and gooey, rather than hard set. They also offer giant donuts from Donut Bar, caramel apples, fudge, and more. But, I'll only come here for the ice cream and a taste of Florida.

text: Tão bom, aproveite para se presentear! É delicioso, mas convide um amigo para compartilhar! Os sundays podem ser personalizados, trocamos duas porções de sorvete de biscoito e creme por uma de baunilha e uma de morango. Delicioso!
original: So good, go treat your yourself! So decadent but bring a friend to share!!! The sundaes are semi customizable, we traded 2 scoops of cookies and cream ice cream for one vanilla and one strawberry scoop. So nice!

text: Fui à Sweet Republic pela primeira vez hoje à noite... Compartilhei o sundae com caramelo com a minha esposa. Era o tamanho perfeito para duas pessoas se deliciarem. A jovem atendente na loja nos recebeu com muito carinho... E explicou tudo sobre o processo... Como tudo é feito à mão. Isso nos mostrou assim que entramos que este era um lugar especial. Ela também nos informou que Alton Brown, do canal Food TV, voltará neste mês... Sempre uma ótima novidade. Mal posso esperar para voltar!!!
original: Made my first trip to Sweet Republic tonight.... Shared the butter toffee sundae with my lovely bride. It was the perfect size for two people to snack on. The young lady behind the counter welcomed us into the shop warmly... And explained everything about the process.... How everything is handmade. This told us as soon as we walked in that this was a special place. She also told us that Alton Brown from the Food TV channel will be back this month...always a fun thing. I can't wait to go back!!!

text: ¡Este lugar era excelente! El helado artesanal casero fue, sin duda, uno de mis helados favoritos hasta la fecha. Si están de viaje por Phoenix, como nosotros, es un lugar que no pueden perderse. Disfrutamos del helado de miel y lavanda, y también del de bourbon y nueces pecanas. El helado de miel y lavanda es tranquilo, pero también dulce. La lavanda se destaca con un toque de miel. Es como caminar por un campo de lavanda bajo el sol. El helado de bourbon y nueces pecanas era dulce y muy cremoso. El dueño fue muy amable y nos trató como si formáramos parte de su "club de helado". Disfrutamos mucho charlando con él mientras probábamos los helados. Como mis hijos adolescentes dijeron: "Algunos de los mejores helados que he probado en mi vida. Me alegro de no vivir aquí, ¡de lo contrario estaría en bancarrota por venir aquí todos los días!". El precio es muy razonable. Es lo que esperaría pagar por una porción. El lugar donde está ubicado el heladería es acogedor, un patio encantador para disfrutar del helado y compartir la alegría del helado con amigos y familiares. ¡Gracias por crear una heladería tan maravillosa! ¡Nos encantaría que abrieran una aquí en Greensboro, Carolina del Norte! Esperamos volver a visitarlos y disfrutar de este helado de nuevo.
original: This place was top notch! The homemade artisan ice cream was by far one of my favorite ice creams to date. If you are traveling through Phoenix like us it's a MUST stop. We enjoyed the honey lavender and bourbon pecan. The honey lavender is calm, yet sweet. The lavender shines through with a touch of honey. It's like walking through a lavender field in sunshine. The bourbon pecan was sweet, very creamy. The owner was very kind, spoke to us like we were part of his ice cream society. We enjoyed chatting with him while checking out. As my teenage kids put it "some of the best ice cream I have had in my life. I'm glad I don't live here I would be poor from coming here everyday!" The cost is price pointed well. It's what I would expect to spend on a single scoop. The setting where the ice cream shop is located is cozy, a great courtyard to eat ice cream and share the happiness of ice cream with friends and family! Thanks for creating such a wonderful local ice cream shop! You're welcome to come and open one in Greensboro, NC for us!! We hope to travel back through and eat this again!

text: Exterior = 4/5 This place is located next to Momofuku on the second floor of the Cosmopolitan. It is almost like a stand so there is no seating area for it specifically - though there is seating near by or you could grab a slot machine (play and eat). The line was small when we got there so no major wait. It was nicely decorated, and definitely eye catching with the neon "Milk" sign. Interior = 3/5 Not much of an interior, since it is a stand alone stall almost. They have a cart in front of the cashier where you can get napkins and the utensils. Along the cashier, they have their cookies. Their menu is located on the wall directly behind the cashier. Service = 5/5 The ladies working the cashier and the food items were quick to move and get the items as you ordered. So there was basically no lag time between ordering and receiving your items. Their quickness almost had me struggling to pay and hold my items. Order = 3/5 Crack pie: 3/5 We felt this was a little hyped up, and it didn't really specify a flavor type. It was a kind of tiny triangle of pie, not very thick either. When I bit into it, it reminded me of butterscotch. It was also pretty chewy. Cereal Milk with cornflakes: 3/5 The ice cream didn't really have a flavor that I found I could nail down. The cornflakes itself seemed like they were sweetened, but not in the way Frosted Flakes are. I felt they were more crunchy than your usual corn flakes. I was thrown off as the combination seemed almost salty somehow. Fruity Milk with cornflakes: 3/5 Light fruity flavor. Boyfriend found there to be a slight chalky after taste. The cornflakes, added a nice crunch, but also had an interesting flavor. For me, I preferred this over the Cereal Milk since it didn't seem to have a salty flavor (which I think is attributed to the cornflakes). Overall = 3/5 It was good to try, but I'm okay with not running back next time I am in Vegas. If you like cookies, they also have a selection of cookies to choose from that are pre-packaged. The price was a bit much for the quantity of the items and ice served. Did find the saltiness/after taste of the ice cream a bit weird. Hint = Grab a cookie for on the go munching. They have a deal if you buy three!

I have been waiting to try this place since moving to Charlotte. It's a good place for sweets and I'll for sure be back again. I would like to say that I'm someone who does not like overly sweet, sugary things. I grew up eating Japanese cake and sweets, if that gives you an idea. Said in bubble tea terms: I order my sugar 25%. 50% sugar is my max and this is only if I'm wanting that sugary taste. Cheesecake: First off, I was shocked that this place actually made baked cheesecake instead of the pour and cool in the fridge type. This is the type of cheesecake seen in Japan. However, the chocolate chips ruined it for me. You can't see it in the picture but the inside is PACKED with more chocolate chips. I felt like I took a handful of chocolate chips, shoved it in my mouth and then added a small bite of cheesecake. I tried hard to assess just the cheesecake portion but it was difficult. I *think* the cheesecake was ok? It was the right amount of sweetness and tartness. My husband who loves cheesecake and chocolate got this for himself and loved it. So I think I'm just the anomaly here. Red velvet cake: I'm a sucker for red velvet. The cake was SUPER moist. Just for that, I would get it again. The cake sponge was not overly sweet and I savored every bite. Downside: there was waaaaay too much icing surrounding the cake. I could not eat the "spine" of the cake with icing and tossed it out. But the amount of icing between the layers of cake was perfect. The icing is pretty sweet but it was balanced out by the cake. I just wish they didn't slather so much on the outside Cannoli: So this is made fresh at the counter and you can customize it however you want. Husband got the simplest-- sweet cream with chocolate chips. I think I'm just not a cannoli person. So I think it's unfair for me to judge this item. I will say, a lot of my friends LOVE their cannoli. And I have to admit, even though I thought it was meh, this was the first cannoli that was edible for me, which is saying a lot. So if you're a cannoli person, I would say, get it. Napoleon: Best for last. I can't even describe how amazing this was. It's a huge slice and I wanted another one. I can't stop thinking about this! The custard/cream was the perfect sweetness and the puffy layers were sooo good!! FYI, it gets a little messy to eat because the custard will leak out. But I love that they didn't skimp out on the custard. I will absolutely be craving and getting this again!!!! I honestly think I would have given this place a 3 star but this ONE dessert deserved a star of it's own. Overall, I thought this place was standard. I've definitely had better sweets from both Italian and French bakeries. But the Napoleon? Man, that was so good! I want to get several different items next time and reassess. With the Napoleon aside, this place got a 4 star because of their great and friendly customer service (some bakeries can be snobby and rush customers to pick their items), countless selections of baked goods, and the fact that they don't overly sweeten their items. Reading the other reviews here, hearing what my friends have said about this place, I understand that I probably do not have the palate of the majority. I can't in good faith give this place 3 stars because I am weird about sweets. But this definitely was not the best Italian bakery I have tried. Therefore, 4 stars.

¡Este lugar fue genial! Mi esposo y yo compartimos la sándwich de albóndigas con papas fritas y elegimos varias opciones de postre. Cuando llegamos, el lugar no estaba muy concurrido, así que no fue necesario sacar un número, pero dentro de los 5 minutos posteriores a la orden, ¡el lugar se llenó! Tienen un número adecuado de asientos tanto en el interior como en el exterior. Si volvemos a ir (vivimos en Louisville, Kentucky, y paramos aquí durante un viaje), y pedimos el sándwich de albóndigas de nuevo, les pediré una taza adicional de salsa de tomate, ¡fue increíble y estaría delicioso con las papas fritas que se sirven con el sándwich! ¡Un lugar excelente y lo recomiendo mucho!
original: This place was great! My husband and I split the meatball sub with chips and picked out several dessert options. The place wasn't busy when we first got there so pulling a number tab wasn't necessary, but within 5 minutes after ordering the place was packed! They have an adequate amount of seating between the inside and outside. If we end up going back (we live in Louisville, KY and stopped here on a road trip) and order the meatball sub again, I will ask for an additional cup of tomato sauce, it was incredible and would be very tasty on the kettle chips served with the sub. Great spot and I recommend it highly!

text: Na primeira vez que fui à Crêpes De Luxe, minha intenção era escrever uma crítica negativa. Claro! A crêpe que eu recebi na época era tão deliciosa quanto a que eu recebi recentemente, com Nutella, morangos e bananas em uma crêpe fresca e quente. Mas essa atitude foi um desastre. Os funcionários pareciam irritados e frios, com uma expressão desagradável no rosto, o que me faria hesitar em ir ao seu balcão no West Side Market em um dia movimentado! Foi pior que o "Soup Nazi" – pelo menos ele tinha um conjunto de regras estabelecidas para seguir. Mas, de certa forma, eles estavam certos. Eu, de fato, solicitei aquele tipo de atendimento. Na minha última visita, alguém na faixa dos vinte anos cuidou de mim em uma quarta-feira matinal, e sua atitude foi muito mais agradável. Ele até foi paciente o suficiente para atender seis meninas do ensino fundamental em uma excursão, com um sorriso. Minha melhor sugestão para quem for à Crêpes De Luxe é: tente evitar ir quando o mercado estiver cheio. As crêpes sempre serão deliciosas, mas o sabor fica ainda melhor com um ótimo atendimento.
original: The first time I went to CrÃªpes De Luxe, I was intent on giving it a bad review. Sure! The crepe I received then was just as delicious as the one I recently got, Nutella, strawberries, and bananas on a fresh warm crepe. But that attitude was a killer. The men behind the counter seemed angry and cold, with a nasty look on their faces that I would dare come to their stand in the West Side Market on a busy day! It was worse than the Soup Nazi- at least he had an established set of rules to follow. But in a way, they were right. I did sort of ask for that treatment. On my recent trip, someone in their earlier twenties took care of me on a fairly steady Wednesday morning and his demeanor was much more engaging. He was even patient enough to serve the six middle school girls on a field trip with a smile. It's my best advice for hitting up CrÃªpes De Luxe. Try to avoid going when everyone is at the market. The crepes will always be delicious, but they taste a little better with great service.

text: This place satisfied my sweet tooth with a lovely display of its spread of offerings. The oatmeal scotchie cookies were probably something I could have made at home but was nice to be able to pick them up ready to go- delicious, we got the butterscotch chip bars to go along with. Not often something I find in other bakeries so I was really happy! The hamburger buns were so soft and reminded me of my grandmas homemade buns- I could tell everything is made with high quality ingredients because the two buns we didn't eat had mold growing on them after a few days on my counter, unlike the preservative filled bread you find in a grocery store- sad for me that we didn't eat them fast enough! The cracked wheat loaf was very good also. I live on the west side but will make a special trip to Batch if I am in need of high quality bakery items.
Every time I come to Charlotte, Amelie's is a must. If you have a love of the French culture or have taste buds you will find something here that you will love. Mimosa's and pastries for me.

Una fila enorme para entrar, de unos media hora, lo que me hizo pensar que debía ser un lugar muy bueno. Cuando llegamos al frente, nos presionaron para que eligiéramos rápidamente y nos preguntaron si podíamos decidirnos pronto debido a la larga fila. No solo fue una actitud grosera, sino que la famosa panadería no valía la pena la espera en absoluto. Pedimos cannoli con chocolate y pastel de Oreo. Todos estuvimos muy decepcionados y nos dimos cuenta de que habíamos perdido media hora. No había sitio para sentarse, el personal era grosero, tanto al atender la fila como al tomar los pedidos y en la caja. No volveré.
original: Huge line to get in, about half an hour which made me think it must be good. When we get to front we are rushed to choose and asked if we can decide quickly because if the line. Not only is that rude, but the world famous bakery wasn't worth the wait whatsoever. We ordered chocolate covered cannoli and Oreo cake. We were all disappointed and pretty much were thinking we wasted a half hour. No where to sit, rude worker handling line, rude worker taking order and rude cashier. Will not go back.

text: Liguei à padaria na manhã de sexta-feira para encomendar um bolo de cannoli. Fui informado que o bolo custaria US$ 65 e estaria pronto no domingo às 12h30. Cheguei à padaria e, de fato, estava pronto e parecia incrível!! Fiquei muito satisfeito com o bolo, mas fui cobrado US$ 5,00 a mais do que o valor informado por telefone. Então, decidi comprar alguns biscoitos para o aniversário da minha mãe e, já que meu namorado é de Nova York, queria experimentar o biscoito colorido antes de comprá-los, pois era o favorito da mãe dele. A funcionária do balcão perguntou ao atendente se ele poderia ter um biscoito, e ele respondeu: "Bem, você terá que comprá-lo". Nós tínhamos planejado gastar facilmente US$ 100 lá, e ele não poderia experimentar o biscoito? Sério? O atendente cobrou-nos US$ 1,00 por um biscoito. Talvez eu desse 5 estrelas se o atendimento ao cliente fosse melhor. Avisarei como o bolo fica depois, mas parece realmente delicioso.
original: I called the bakery Friday morning to order a cannoli cake. I was told it was $65 for the cake and it would be ready on Sunday at 12:30. Got to the bakery and it was indeed ready and looked amazing!! Was very happy with the cake but was charged $5.00 more for the cake than I was told over the phone. So decided to buy a few cookies for Mom's anniversary and my boyfriend being from NewYork wanted to try the rainbow cookie before buying them Because it was his Mothers favorite. The girl behind the counter asked the guy at the register if he could have a cookie and he said "well, you're going to have to buy it". Well we planned on dropping $100 there easy and he couldn't try the cookie? Really? Guy behind the register charged us $1 for 1 cookie. May have given 5 stars if the the customer service was better. Will let you know how the cake tastes later but looks really delicious

text: Siempre he querido probar esta panadería y, finalmente, lo hice anoche. Sin embargo, la experiencia no fue la mejor. No tenía mucha hambre de pasteles, así que probé el "cream puff" de avellana y el "tail" de langosta con avellanas. Lamentablemente, el "cream puff" estaba rancio. :( Por lo tanto, fue una decepción. Sin embargo, el "tail" de langosta estaba bien. No era espectacular, simplemente estaba bien. No tuvimos que esperar mucho en la fila y nos atendieron en menos de 5 minutos. Dos "tails" de langosta y un "cream puff" nos costaron 16 dólares (redondeando). ¿Volvería? Tal vez, solo por el pastel. Pero no por los que compré anoche.
original: I have always wanted to try this bakery and finally but the bullet last night. I was not craving for cakes so I i tried the hazelnut cream puff and hazelnut lobster tail. Unfortunately the cream puff was stale. :( so that was a downer. However the lobster tail was good. Not great. Just good. We didn't have to wait too long in line and was checked out less than 5 mins. Two lobster tails and 1 cream puff cost us 16$(rounded up). Would i come back? Maybe for the cake. But not for the ones i have gotten last night.

text: Primeiramente, o 85* não é uma padaria ruim. Alguns dos seus produtos, como a torta de ovos e os pães com leite, são bons. Também adoro o chá preto com creme de sal marinho e meu marido adora o chá tailandês. No entanto, o atendimento aqui é absolutamente terrível. Falar sobre falta de funcionários e funcionários lentos. Entendo que o 85* é popular e Las Vegas tem esperado ansiosamente pela sua inauguração. Não me surpreende que esteja sempre cheio, mas parece que, a cada vez que venho aqui, eles estão sempre com filas e sem produtos. Os atendentes realizam várias tarefas ao invés de apenas atender os clientes. Isso torna todo o processo de pagamento ineficiente, pois leva muito tempo. Eles não só têm que contar os produtos e inseri-los no sistema, mas também montar as caixas de transporte e colocar cada item individualmente em sacos plásticos antes de organizá-los na caixa. Todo esse processo pode levar até 5 minutos, e isso antes mesmo de começarem a coletar o dinheiro. Já fui em vários 85* na Califórnia e sei que isso é bastante comum em relação ao atendimento, mas, com a grande quantidade de clientes que visitam este local, acho que não é uma forma eficiente de usar o tempo. Pelo menos, montar as caixas de transporte com antecedência ou eliminar a embalagem individual dos produtos para agilizar o processo. Além disso, as atendentes trabalham muito lentamente. Entendo que todos são novos, mas ainda assim, é importante ter um senso de urgência diante da multidão. É frustrante ver as atendentes demorando em uma fila que envolve vários corredores, especialmente quando você já está esperando há mais de 30 minutos apenas para ser atendido. Na última vez que fomos, meu marido comeu um pastel enquanto esperávamos, pois estava com fome e a fila demorou muito. Também vimos um homem literalmente derrubar sua bandeja cheia de pastéis em um balcão próximo e sair, pois não queria esperar mais. Estou curioso para saber se a equipe jogou os pastéis fora ou se os colocou de volta nas prateleiras para venda. De qualquer forma, isso representou uma perda para o negócio. Claro, eu avisei à atendente que meu marido comeu um pastel (a embalagem ainda estava na bandeja), mas estou curioso para saber quantos outros clientes comeram seus produtos enquanto esperavam e não se preocuparam em avisar a atendente. Com tanta gente, é muito fácil passar despercebido. Além disso, enquanto meu marido esperava na fila, fui ao quiosque de autoatendimento e comprei bebidas, já que era mais rápido em um balcão separado. A tela anunciava chá tailandês, que era "compre um, ganhe outro grátis" de dezembro até início de janeiro. Eu pedi o chá tailandês, mas não vi nenhuma mensagem sobre um drink grátis, então decidi perguntar à atendente. Ela pareceu confusa no início e, em seguida, disse: "Ah, não temos essa promoção aqui, pois estamos inaugurando". Perguntei então por que está anunciado na tela se não está sendo oferecido. A resposta dela foi: "Não podemos tirar isso da tela. Desculpe". Eu simplesmente deixei isso de lado. Isso não é contra a atendente. Ela foi educada e estava apenas fazendo o seu trabalho, mas, se você for anunciar algo e for uma franquia, pelo menos, informe que não é válido neste local ou algo similar. Caso contrário, isso seria apenas publicidade falsa e comportamento antiético. Se não for uma promoção válida, então deve ser removida, caso contrário, ainda deve ser oferecida se estiver anunciada. De qualquer forma, não estou reclamando de um chá tailandês grátis, mas achei isso estranho. Isso realmente contribui para a má gestão, falta de pessoal e falta de organização deste lugar. Espero que eles consigam resolver isso no futuro. Como eu disse, o 85* não é uma padaria ruim.
original: First off, 85* is not a bad bakery. Some of their pastry items are good like the egg tart and milk breads. I also love their Black Tea with Sea Salt Cream and my husband loves their Thai Tea. That being said, the service here is absolutely horrendous. Talk about under staff and SLOW workers.
