I get it, 85* is popular and Vegas has been anticipating its grand opening for a while now. I'm not surprised that it's constantly crowded but it seems like everytime I come here they're always backed up and out of pastries. The cashiers do multiple tasks instead of just checking customers out. This makes the whole payment process inefficient because it takes up too much time. They not only have to count the pastries and input it into the system, but they assemble cardboard carrying boxes and individually place each pastry item into plastic bags before arranging them into the box. This whole process can take up to 5 minutes and that's before they even begin to collect money. I've been to many of the 85* in California and I know this is pretty standard for how they check out, but with the large amount of customers visiting this single location, I just don't think it's a smart use of time. At least assemble the carrying boxes in advance or omit individually packaging the pastries all together to speed up the process. Also, the register girls work so slow. I get that everyone is new, but still, have some sense of urgency for the crowd. It's toture watching the girls take their time in a line that wraps around muitple loops, especially since you've been waiting for over 30 minutes just to check out. The last time we came my husband ate 1 pastry while we waited because he was hungry and the line took so long. We also witnessed a guy literally drop his tray full of pastries onto a nearby counter and left because he didn't want to wait any longer. I wonder if the staff threw the pastries away or if they put it back into the shelves for sale. Either way, that was a loss of money for the business. Of course, we told the cashier my husband ate a pastry (the wrapper was still on the tray) but I wonder how many people munched on their items while waiting and don't bother to tell the cashier. With the amount of crowd, it's really easy to go unnoticed. Also, while my husband was waiting in line, I went to the self-order kiosk and got us drinks since it came quicker from a separate counter. The screen advertised Thai Tea that was buy 1 get 1 free from December until early January. I order the Thai Tea but didn't see a prompt for a free drink so I decided to ask the register. She seemed confused at first and then she said "Oh, we don't have that promotion here because we're grand opening." I asked her then why is it advertised on the screen if you don't honor it? Her reply was "We can't take it off the screen. Sorry." I just left it at that. This is not against the girl. She was polite and only doing her job, but if you're going to advertise something and you're a franchise then at least state that it's not valid at this location or something similar to that effect. Otherwise, that's just false advertising and unethical business. If it's not a valid promotion then it should be taken down, otherwise it should still be honored if it's advertised. Either way, I'm not fussing about a free Thai Tea, but I just thought that was strange. It really adds to the whole unprepared, under staffed and poor management of this place. Hopefully, they'll figure things out in the future. Like I said, 85* is not a bad bakery.

text: El helado era simple. No era lo mejor que había probado. Había mucha gente esperando porque es una novedad y está de moda en Charlotte en este momento. El cono de waffle era de calidad media. El servicio fue bueno. Los empleados parecían contentos de trabajar allí, y el ambiente en el lugar era alegre, ya que todos estaban muy emocionados por la apertura.
original: Ice cream was straight. Wasn't the best thing ever. Line was long since it's new and trendy right now in CLT. The waffle cone was mediocre. Service was good. The staff seemed happy to work there and there's a happy atmosphere at the place since everyone was so excited about the opening.

text: Fui aqui exatamente uma semana atrás, e o atendente fechou cedo. O sorvete foi o pior que já experimentei: sem sabor, com aspecto de congelado e com textura arenosa. Eu não comeria esse sorvete de graça. Estou muito decepcionado. Mesmo que o sorvete fosse bom, o preço era excessivamente alto para as quantidades oferecidas. Absolutamente ridículo.
original: Went here exactly a week ago, guy closed early. Worst ice cream I've ever had.. no flavor, freezer burned, and gritty. I wouldn't eat that ice cream for free. VERY disappointed. Even if the ice cream was good, it was severely overpriced for the sizes. Absolutely ridiculous.

text: The food is unbelievable whether its a sandwich, a box full of desserts, or a cheese tray. My personal favorite are the mini crÃ¨me brulee's, they have seasonal flavors. I love visiting Amelie's in the middle of the night to people watch, there is such a huge range of people who visit you never know who you might see.

Es el mejor donut que he probado. Por la apariencia exterior, no esperarías que los donuts fueran tan buenos. Ahora vivo en Maryland y siempre pienso en estos donuts. Intento visitarlos cada vez que estoy en Cleveland. El donut con tocino es simplemente increíble, ¡es imprescindible probarlo!
original: Best donut I've ever tasted. From the look on the outside you won't expect the donuts to be so good. I live in Maryland now and I always think of the donuts. I try to stop by every time I'm in Cleveland. The bacon donut is just WOW, a must have.

text: Eu já fui a Nova York antes, mas, infelizmente, não tive tempo suficiente para experimentar o Milk Bar. Ouvi muitas coisas boas sobre este lugar, então fiquei muito animado para experimentar. Felizmente, consegui experimentar seus bombons de aniversário e o sorvete enquanto jantava no Momofuku em janeiro. Ambos foram realmente deliciosos. Então, fico contente que o Milk Bar esteja aberto ao lado para satisfazer meu desejo por doces. Vim aqui em janeiro antes de minha viagem de volta para comprar alguns biscoitos. A funcionária descreveu todos os biscoitos para mim e quando ela disse que os biscoitos de blueberry e creme tinham o sabor de um muffin de blueberry, eu já estava convencido. Peguei alguns desses e, em seguida, um biscoito de milho, um biscoito de composto e um biscoito de chocolate com marshmallow. Definitivamente, gostei mais dos biscoitos de blueberry. São um pouco caros, mas acho que valem a pena. Voltei novamente em abril e comprei mais biscoitos. Todos de blueberry e chocolate. Na minha opinião, esses dois são os melhores. Também comprei um sorvete de cereal com pedaços de frutas. O cereal com pedaços de frutas tem um certo salgado que equilibra a doçura. É realmente agradável. Por fim, comprei sorvete aqui às 10 da manhã. Nunca é cedo demais para satisfazer seu desejo por doces. Além disso, você está de férias. Aproveite! haha O Milk Bar e seus doces são realmente ótimos. Tão bons que minha amiga, que mora em Las Vegas, trouxe alguns biscoitos para mim quando voltou para visitar. A equipe é muito simpática e conhece bem os produtos. Nas duas vezes que vim aqui, não havia fila, o que é ótimo. Sou viciado. Os biscoitos (e o sorvete) são divinos. São tão bons e mal posso esperar para experimentar mais quando voltar a Las Vegas em setembro! Faça um favor a si mesmo e compre alguns desses, você não vai se arrepender.
original: I've been to New York before but unfortunately didn't have enough time to try Milk Bar. I've heard only good things about this place so I was excited to try it. Luckily I was able to try their birthday cake truffles and their soft serve while dining at Momofuku in January. Both were really good. So I'm glad Milk Bar is open next door to satisfy my sweet tooth. Came here in January before my flight back home to get some cookies. The worker described all the cookies to me and when she said the blueberry and cream cookies tasted like a blueberry muffin, I was sold. I grabbed a couple of those and then a corn cookie, compost cookie, and a chocolate chip with marshmellow cookie. I definitely liked the blueberry cookie the best. The are a little pricey but I think it's worth it. I came back again in April and bought some more cookies. All blueberry and Chocolate chip. Those two, in my opinion, are the best. I also got myself a cereal and fruity pebbles twist soft serve with cereal crunch. The cereal crunch has some kind of saltiness to it that balances out the sweetness. It's really pleasant. FYI, I bought ice cream here at 10am. It's never too early to satisfy your sweet tooth. Also, you're on vacation. Live a little. haha Milk bar and their treats are really good. So good, that I had my friend, who lives in Vegas, bring me some cookies back to the bay when she came home to visit. The staff is really friendly and knowledgeable about the products. Both times I've come here there was no line which is great. I'm addicted. The cookies (and their soft serve) are divine. They're so good and I can't wait to get some more when I visit Vegas again in September! Do yourself a favor and pick some of these bad boys up, you won't regret it.

text: El precio era un poco elevado teniendo en cuenta la falta de sabor del helado. Yo pedí uno de café, pero el helado de mi hijo, que era de tipo cupcake, tenía un sabor demasiado intenso y era excesivamente dulce.
original: It was a little too high in cost for the lack of taste in ice cream. I got the coffee flavored ice cream. My kid got a cup cake ice cream that was way too rich in taste and was a waist.

text: Very exicted to have my first Sprinkles experience on my trip to Vegas. Sprinkles is located in the new little village by the high roller observation ferris wheel thingy. There was no line at all in the afternoon and we headed in there. We got 2 cupcakes- triple chocolate and a banana chocolate- something like that. They were both fresh, delicious, and reasonably priced. They even have tables and chairs set up outside. Very cute place. Will def be back. **THEY HAVE AMAZING TO-DIE-FOR GLUTEN FREE COOKIES!!!! OMG!!!** (NOT in the ATM tho- you have to go into the store).

Great spot to get some really good ice cream. We like to get the sweet sundae where you can choose 4 different kinds of ice cream, comes with a cookie, brownie and a toasted marshmallow. This is a great item to share. I have also got the sorbet, strawberry and coconut which is very refreshing as well. Typically on the weekends they have enough employees to handle the line. When I recently went this past weekend, they do not have any seating inside only about two tables outside. Love to come here when we are in the area!

Best soft-served ice cream I ever had. At first when receiving a very dauntingly large ice cream cone I was worried about my ability to finish it. But to my surprise tthe ice cream was perfect. The temperature was perfect wasn't too cold and didn't melt to fast. The matcha flavor of the ice cream was definitely present but not over powering with the addition of the vanilla swirl to add some extra flavor. The ice cream had the perfect amount of sweetness. I don't have a sweet tooth but I still able to finish the ice cream in one sitting. The ice cream was flavor were very subtle easily melting in your mouth yet somehow so perfect in making you addicted to taste more. If you're not trying this ice cream and you're from the area you are definitely missing out.

This is a excellent ice cream place. They have a variety of treats ice cream, smoothies and candy. I ordered the daily grind which consists of coffee, Oreo and some homemade chocolate chips. All the ingredients favor each other so well that make a great ice cream. Staff are working hard and making smiles. Went to the back patio and there is a very nice presentable setting to it. Hope to return to Churn really soon. :)

Sem dúvida, o sorvete mais delicioso que já comi em Madison, WI. O "crumble" de pão caramelizado era simplesmente divino. Não sei de onde veio a ideia, mas adicionou um toque delicioso ao sorvete de creme de baunilha com pedaços de geleia. Os pedaços de waffle têm uma crocância deliciosa e definitivamente voltarei para experimentar outros sabores nesse ambiente charmoso.
original: Hands down the best ice cream I've had in Madison, WI. The best is yet to crumb especially was heavenly. Not sure where the idea of carmelized bread crumbs came from but they were a delicious touch to the vanilla flecked jam packed ice cream. The waffle bits have a delectable crunch and I will definitely be back to try more flavors in the cute setting.

text: Meu Deus, uma ótima seleção de donuts, alguns são enormes! Ou seja, poderiam alimentar 3 pessoas, mas de qualquer forma, os recheados com pasta de amendoim e geleia são ótimos, o bolo de cream cheese com morangos é delicioso e o "Maple Bacon" (bacon com xarope de bordo) é realmente muito bom. O café Stumptown, que foi uma ótima surpresa, definitivamente vale a pena experimentar este lugar!
original: Holy Moly great selection of donuts some Giant! I mean would feed 3 people but anyways peanut butter with jelly filled good, Strawberry cream cake good and Maple Bacon really good. Stumptown Coffee which was a nice treat definitely must try this place!

text: Meu marido e eu adoramos este lugar. Embora não pudéssemos nos sentar dentro (devido ao Covid, só tinham opções para levar), o ambiente era incrível e realmente gostaríamos de ter aproveitado mais. Parecia um dos salões de entretenimento da época de "O Grande Gatsby". Sofás de veludo vermelho, móveis antigos, iluminação amarela acolhedora, tecidos ricos e bonitos por toda parte! O Butterwood tinha uma seleção incrível de doces e bolos, que você nem acreditaria, e também diversas opções veganas. No final, escolhemos: - Bolo Poppy Rose com creme de figo - Bolo de cenoura com especiarias e buttercream de café com canela - Bolo de laranja sanguínea com buttercream de amêndoa. Todos foram absolutamente fantásticos – compartilhamos com minha prima e seu namorado – e o bolo Poppy Rose foi o favorito, que era úmido, delicioso e tinha as notas sutis de poppy e rosa que combinavam perfeitamente. Também pedimos dois chocolates quentes. Os chocolates quentes eram bastante comuns, não vale a pena. Em vez disso, experimentem mais dos doces mastigáveis! Cinco estrelas, apesar dos chocolates quentes, porque realmente eram muito bons.
original: My husband and I loved this place. Though we couldn't sit inside (they only had to-go items available due to Covid), the ambience was incredible and we really wish we could have enjoyed it more. It seemed like one of those entertaining rooms in old timey Great Gatsby era. Red velvet couches, antique furniture, warm yellow lighting, beautiful rich fabrics everywhere! Butterwood had an incredible selection of pastries and cakes that you wouldn't even believe, and numerous vegan options to boot. We ended up going with: - The Poppy Rose Cake with Fig Cream - Carrot Spice Cake with Cinnamon Espresso Buttercream - Blood Orange Almond Cake with Almond Buttercream All were absolutely fantastic - we shared with my cousin and his gf - and the crowd favorite was the Poppy Rose Cake which was moist, delicious, and had the perfect subtle notes of poppy and rose that went excellently together. We also had two small hot chocolates. The hot chocolates were very average, would not waste your time with them. Just get more of the chewable sweet treats instead! Five stars despite the hot chocolate because it really was JUST that good.

text: Aunque el helado es delicioso, el personal siempre es muy poco amable. Parece que nunca están contentos y es como si estuvieran haciendo un favor al ofrecérselo a los clientes. A menudo hay una señora, a la que asumo que es la gerente, con la que el personal parece sentirse incómodo. La última vez que fui, un empleado dejó caer la bolsa donde iba a colocar nuestro pedido y, sin embargo, siguió usándola para nuestro pedido. Le pedí amablemente que usara una bolsa que no hubiera caído al suelo, y luego siguió doblando la bolsa sucia y poniéndola de nuevo para el siguiente cliente. Esto no es correcto en el manejo de alimentos, y creo que los empleados deberían haber sido capacitados en esto. Parece algo muy básico.
original: While the ice cream is yummy the staff is always so unfriendly. They never seem happy and it's like they are doing you a favor by providing you with expensive ice cream. There's often a lady who I'm assuming is the mgr that the employees seem very uncomfortable with. Last time I was there an employee dropped the bag she was going to put our to go order in on the floor and she was still going to use it for our order. I asked her nicely to use one that didn't fall on the floor and then she proceeded to fold the dirty one and put it back for the next customer! This is not right in food handling services and I would think that employees would have been taught that - seems pretty basic to me.

text: Cute place in the cut. I was looking for somewhere to get pastries after dinner and Amelie's had a very little selection that night so I found this on Yelp and I'm glad I did. They only allow 2 in at a time so be prepared to stand outside if it is a busy time. They move you in and out pretty quickly though. I got a cannoli and crumb cake. Both were delicious and hit the spot. There was a nice selection of goodies so I'm sure anyone can find something they like. Now I know where I can get something sweet.

Só posso dizer: delicioso! Já tinha ido à Milk Bar em Nova York, mas só tinha experimentado o sorvete de leite com cereal antes. Desta vez, optei por experimentar o sorvete de caramelo crocante, que estava delicioso. Adicionei granulado colorido e flocos de milho por cima. Adorei a variedade do cardápio, com biscoitos, bolos e sorvetes. Eles também vendem livros interessantes e ingredientes para cozinhar. Era o aniversário da minha amiga, então pedimos um bolo de aniversário e a equipe foi muito atenciosa, incluindo duas velas para a celebração e velas da sorveteria ao lado, o que é ótimo saber para festas de aniversário. Recomendo fortemente que você pare na Milk Bar depois de experimentar o restaurante Momofuku do David Chang, para satisfazer suas necessidades de sobremesa.
original: All I can say is yum!! I've been to Milk Bar before in New York City but I'd only tried the cereal milk soft serve before. This time I opted to try the toffee crunch soft serve which was delicious. I added rainbow sprinkles and corn flakes on top. I loved the amount of variety their menu has with cookies, cakes and soft serve. They also have cool books and cooking ingredients for purchase as well. It was my friend's birthday so we opted for a slice of bday cake to go and the staff was so nice to include two candles for the celebration and candles from the bar right next door, which is great to know for birthday celebrations. I'd highly recommend stopping by Milk Bar after trying David Chang's Momofuku restaurant next door for your dessert needs.

text: Recomendo muito o sanduíche de sorvete! É um sorvete cremoso, feito em casa, entre duas bolachas recém-assadas, que você escolhe. A combinação de texturas e sabores é simplesmente irresistível! Por favor, experimente!
original: Highly recommend the ice cream sandwich! It is homemade creamy ice cream squished between two freshly baked cookies, which are selected by your choosing. It creates a cannot be missed texture and flavor combo!! Please try!!

text: Os macarons aqui são realmente deliciosos. São leves, fofos e crocantes, mas ao mesmo tempo, têm um sabor doce e intenso. Além disso, os macarons são naturalmente livres de glúten, o que é uma grande vantagem, já que nem sempre é fácil encontrar doces tão saborosos e feitos sem produtos à base de trigo. Nunca estive no The Venetian, mas sempre que venho para Las Vegas a trabalho, tento sempre fazer uma parada por aqui. Nunca experimentei nada mais nesta pequena padaria, mas os macarons já são suficientes para justificar uma visita extra.
original: The macarons here are seriously delicious. They're light, airy and crunchy, but at the same time pack a serious rich sweetness. Macarons are naturally gluten free as well, a huge plus as it's sometimes hard to find such decadent treats free from wheat products. I've never stayed in The Venetian, but every time I come to Las Vegas for work, I always make sure to make a detour. I've never had anything else from this little bakery, but the macarons are enough to warrant a side quest.

text: Amazing , great place, great customer service , ice cream is the best , glad to see them on Roosevelt row , I shop local and support local , this place is awesome

Este brownie gigante é incrível – é muito saboroso. Sem dúvida, o brownie mais delicioso que já provei, com uma generosa camada de fudge no meio, uma base de biscoito Graham na parte inferior e camadas de marshmallow assado. Eu adorei cada mordida deste brownie gigante, pois ele realmente impressiona. Além disso, as tortas de creme de aveia são imperdíveis, são demais. Ambos os itens são os mais vendidos da Batchmaker, e, como foi minha primeira visita (e certamente não a última), eu precisei experimentar ambos. Ah, e não posso deixar de comentar sobre os biscoitos, que podem ser os melhores da cidade. Um cardápio vasto, e posso garantir que os biscoitos Oreo com chocolate, com gotas de caramelo e de manteiga de amendoim são incríveis. A Batchmaker se tornou minha padaria favorita na cidade, e, como sou fã de bolos, estou muito animado para experimentar os bolos lá. É preciso fazer o pedido com antecedência, para que eu possa compartilhar minhas experiências em breve. Só desejo que os horários de funcionamento fossem mais convenientes, mas entendo que, como Cristina, a dona da Batchmaker, abriu este local e faz tudo sozinha. Tive que esperar um pouco para que a popularidade diminuísse, pois os produtos acabavam rapidamente. Voltarei (voz de Arnold).
original: This big time brownie is money - it's so rich. Easily the richest brownie I've ever tasted, with gobs of gooey fudge in the middle, graham cracker crust at rock bottom, layered with roasted marshmallow. I thoroughly enjoyed every bite of this beast brownie as it really packs a major punch. Also, a must try are their oatmeal creme pies, wow. Both items are Batchmaker's best selling and appropriately for my first visit (and easily not the last), I had to get both. Oh, and I cannot forgot to comment on their cookies, which may be up for best in town. Vast menu, and I can attest the oreo truffle chocolate chip, caramel chocolate chip, and peanut butter cookies are amazing. The Batchmaker just became my favorite bakery in town and me being a cake guy, am overly excited to try the cakes there. You have to pre-order them so those reports are soon to come. I just wish their hours were more convenient, but I understand as Cristina, The Batchmaker herself, just opened this location and bakes all the goodies by herself. Had to wait for the hype to die down as they were selling out fast daily. I'll be back (Arnold voice).

text: Fun place to try different flavor combos. We had chocoholic and frooty tooty and loved both. Waffle cones are fresh and yummy as well. Service is great!! Very clean.

Phenomenal as always! Also a long line always! Ha! You must get in line early although they do move along pretty quickly. I opted for the chocolate croissant and it was thick and flaky! They definitely don't skimp on the chocolate. Their coffee is delicious so much rich flavor in one single cup!

Fui apresentado ao Mitchell's há alguns anos e nunca mais voltei. O sorvete do Mitchell's é uma loja maravilhosa. Todo o sorvete é feito em casa, e esta unidade específica do Mitchell's tem uma pequena fábrica dentro, que pode ser vista através do vidro atrás do balcão. A loja é enorme. As filas estão sempre cheias, o que demonstra a popularidade deste lugar. Experimentei algumas coisas do Mitchell's, mas meu preferido é o sorvete de chocolate amargo com pedaços de menta. O que eu gosto é que ele tem pedaços grandes de chocolate amargo no sorvete, E o sorvete não é tingido de verde. Tem um sabor ótimo de menta, sem ser exagerado. Normalmente, gosto de pedir o sorvete em um sundae com calda de chocolate quente e chantilly extra. Adoro o chantilly deles e compraria um pote inteiro para comer tudo de uma vez. Adoro sorvete, e o Mitchell's é o lugar ideal para quem gosta de sorvete.
original: I was introduced to Mitchell's a few years ago and I have never gone back. Mitchell's ice cream is a gem of a shop. All the ice cream is home made and this particular Mitchell's has the little factory on the inside that you can see through the glass behind the counter. The store is huge. The lines are always wrapping out the door, that's how popular this place is. I've tried a few things from Mitchell's, my favorite has to be the mint dark chocolate chunk ice cream. What I like about it is that there are nice big chunks of dark chocolate in the ice cream AND the ice cream isn't dyed green. It's plenty minty without being overbearing. I usually like to get the ice cream in a sundae with hot fudge and extra whipped cream. I love their whipped cream and would totally buy a canister of it and eat it in one sitting. I love ice cream and Mitchell's is the place to be for ice cream.

text: Los postres de este lugar cumplieron con las expectativas. El pastel que pedimos no era demasiado dulce, el nivel de dulzor era perfecto, y la porción era muy grande. El servicio fue excelente, y sin duda volvería, especialmente porque está abierto hasta tarde y tiene una decoración interior encantadora.
original: The desserts here lived up to the hype! The cake we got wasn't too sweet, the sweetness was perfect, and the slice was huge. The service was great, and I would definitely go back especially since it's open late and has a cute interior decor.

text: Um dos dois estabelecimentos de cupcakes que meu marido, que é exigente, gosta. A opção de fazer pedidos online e retirar na loja me convenceu. 5 estrelas!
original: One of two cupcake shops that my picky husband likes. Online ordering and curbside pickup won me over. 5 Stars!

text: La comida era buena, pero la relación calidad-precio era pésima. Estaba muy emocionado por ir a este lugar después de ver "Cake Boss" durante varios años, pero al final me decepcioné. Pedimos dos raciones de langosta rellena, una galleta, un cheesecake de canolli y una porción de pastel. Cuando abrimos la caja, una hora después en nuestro hotel (ya que la pastelería no ofrece servicio en el local), solo encontramos una ración de langosta. El resto de la comida era excelente, pero pagar $6 adicionales por algo que ni siquiera recibimos fue una estafa.
original: Good food but total rip off. I was really excited to go here after watching Cake Boss for several years, but I ended up disappointed. We ordered 2 cream lobster tails, a cookie, a cannoli cheesecake, and a slice of cake. When we opened the box about an hour later at our hotel (because the bakery is not dine-in), we only found 1 lobster tail. The rest of the food was great but it was a rip off to pay $6 extra for something we didn't even get.

text: ¡Me encantó el helado de chocolate y menta! Esperaba mucho viniendo aquí, debido a las reseñas en Yelp y al hecho de que supuestamente es uno de los mejores de Estados Unidos. Normalmente, cuando esto ocurre, suelo encontrar que el producto no es tan bueno como esperaba y me siento muy decepcionado. Sin embargo, este lugar es definitivamente una excepción. El dueño fue muy amable con nuestro grupo. Queríamos llevar una pequeña porción a casa, pero no queríamos que el helado se derritiera durante un viaje de una hora. Ella dispuso de llevar la porción en una bolsa marrón con hielo y la guardó en su congelador mientras nosotros disfrutábamos de nuestras porciones para consumir allí. Mis favoritos fueron el de chocolate y menta, y el de fresa. Se puede apreciar la frescura de los ingredientes. La próxima vez, me daré el capricho de probar alguna de sus otras delicias.
original: I looooved the mint chocolate ice cream! Expected a lot coming here because of the reviews on yelp and the fact that it's supposedly one of the best in the US. Usually, when this happens, I tend to find the product not so up to parr and am extremely disappointed. However, this place is definitely an exception! The owner was very accommodating to our group. We wanted to take a small pint home but didn't want the ice cream to melt during an hour drive. She willingly put the pint in an ice filled brown bag and kept it in their freezer while we enjoyed our cups "for here" My favorites were the mint chocolate and strawberry. You can taste the freshness of the ingredients. Next time I will splurge and get one of their other delicacies!

text: Hard to find - store still has old business name above the entrance, Open sign turned off. Limited selection, donuts on the small size, pricey compared to traditional donuts. Nice staff but they seemed unconcerned about their appearance and unenthusiastic about their donuts. Donuts are thick and heavy, soaked and drenched in sugar

Eu completamente esqueci o quão incrível era o Batch, até uma recente viagem de volta a Madison. Fiquei satisfeito por eles terem finalmente se mudado para a loja maior, o que, na minha opinião, significava que teriam mais produtos interessantes para oferecer. E não me decepcionei. Já comprei muitos itens ótimos no Batch, desde os seus pães de trigo até o famoso "monkey bread" (pão de banana). Um dos meus doces favoritos desde criança era o "morning bun" (pão da manhã). Fiquei como uma criança em uma loja de doces quando vi que o Batch tinha o seu próprio. Como diria Corey D, "que Batch!" Essa grande bolinha de massa amanteigada, coberta com caramelo pegajoso, pode ter sido um dos melhores "morning buns" que já comi... acredite, já comi muitos. Este pode até rivalizar com o Simma's em Milwaukee. Isso sozinho já justificaria 10 estrelas, mas, infelizmente, o Yelp só permite cinco! Preciso experimentar uma de suas opções salgadas e um pão de challah na próxima vez que estiver na cidade!
original: I completely forgot how awesome Batch was until a recent trip back to Madison. I was pleased that they finally relocated to the bigger storefront, which to me meant that they'd likely have more goodies to offer. I was not disappointed. I've had numerous great items in the past from Batch, from their baguettes to the popular monkey bread. One of my favorite pastries since I was a kid was the "morning bun." I was like a little kid in a candy store when I saw that Batch had one of their own on my recent stop. As what Corey D woul say, "son of a batch!" This big buttery ball of goodness topped with gooey caramel may have been one of the best morning buns I had ever eaten........believe me, I've eaten many. This one may actually rival Simma's in Milwaukee. This alone would warrant 10 stars, but damn Yelp only allows five! I need to try one of their savory offerings and a loaf of challah the next time I'm in town!

text: Esta sorveteria, localizada no Memorial Union da Universidade do Wisconsin, serve sorvete da Babcock Hall, que parece ser muito famoso na região. Não me surpreende: o sorvete é realmente muito bom. Minha esposa escolheu o sorvete de chocolate com pedaços de laranja em um coninho de açúcar e elogiou muito; o meu sorvete com pedaços de biscoito também estava bom, mas não tão especial quanto o dela. Minha avaliação de cinco estrelas se baseia não apenas na qualidade do sorvete, mas também no custo-benefício: nossos coninhos custaram apenas US$ 2,60 cada, o que é mais do que razoável, considerando o tamanho generoso que recebemos. O local também é agradável: você pode levar seus coninhos para fora e sentar na varanda do M.U., que oferece uma vista deslumbrante do lago. Vale a pena a visita.
original: This ice cream store, located in the University of Wisconsin Memorial Union, serves Babcock Hall ice cream, which appears to be locally famous. I'm not surprised: it's really very good. My wife had the orange custard chocolate chip in a sugar cone and raved about it; my chocolate chip cookie dough was quite good but not as unusual as hers. My five-star rating is based not only on quality of the ice cream but on value for money: our cones were only $2.60 each, which is more than reasonable given the very good-sized scoop we each got. The locale is also nice: you can take your cones outside and sit on the M.U. terrace, which has a splendid view of the lake. Well worth a visit.

text: Clevelanders embriagados, saindo de festas e bares por toda a região leste, acabam seguindo o olfato até a padaria Presti, em Little Italy, por volta das 2h e 3h da manhã. Eles são atraídos pelos aromas doces e quentes que emanam do processo de produção de donuts frescos. Assim como os donuts da Bob's, em San Francisco, estes donuts são irresistíveis, capazes de atrair as pessoas de um carro quente em uma noite de neve, vento forte e inverno escuro na costa norte, para caminhar pelos bancos de neve em direção ao paraíso açucarado, na forma de um donut quente.
original: Drunken Clevelanders emerging from parties and bars all over the east side find themselves following their noses to Presti's bakery in Little Italy at 2 and 3 am. They're following the sweet warm vapors emitted by the making of fresh donuts. Like Bob's on Polk in San Francisco, these donuts are evil in their ability to lure you out of a warm car on the snowiest rainiest windiest night in a dark North Coast winter to tromp through the icy drifts toward sweet glazed nirvana in the form of a hot donut.

text: Gracias, Villani's Bakery, por crear los postres de boda más deliciosos. Nos sentimos las novias y los novios más felices de poder disfrutar de todos nuestros postres favoritos en la mejor panadería de Charlotte. Villani's siempre cuenta con un personal amable y divertido que hace que la experiencia de disfrutar de postres deliciosos sea aún mejor de lo que se puede imaginar.
original: Thank you Villani's Bakery for making the most delicious wedding desserts! We were the happiest bride and groom to be able to eat all our favorites from the best bakery in Charlotte. Villani's always has pleasant and fun staff who make the excitement of decadent desserts an even better experience then you could imagine a case full of sweets could be.

text: Em geral, é um bom lugar para ir ocasionalmente. O serviço tem diminuído um pouco nos últimos meses, não tenho certeza do motivo.
original: Generally, a good place to go on occasion. Service has gone a bit downhill in the past year or so, not sure why.

text: Vine aquí porque realmente quería probar sus donas. Está en el centro de la ciudad y el aparcamiento no era muy cómodo, pero gracias a los aparcamientos pude entrar y salir. Es una tienda de donas encantadora. Es pequeña por dentro y entras y te colocas en la cola para pedir. Pedí dos donas de crema brûlée y también una de Nutella. La dona de Nutella costó $4 y la de crema brûlée $2. Definitivamente, precios razonables. Diría que me encantan las donas de crema brûlée. Son mi favoritas y también me gustó la de Nutella, pero sin duda, las de crema brûlée son las que más me gustan. Definitivamente volveré aquí.
original: Came here because I really wanted to try their donuts. It's in downtown and parking wasn't that convenient but thanks for the meters I got in and out. It's a cute donut shop. It's small inside and you go in and get in line to order. I got 2 creme brÃ»lÃ©e donuts and I also got the Nutella donut. The Nutella donut was $4 and the creme brÃ»lÃ©e was $2. Definitely reasonable prices. I would have to say I love love love the creme brÃ»lÃ©e donut. It's my favorite and I loved the Nutella one too but creme brÃ»lÃ©e definitely has my heart. I will definitely come back here for sure.

text: A comida é fantástica, adoro a atmosfera francesa eclética. No entanto, a espera costuma ser longa, mas é definitivamente suportável. Amélie's é um dos meus lugares favoritos.
original: Food is fantastic, I absolutely love the eclectic French atmosphere. Most of the time however the wait is quite long but it's definitely manageable. Amelie's is one of my favorite go-to's.

text: I wanted to try this bakery after watching him compete with Duff on the food channel. The shop has a lot of pretty baked goods. A sales person takes your order and the back staff packages it while you head over to the cashier. We shared a regular cannoli. The ricotta filling was very thick like a NY cheesecake. I still prefer the creamy filling from the Modern Pastry ship in Boston. The cookie shell was good and crispy but thick. Wished we had time to try the cakes.

Eu ouvi falar do nome antes, mas ele é conhecido por ter padrões muito elevados e uma ótima reputação. Como não podíamos todos pagar pelo lugar original, fomos até a padaria, que fica bem em frente ao Teatro Fantasma da Ópera. Estava por volta do horário do café da manhã, então comprei um croissant e um biscoito de bolo de cenoura. O croissant estava muito macio e com muito sabor de manteiga. Também gostei do biscoito de bolo de cenoura, mas é bastante doce. Não consegui comer tudo de uma vez, então guardei um pouco para depois. Pensei em voltar para comprar alguns macarons – são os maiores que já vi – mas acabei não voltando, então isso será para a próxima vez. *Atualização* Finalmente experimentei os macarons de baunilha e framboesa. Deliciosos! Macios, com bastante recheio e cheios de sabor. São maiores do que os macarons pequenos que se servem em muitos outros lugares, mas custam aproximadamente os mesmos $3.
original: I've only heard the name before but it comes with very high standards and a great reputation. Since we couldn't all afford the real deal, we stopped by the bakery which is right across from the Phantom of the Opera Theater. It was around breakfast time so I got a croissant and the carrot cake cookie. The croissant was so soft and buttery. I liked the carrot cake cookie too but it's a lot of sugar. I couldn't finish it all in one sitting so I saved some for later. I thought I would be back to get some macaroons - they are the hugest I've ever seen - but I never made it back so that's something to get next time. *Update* Finally tried the vanilla and raspberry macaroons. Delicious! Soft with lots of filling and full of flavor. These are bigger than those bite sized macaroons they serve at a lot of other places but about the same price at $3.

text: O Las Vegas Donut Bar é um dos melhores lugares para comer donuts. Oferece tanto donuts clássicos quanto criações inovadoras, e o atendimento é muito simpático. Com certeza voltarei quando estiver em Las Vegas! #deadliftsanddonuts
original: The Las Vegas Donut Bar is one of the best donut places anywhere. It offers both classic and creative donut creations and the bonus is the friendly service. I will definitely come back when I am in Vegas! #deadliftsanddonuts

text: Amazing cupcakes! My favorite was all of them! Even vanilla was good!!! The cupcake ATM was cool and cupcakes tasted just as fresh as if ordered from inside.

Our favorite place for dessert! The flavor varieties are outstanding and make choosing your flavor difficult. We love the fact the size is by weight so you can select multiple flavors even with a single.

El pan y los productos de taro son deliciosos. ¡De verdad, taro en el centro! El té con leche y caramelo también estaba perfecto, no demasiado dulce. El pan brioche también era exquisito. Era ligero y con mantequilla. ¡Definitivamente volveremos! Hay mucho espacio para sentarse, los precios son buenos, el servicio es rápido y todo está recién hecho.
original: The Taro bread and pastry is sooo delicious! Real taro in the center!! Carmel milk tea was perfect as well, not too sweet. The brioche bread was mouth watering as well! It was light and buttery. We are definitely coming back. Plenty of room to sit, prices are good, quick service, and everything is fresh!!

text: I think this review is going to be along the same lines as everyone else. I was hankering for some sweets late at night, ok it wasn't that late, maybe 8 or so, and I looked for some dessert spots. Turns out we weren't too far from AmÃ©lie's French Bakery. I hate parking so I looked them up on Google Maps before heading out and saw they had a parking lot right in front so I figured it wouldn't be too bad and I was right, we found a spot right away. The line was long. It did wrap around and through 2 rooms. It also moved fast. I timed it, because why not? It took 25 minutes from walking in to walking out. That's not bad at all. I got to hear a lovely (not) conversation behind me, so it was interesting to say the least. The space is super cute and cozy, though we got ours to go. I can see why people would like to come here and work or hang out with friends. We ordered a variety of desserts. Lemon & raspberry meringue; salted caramel & espresso torts; salted caramel brownie; 2 macaroons; 2 chocolate croissants for the following morning. The best thing was the Lemon & Raspberry meringue. The worst things were the macaroons. The torts were excellent and the salted caramel brownie was just okay. The croissants were pretty good though. I think I am biased though. My heritage is French and my mom is an excellent baker, so things first get judged by how my mom makes them and secondly by a place in my hometown that made a croquembouche for my wedding, who is directly from France. His macaroons are the best things I've ever had. I think my expectations were too high for a place that is always packed and is open 24hrs. I think their quality suffers because of the quantity they need to produce to keep up with demand. It did however meet the "late night desserts" urge that I had!

¡Sabores muy interesantes! Yo pedí el Cap'n Crunch (probé los Fruity Pebbles y el pastel de cumpleaños), mi amigo pidió uno de chocolate con chispas de chocolate (principalmente chocolate), y mi novio pidió un brownie dulce y salado. Vienen en pequeñas cajas de comida china para llevar, que no me gustan mucho porque siento que van a derramarse cuando se derritan. El aparcamiento es terrible, pero encontré un sitio decente después de dar una vuelta por la manzana. Y el edificio es una casa reformada que puede albergar a unas 6 personas a la vez. Sin embargo, hay mucho espacio para sentarse afuera. Aunque, debo decir que este lugar es increíblemente popular tanto para adultos como para niños.
original: Very interesting flavors! I got the Cap'n Crunch (tried fruity pebbles and birthday cake), my friend got chocolate chip-mostly chocolate, and my bf got sweet and salty brownie. They come in little Chinese food take out boxes which I don't really like because I feel like it's gonna leak out when it Melts. The parking is atrocious but I found a decent spot after circling the block once. And the building is a renovated house that fits maybe 6 thin customers at once. Lots of outside seating though. I will say this place is insanely popular though for adult and kids.

text: Paguei 6,50 dólares por um copo de sobremesa e também paguei mais 1 dólar por um marshmallow tostado. O Fatty Daddy oferece sabores de sorvete e macarons bastante comuns; nada muito original ou exótico. Quanto ao sorvete, eles estavam quase sem Nutella; não havia o suficiente para fazer um copo, mas ainda assim experimentei e achei bom. Estavam sem o macaron de caramelo e não queria de baunilha ou morango. Não sou fã de coco, e sei que os "Fruity Pebbles" são populares, mas nunca fui um grande fã. Minha única opção restante era o red velvet. O caramelo salgado costuma ser uma das minhas escolhas, então nem sequer pensei em experimentar primeiro. Pensei que combinaria bem com o macaron de red velvet, então optei por ele. Claro, precisei adicionar um marshmallow tostado para dar um toque especial. Gostei do conceito do copo de sobremesa e aprecio o que eles estão tentando fazer. No entanto, estava muito doce para mim... e eu tenho um grande apetite por doces. O sorvete de caramelo salgado não tinha um sabor agradável. Foi uma decepção, especialmente considerando o preço. Mas, se você está fazendo isso para as redes sociais, pode ir, mas não espere uma experiência surpreendente. No entanto, devo dizer que a pessoa lá foi muito simpática e os outros sabores que experimentamos foram bastante gostosos.
original: I got a cookie cup for $6.50 plus paid an extra $1 for a toasted marshmallow. Fatty Daddy pretty much has your standard flavors for ice cream and macarons; nothing too unique or exotic. For the ice cream, they were close to selling out of nutella; not enough to make a cup but I still sampled it and thought it was good. They were sold out of the caramel macaron and I didn't want vanilla or strawberry. I'm not a fan of coconut and I know fruity pebbles is trendy, but I was never fan of it, either. My only option left was red velvet. Salted caramel is usually one of my go-to's so I didn't even think about sampling it first. I thought it should go well with the red velvet macaron, so I went with it. Off course I had to add a toasted marshmallow for extra effect. I liked the concept of the cookie cup and appreciate what they're trying to do. It was just way too sweet for me...and I have a huge sweet tooth. The salted caramel ice cream didn't even taste good. It was a disappointment, especially for how much it costs. I say if you're doing it for the 'gram, go for it, but don't expect to be blown away. I do have to say though that the person there was very friendly and the other flavors we did try were pretty tasty.

text: ¡Pasteles y productos de temporada increíbles! Una variedad de opciones de té. Un buen lugar para estudiar o para tomar algo por la noche. Definitivamente lo recomendaría.
original: Amazing pastries and seasonal items! A variety of tea options. A good spot for studying or late night snacks. Would recommend this spot for sure!

text: No words for this deliciousness. At least four types of vegan donuts every day - not sure which is my fav because they're all so incredibly good. It is an honor to pay $3 each for these donuts :-)

You literally cannot beat Mitchell's ice cream. I eat it daily (hate to admit it?).. I buy it at the local grocery stores as well. Favorite flavors include the seasonal campfire s'mores and cold brew. Also love ALL the vegan flavors.. even the "plain" chocolate.. seriously the best chocolate ice cream I've ever had. If you haven't tried Mitchell's yet, you are waaay behind the times. Get there ASAP!!

El mejor postre de Presti es su tarta de frutas con crema (solo los fines de semana). Los cannoli son aceptables, pero si los compras más tarde, tienden a estar blandos y fríos. Los demás postres varían según su frescura. Sin embargo, Presti sigue sirviendo postres que ya no están en su mejor momento, lo cual es sorprendente. Fui mucho a este lugar durante este semestre debido a su excelente ambiente. Es mi "lugar feliz" en Cleveland. Aunque la comida para el almuerzo es atractiva al verla a través del cristal, necesita algunas mejoras. No se trata de grandes cambios, sino de pequeños detalles, como añadir sal, especias, evitar que la pasta se remoje en su propia salsa durante horas, o poner suficiente relleno en los strombolis. Cuando tienen los sándwiches disponibles, ¡compra! Son posiblemente el único elemento delicioso en el menú del almuerzo. Mi postre favorito. El café es horrible: insípido, con pequeñas manchas aceitosas flotando en la superficie. El té es aceptable, y tienen una buena variedad. A mi hermano pequeño le encanta el chocolate caliente con nata. En su defensa, a pesar de algunos alimentos cuestionables, el servicio de Presti es excelente. Me encanta la señora mayor con cabello rubio y una gran sonrisa. Siempre están dispuestos a ayudar, y eso es suficiente para que regrese una y otra vez. Visito el lugar constantemente, y solo he encontrado una excepción a la regla: un camarero más joven, de cabello oscuro y con una actitud muy mala (una vez le pedí que calentara mi pastel de pollo, que estaba helado, y lo sobrecocinó, lo olvidó y luego me lo tiró cuando le pedí que me lo devolviera sin disculparse. Supongo que tuvo un mal día, o simplemente es una mala persona). He evitado a ese camarero desde entonces. Si soy honesto conmigo mismo, aunque me encanta Presti y regreso con frecuencia, no creo que sobreviva si tuviera más competencia. Necesitan repensar su menú de almuerzo, o dejar de ofrecerlo. Y si los postres están viejos, no los vendas. No vale la pena dañar tu reputación. La única competencia viable para ellos es Corbo's, que está justo en la calle, pero no es suficiente para provocar un cambio significativo.
original: Presti's best dessert is their custard fruit tart (weekends only). Cannoli is okay, but if you get it later in the day, it tends to be soggy and cold. The other desserts vary depending on freshness. But it's not above Presti's to still serve stale desserts well after their prime time. I came here a lot this semester because of the great atmosphere. It's my "happy place" in Cleveland. Their lunch foods, though appealing from behind the glass, NEED some improvement. It's not even big changes - little things, like actually adding salt, spices, not having the pasta soak in its own sauce for hours, or putting enough filling in the strombolis. When they have the sandwiches out, get them! They're possibly the only certain delicious item on the lunch menu! Personal favorite. Coffee is yucky! Bland, with little suspicious pools of oil floating on top. Tea is okay though, and they have a respectable selection. My little brother loves their hot chocolate topped with whip. To their credit, despite some questionable foods, Presti's service is TOPS. I love the older lady with blonde hair and a big smile. They are always happy to help, and that is enough to bring me back time and time again. I visit all the time, and have only met one exception to the rule: a younger, dark-haired male server with a very bad attitude (I once asked him to re-heat my ice-cold chicken pot pie, and he over-cooked it, forgot about it, and then tossed it at me when I asked for it back without an apology! Bad day for him, I guess, or he's just an ass. Have avoided him since.) If I'm honest with myself, though I love Presti's and come back often, I don't think it would survive if it had a little more competition. They have to rethink their lunch menu, or not offer lunch at all. And if the desserts are stale, don't sell them. It isn't worth damaging your reputation. The only viable competition for them is Corbo's up the street - not enough to catalyze any serious change.

text: Sou um grande fã do iogurte, das tortas e dos croissants caseiros deles. É um ótimo lugar para tomar um café da manhã ou almoço rápido quando estiver hospedado no Venetian ou no Palazzo, e quando não tiver tempo para ir ao restaurante Bouchon, que fica no andar de cima. É possível perceber que eles utilizam ingredientes de alta qualidade em tudo.
original: I'm a huge fan of their home made yogurt, tarts, and crossants. It is a good place to get a quick breakfast or lunch when staying at the Venetian or Palazzo and you don't have time to go up to the Bouchon restaurant upstairs. You can defenitely taste that they use high quality ingredients in everything.

text: The couple of experiences I've had here have all been positive. The lines are long of course but what do you expect? They're highly sought after. (The line is formed against the side and there's windows so you can see inside the bakery which is pretty cool while waiting). It's also alllll the way towards the end of the strip so it can be a walk if you stayed in the middle. If you really want to give the place a taste than the wait shouldn't be a problem considering everyone else is there trying to do the same, it's just about being courteous. Anywho I LOVED everything I tried so far (I will be back ahah) but my favorite treat are the cannolis omg they are so great, good crunch, yummy filling and I love the little chocolate chips and chocolate dip on my ends. Buddy was there on one of the days I went and I felt the passion in his work and I'm not just being a fan he's a hard worker, you can sense integrity.

Vocês precisam experimentar este lugar! Estou muito feliz por ter ido e mal posso esperar para experimentar mais delícias daqui. Minha primeira experiência foi com uma torta de ovos – simplesmente divina! Era tão saborosa e macia, com uma crosta perfeita. Nossa! E o tamanho? Perfeito! Uma ótima sobremesa para finalizar um dia agitado. Com certeza voltarei para experimentar o café e outros produtos de confeitaria. Nota 10 em tudo!
original: You must try this place! I'm glad I did and can't wait to try more goodies from this place. My first try was an egg tart from here--heavenly custard!! It was so tasty and smooth with a perfect flaky crust. Oh. My. God. And, it's size? Perfect! A great treat to cap off a busy day. I'm definitely going to be back to try their coffee and other bakery items. A++++ all around!

text: Bueno, obviamente es un lugar muy famoso por sus excelentes pasteles, sándwiches, sopas y bebidas. Este lugar es muy especial para mí y mi esposa, y tenemos muchos recuerdos hermosos aquí. El hecho de que esté abierto las 24 horas del día, los 7 días de la semana, le añade un valor adicional. Mis favoritos son el brownie de caramelo salado, el pastel de chocolate, el sándwich de pollo, el pastel de almendras (delicioso) y el latte de té Chai con leche de soja. Este fue el primer lugar donde probamos el latte de té Chai con leche de soja, y ese sabor se ha convertido en algo habitual. Sin duda, el ambiente te da una sensación francesa, o al menos aprenderás a apreciar los sabores franceses. Los viernes y sábados por la noche suele estar muy concurrido, ya que mucha gente viene aquí para disfrutar de sus comidas favoritas después de una fiesta. Además, gracias al wifi, es un lugar ideal para trabajar o estudiar. Si te gustan los pasteles, es un lugar imprescindible en Charlotte.
original: Well, it obviously a very famous place for their great pastries, sandwiches, soups, beverages. This place is very special for me and my wife and have had great memories here. It being 24x7 operational, adds more value to itself. My fav are the most familiar Salted Caramel Brownie, chocolate gateaux, chicken salad sandwich, almond cake (to die for), and Chai tea latte. This is the first place where we tried Chai tea latte with soy milk and that taste has become a standard. The ambience for sure gives you a French feel or at least you will learn the French taste. Friday and Saturday late nights are always pretty crowded as lot of people come here for their favorite bites after party. With wifi it's a great place to work/study as well. A must go in Charlotte if you like pastries :)

text: ¡Me encanta esta panadería! El brownie de caramelo salado es increíble. Los macarons son deliciosos. La sopa de cebolla era muy buena.
original: I love this bakery! The salted caramel brownie is amazing. Macaroons are delicious! Leek soup was good

text: ¡Tantos sabores de helado fresco, cremoso y suave! ¡El "Mint Avalanche" fue increíble! Me gustaría quedarme más tiempo en Madison para probar más sabores.
original: So many flavors of fresh, stretchy & creamy ice cream!!!! Mint Avalanche was amazing! Wish I could stay in Madison longer to try more flavors.

text: New n just opened. I was excited because I have been to the Austin Texas location N loved.it. This place was small n not enough sitting place if you want to eat there. A lot of selections n price d good What turned me off is When I ordered coffee I ask for my cream which they did but charged me $3,35 for a cup no refill. Black coffee is $3.00 .And automatically add 35 cents when u asked for cream n sugar which they will add themselves. Who does that?????? I understand the no refill but cream only on my part nooooo way.

when you're hungover and you need some sugar clap your hands *clap clap* I've had the pleasure of trying MILK Bar in NYC when they first opened up and I was hooked. It was my go-to must thing every time I went for a visit. And then we ended up in Vegas and I was like I can fly over for $39 and get myself some crack pie and shakes. Mmmhhmm yes you can girl. We ended up getting Egg Slut for breakfast and having MB for dessert and 'tis is what I call a good morning. There wasn't a wait which was great cause I saw it the day before and it was wrapped around the corner like say what. I also got their birthday cake bites which are super dense and packed with flavor. And you can't go to MB and not get a milkshake so I got coffee shot added in mine (birthday cake + coffee). Nailed it!

¡Postres encantadores y asombrosos! Me encanta el brownie de chocolate con sal, perfecto para los amantes del chocolate. Los macarons son pequeñas y esponjosas delicias, como un pedacito del cielo. También me gustan sus sándwiches, croissants, quiches, ensaladas, tés con sabores del día y café (y tienen leche de almendras para quienes tienen intolerancia a la lactosa). No puedo pensar en algo que no me guste de su menú. Además, me encantan la decoración original. Y después de visitar París, puedo decir que sus postres cumplen con todas las expectativas.
original: Lovely and amazing desserts! I adore the salted carmel brownie for true chocolate lovers. The macarons are light and sugary fluffy bits of dessert heaven. I like their sandwiches, croissants, quiches, salads, teas with flavor of the day, coffee (and they have almond milk for us lactose intolerant peeps). I cannot think of one thing I do not love to eat on their menu. I enjoy the quirky decorations too. And after visiting Paris, I can say their desserts definitely live up to the inspiration!

text: Como futura mãe, a fome chega rapidamente, mesmo quando menos se espera. Estávamos tão ocupados explorando as atrações e os sons do Strip que perdemos a noção do horário do jantar. A náusea e a tontura começaram antes que eu soubesse o que fazer. Meu marido, com sua rápida capacidade de pensar, disse: "Vamos pegar um cupcake, já que não conseguimos decidir em qual restaurante jantar e ainda teríamos que esperar pela comida depois de pedir". Ele me conhecia muito bem. Eu escolhi um cupcake de chocolate escuro com granulado (óbvio) e foi incrível como rapidamente me senti melhor. Claro, os cupcakes podem fazer isso, mesmo que você não esteja grávida e com fome.
original: Being a mama to be, hunger strikes quickly when you least expect it. We were so busy exploring the sights and sounds of the Strip that we lost track of dinner time. Nausea and light-headedness kicked in before I knew what to do. My quick thinking husband said, "Let's get you a cupcake since we can't decide on a restaurant to eat at and we would still have to wait for the food once ordered." He knew me too well. I chose a dark chocolate cupcake with sprinkles (naturally) and it was magical how quickly I felt better of course cupcakes can do that to you even if you're not pregnant and hungry.

text: No soy un experto en cupcakes. Disfruto viendo "Cupcake Wars" cuando está en televisión, y no tenía ni idea de que este lugar era propiedad de alguien que aparece en el programa. Eso no habría cambiado nada para mí. La cola era demasiado larga, así que decidimos usar el cajero automático que había cerca. ¡Qué idea tan adorable! Compramos cupcakes de chocolate con malvavisco, de "red velvet" y de chocolate con vainilla... o algo parecido. Todos estaban deliciosos. ¡Enhorabuena! Por fin, un lugar que compite con "The Cupcakery"! Espero volver pronto.
original: I'm no cupcake connoisseur. I enjoy watching Cupcake Wars when it's on, had not a clue this place was owned by someone on the show. It wouldn't have made a difference to me. The line was too long for us to put up with, so we chose to utilize the ATM around the corner. What an adorable idea! We got chocolate marshmallow, red velvet and vanilla chocolate...or something like that. They were all delicious. Thumbs up. Finally a place to rival The Cupcakery! Looking forward to coming back soon.

text: Carlos bakery is my favorite bakery. I had been dying to go to this place for the longest time. The lines are always very long everytime I had gone. And the place is pretty dang hard to find in the Venetian! I had tried to figure out the best times to go, as sometimes I'd go on a Friday at noon and understandably they are packed. I mean packed. I mean a line like a ride at a theme park. Today however, ahhhh today was different. Today was MY day. Today was the day that I would get to eat baked goods from the great cake boss. I decided who would go on a Wednesday at 4pm? Boom. Only a short line. I looked for about 10 minutes and there was so many decisions. These are big decisions. Not life or death obviously. But big in my mind. So....I got the carrot cake and 2 red velvet cupcakes. It came to about $15 which is expensive but also fair. They put them in a nice little box so I could take it home and enjoy. I don't have much else to say about the place. It is well maintained, clean, and the people are friendly. You can see the workers in the window working on the food. Now how were the baked goods? Delicious! They were among my favorite for the red velvet cupcakes. And the carrot cake was superb as well. Like I . But like I said the lines can be crazy long and finding the place is quite a challenge. So my advice, go there, and if the line is tooooooo long then come back another time. Like say Wednesday around 4pm.

Cupcakes deliciosíssimos! Sempre quis experimentar um cupcake da Sprinkles, mas não encontrava nenhuma loja na minha região. Depois de viajar para Las Vegas, agora posso dizer com prazer que experimentei o sabor deles :) (No entanto, já experimentei chocolates melhores;).
original: Really yummy cupcakes! I've always to try a Sprinkles cupcake, but there just weren't any shops in my area. After traveling to Vegas, I can now gladly say that I got to experience the taste of them:) (I've had better chocolate ones, though;)

text: Este lugar no cumplió con las expectativas y estaba sobrevalorado. La única ventaja es que el personal es amable y eficiente. A pesar de esto, había largas colas y una larga espera. Pedí una porción de pastel de queso de vainilla roja. En cambio, me dieron un cupcake de vainilla roja. Todo estaba preenvasado, así que no me di cuenta hasta que volví al hotel. El sabor era TERRIBLE. Normalmente me encanta el pastel de vainilla roja, pero este estaba seco y el glaseado era extremadamente salado. Nunca antes había probado un cupcake de vainilla roja tan desagradable. Si estás buscando una pastelería, evita este lugar.
original: This place was underwhelming and over hyped. The only pros are the staff are friendly and efficient. Despite this, lines were long and there was a long wait. I ordered a red velvet cheesecake slice. Instead, they gave me a red velvet cupcake. Everything is prepackaged so I had no idea until I got back to the hotel. It tasted AWFUL. I usually love red velvet but it was dry and the icing was extremely salty. I have never had a red velvet cupcake so gross. If you are looking for a bakery, skip this one.

text: Probamos su croissant, pan de focaccia con queso feta y tomates, y macarons de vainilla con pistachos. Su croissant estaba bien, pero no espectacular; no tenía un sabor realmente fresco y el interior no era tan cremoso como me gusta. Su pan de focaccia estaba bueno, lo calentaron para nosotros y tenía un delicioso pesto dentro. Sus macarons de vainilla eran deliciosos!!! Mucho mejores que los de pistacho.
original: We got their croissant, focaccia bread with feta cheese and tomatoes, and vanilla bean macaron and pistachio maracons. Their croissant was OK, not great, it didn't taste really fresh and the inside wasn't as buttery as I prefer. Their focaccia bread was good, they warmed it for us and there was a nice pesto soaked into the bread. Their vanilla bean macaron was delicious!!! Much better than the pistachio one.

text: Went to Jack Frost 04/30/2020. Business open. Store was closed 2 eeeks before due to Covid 19. Store has updated with plexiglass, distancing spacing & line marking. Looks really good & safe as practical under Covid 19 regulations. Will return. Same tasty donuts.
Helado de buena calidad, gente amable, lugar encantador. Me gusta el ambiente. A veces, encontrar aparcamiento puede ser difícil.
original: Good ice cream, nice people, cute place. I like The environment. Sometimes it's hard to find parking though.

text: Meu Deus! Tenho receio de afirmar algo como "o melhor", mas este é, sem dúvida, o sorvete mais delicioso que já provei. Eu pedi um cono de chocolate com nozes pecan e outro cono de waffle com banana. Adoro os conos de waffle, mas eles também são a opção mais segura aqui – os conos de açúcar comuns não são grandes o suficiente para suportar adequadamente os sorvetes. Sabor: rico e com ingredientes de verdade. O cono de banana continha pedaços de banana reais e tinha o sabor de banana de verdade. O cono de chocolate com nozes pecan continha metades inteiras de nozes pecan salgadas, incorporadas em um chocolate cremoso e rico, de meia doçura. Doçura: não é enjoativa nem excessiva – o mel realmente proporciona a quantidade certa de doçura. Textura: não muito duro, nem muito mole, não derrete facilmente, refrescante, cremoso com uma textura ligeiramente gelada, sem causar aquela sensação de cabeça cheia. Preço: um pedido inclui 2 conos generosos por menos de $4. Público: fui em uma noite de domingo; as filas eram longas, mas o atendimento foi relativamente rápido. Este é um verdadeiro tesouro de uma pequena empresa, que nenhuma cadeia conseguiria replicar. A qualidade é até melhor do que meus sorvetes favoritos de lojas, como Ben & Jerry's e Movenpick. Só gostaria que houvesse uma maneira de enviar alguns litros de volta para meus amigos em Los Angeles! Com certeza voltarei para experimentar os sabores especiais de cada mês – mal posso esperar para experimentar os sabores de canela, abóbora e café em outubro!
original: Holy crap. I'm hesitant to declare anything the best, but this is seriously the best ice cream I've ever had. I ordered one scoop Chocolate Pecan, one scoop Banana on a waffle cone. I love waffle cones, but they're also the more structurally sound choice here--the scoops are really too large to be adequately supported on the regular sugar cone. Flavor: full and with real ingredients. The banana scoop had actual bits of banana and tasted like real banana. The chocolate pecan had entire salted pecan halves embedded throughout creamy, rich semisweet chocolate. Sweetness: not cloying or overwhelming--honey really does give just the right amount of sweetness. Texture: not too hard but not too soft, didn't melt easily, refreshing, creamy with slightly icy texture without inducing brain freeze Price: one order comes with 2 generous scoops for under $4. Crowd: I went on a Sunday night; the lines were pretty long but it moved fairly quickly. This is a real mom-and-pop gem no chain can ever replicate. The quality even tops my all-time store-bought favorites, Ben and Jerry's and MÃ¶venpick. I only wish there were a way to send a couple quarts back to my peeps in LA! I'll definitely be back to try the monthly special flavors--can't wait till October to try their cinnamon, pumpkin, and coffee scoops!

text: Existe alguma maneira melhor de ganhar alguns quilos extras depois do jantar no Windsor? A solução é ir para a Churn, que fica ao lado! Eu estava muito satisfeito após o jantar, mas não consegui resistir aos sabores únicos de sorvete, doces retrô, brinquedos antigos/engraçados e outras delícias da padaria que estavam expostos na Churn. Minha sobrinha comeu o sorvete de pêssego com mel. Ela não gostou muito. O mel puro dominou o sabor do pêssego, o que soava bom, mas ficou muito doce. Eu comi o tradicional sorvete de manteiga com nozes. Você escolhe entre os biscoitos assados na balcão e o sabor do sorvete. Infelizmente, o sorvete não estava congelado, então derreteu muito rápido em um dia quente de verão. Provavelmente, esperarei até que esteja um pouco mais fresco para experimentar outros sabores em um cone de pretzel.
original: What is there a better way to gain couple more pounds after dinner at Windsor, go next door to Churn! I was so full after dinner, but couldn't resist the unique ice cream flavors, retro candies, vintage/silly toys, and bakery goodies all displayed around Churn. My Niece had the Peach and Honey ice cream. She didn't like it at all. The pure honey overpowered the peach taste, which sounded good but was too sweet. I had the traditional butter pecan ice cream sandwich. You get to select from the baked cookies on the counter and the ice cream flavor. Unfortunately, the ice cream wasn't frozen so it melted too quickly on a hot summer day. I will probably wait until it's a little cooler to try other flavors on a pretzel cone.

text: Si no está seguro de qué sabor elegir, la opción de la muestra de 4 sabores es ideal. ¡Todavía no hemos encontrado ningún sabor que no nos haya gustado!
original: If you can't decide the 4-scoop sampler is the way to go. Have yet to have a flavor we didn't like!!

text: El puesto de donuts no era algo que hubiéramos planeado visitar, especialmente considerando la hora del día, pero decidimos tomar un café y un donut. ¡Nos alegra que lo hicimos! Compramos un donut relleno de Oreo, ¡y estaba delicioso! No solo tenía el tamaño adecuado y no era demasiado grande, sino que combinaba muy bien con el café. Mi esposo se quedó con un donut al día siguiente y dijo que el otro donut no era tan bueno al segundo día, pero creo que lo mejor es comerlos frescos temprano en el día, especialmente cuando hay más variedad. El lugar es un poco pequeño, pero no es como sentarse y comer donuts en Dunkin' Donuts; los llevamos para llevarnos. Espero probar otros donuts la próxima vez que estemos en Las Vegas.
original: The Donut Bar was not something we had planned to visit, especially given the time of day but we decided to get some coffee and a donut. Glad we did! We got the donut stuffed with oreo and it was DELISH! Not only was it the right size and not too much donut, it paired very well with the coffee. My husband had a donut left the next day and he said the other donut wasn't as good the second day, but i think fresh is best earlier in the day - especially when there is a lot more variety. Location is a bit small but its not like you sit and eat donuts at dunkin donuts, we take them to go. I hope to try some other donuts next time we're in Vegas.

text: Quando se trata de padarias, a Presti's é uma das melhores, na minha opinião. Eles têm doces, biscoitos e uma variedade incrível de produtos deliciosos. Foi uma escolha natural quando fui convidada por uma amiga muito querida para levar doces para o jantar em memória do pai dela, que coincidentemente acontecia na vizinhança. Para deixar claro, a bandeja com 25 unidades de doces pequenos e a bandeja com 1,3 kg de biscoitos que pedi foram maravilhosas, e foram muito apreciadas pela família em um momento tão difícil. O meu objetivo era exatamente esse, e agradeço à Presti's por terem atendido. A minha crítica se refere às pessoas que trabalham no balcão. Quando cheguei, havia várias pessoas, mas não consegui identificar uma fila. Como eu tinha um horário específico (13:00, mas era 12:45 – já havia informado sobre a situação com antecedência), e já havia pago, perguntei a um funcionário do balcão onde deveria ir para retirar o meu pedido. Tenho que dizer que já estive em melhores lugares, considerando que tínhamos acabado de sair do cemitério de Lakeview em circunstâncias extremamente tristes, eu estava congelada, havia chorado muito, e estava estacionada ilegalmente. A mulher que respondeu praticamente me repreendeu por não ter tirado um número, como se eu fosse uma criança. É raro encontrar tal desprezo de um estranho, mas consegui de sua parte. Apenas por ter feito uma pergunta. Ok... então peguei um número. E esperei. E esperei. Havia pelo menos 4 pessoas atrás do balcão, e um cliente chegava para fazer um pedido de vez em quando. Todos me ignoraram até que o meu número fosse chamado. Quando falei com o homem do balcão, informando que tinha um pedido pré-pago com o meu nome, senti que ele não estava muito interessado. Fui recebida com um "ainda estamos trabalhando nisso". Ok... passaram-se alguns minutos, e os funcionários corriam de um lado para o outro. Neste ponto, comecei a ficar preocupada, já que todos que vieram do cemitério já estavam no jantar há algum tempo. Finalmente, uma jovem simpática perguntou se eu havia sido atendida, e expliquei o que estava esperando. Ela disse que verificaria o status, e alguns minutos depois, outra mulher trouxe uma linda bandeja de cheesecakes e outros doces. Não sei qual foi a história, mas a atitude "não estou nem aí" que senti ao retirar o pedido foi a última coisa que esperava de uma instituição famosa em Cleveland. Estou muito consciente de que somos recompensados pelo que damos, e procuro tratar as pessoas com quem interajo com gentileza. Embora eu tenha chegado com o coração partido, não mereci a falta de educação que inicialmente recebi. Por isso, provavelmente pensarei duas vezes na próxima vez.
original: When it comes to bakeries, Presti's is one of the best, in my opinion. They have amazing pastries, cookies, and their entire food case is pure deliciousness. They were a natural choice when I was asked by a very dear friend to bring pastries to the memorial dinner for her father, which happened to be in the neighborhood. In full disclosure, the 25 pc small pastry tray and 3 lb cookie tray I ordered were a thing of beauty, and they were very much appreciated by the family in such a sad time. Ultimately, that was my goal, and I was grateful to Presti's for delivering. My criticism has to do with the folks working at the counter. When I arrived, there were several people milling around, but I didn't see a discernible line. Since I had a timed pick up (1:00, but it was 12:45 - I told them my circumstances in advance, knowing it may be a few minutes either way), and I was prepaid, I asked a counter employee where I should go to pick up my order. Mind you, I have been in better places in my life, seeing that we literally had just left Lakeview Cemetery under extremely sad circumstances, I was frozen to the bone, I had cried so many tears, and I was illegally parked. The woman who responded literally scolded me for not taking a number, like I was a child. It is rare to read such disdain from a stranger, but I got that from her. Just for asking a question. Ok...so I took a number. And I waited. And waited. There were no less than 4 people behind the counter, and a customer would come for an order every now and again. They all ignored me until my number was called. When I told the man behind the counter that I had a prepaid order under my name, I got the feeling that he couldn't be bothered. I got a "they're still working on it." Ok...minutes passed, and workers bustled to and fro. At this point, I'm starting to panic, since everyone from the cemetery had already been at the meal for awhile. Finally, a pleasant young woman asked me if I had been helped, and I told her what I was waiting for. She told me she would check on the status, and several minutes later, another woman brought out a lovely platter of small cheese cakes, etc. I don't know what the story was, but the "can't be bothered" hipster vibe I got from this pickup was the last thing I expected from a Cleveland institution. I am very aware that we get what we give, and I strive to treat the people I interact with kindness. While I arrived with a sad heart, I didn't deserve the coarseness I initially received. For that reason, I'll probably think twice next time.

text: Este lugar é INCRÍVEL! Foi a primeira vez que fui e não fiquei decepcionado. Experimentei os "s'mores" e estavam deliciosos! Com certeza vou experimentar o resto do que eles oferecem.
original: This place is AMAZING! first time there and I was not disappointed. I had the s'mores and it was delicious! I will be trying out the rest of what they have to offer for sure

text: Sem dúvida, este é um dos melhores lugares para comer sorvete em Charlotte. Além de oferecer os sabores tradicionais, eles também têm opções que você não encontra em outras sorveterias. Um exemplo disso é o "yum ee bun", que consiste em um pão de donut tostad recheado com o sabor e os acompanhamentos de sorvete que você desejar. Eles também oferecem milkshakes com cereais e praticamente qualquer variação de um lanche de sorvete tradicional que você possa imaginar. Além disso, têm sanduíches de macaron com sorvete, que é um dos meus favoritos. O local fica na orla, então você pode pegar um sorvete e fazer uma caminhada.
original: This is hands down one of the best ice cream places in Charlotte. Not only do they offer traditional treats, but they also have options that you won't find at other ice cream shops. An example of this is a yum ee bun which is any filling of ice cream and toppings you want, put inside a toasted donut bun. They also have cereal milkshakes and just about any spin on a traditional ice cream snack you could want. They also have macaron car cream sandwiches which is one of my personal favorites. It is located at the boardwalk, so you can grab a treat and take a stroll.

text: La verdad, no soy muy de postres, pero cuando probé el helado de leche de cereales, ¡no podía tomar suficiente! Si te gusta el helado simple o quieres elegir una opción segura, definitivamente prueba el helado de leche de cereales. Sin embargo, es bastante caro, lo que es un inconveniente, y no sería un lugar donde pueda ir a diario. Además, cierran a las 1 de la madrugada, lo cual también es una ventaja en comparación con otras heladerías.
original: I'm really not a dessert person but when I tried the cereal milk soft serve I couldn't get enough of it! If you like plain ice cream or want to pick a safe bet, definitely get the cereal milk soft serve. It is pretty expensive though which is the downside, and wouldn't be a place where I can stop by everyday. And they close at 1AM which is also a plus compared to other ice cream/dessert shops.

text: Excelente atendimento! Deliciosas guloseimas! Sou grande fã do programa e só descobri que estavam em Las Vegas quando começamos a explorar os hotéis. Definitivamente vale a pena uma visita! Experimente a massa folhada e o cheesecake, são excelentes! Gosto que possamos ver o processo de preparo pelas janelas.
original: Great service! Great treats! Big fan of the show and I didn't realize they were in Vegas until we started walking around the hotels. Definitely worth a stop! Try the puff pastry, and the cheesecake so good! I like that you can watch them baking from the windows

text: Milk Bar, located in the Cosmo, fittingly right next to momofuku, is a great spot to satisfy your sweet tooth! So many options - cookies, cake, crack pie, soft serve, cake pops, milkshakes. The best thing to get here is the soft serve hands down! You can split even the smaller size into 2 flavors and the best is the cereal milk and chocolate pretzel side by side. Add the corn flake crunch - they put it on the top/sides and there's a surprise layer on the bottom too! You will not be disappointed. Also delicious as an affogato and less sweet. Cookies are great to take on the go as they are packaged and you can also get a gift box to bring back as well. Unfortunately they also taste a bit like they are packaged too.
