Nonetheless, the best flavors are the corn cookie and compost cookie! The rest of the treats, like the crack pie or milkshakes, are good for a one time try or a taste but probably not as repeat orders since they are really super sweet.

i didn't have any of the pastries, but always grabbed an iced coffee.. either macchiato or americano w white choc. the iced coffees were flavorful, but a bit on the sweet side. but once the ice melted and watered it down... perfect. didn't see a starbucks in the venetian. no worries.. this was just as good, if not better!

ALWAYS DELICIOUS!! My favorite place for ice cream in the valley!! You have to try the pretzel cone and it goes well with just about any of the amazing flavors!! Fun little shop with tons and tons of yummy choices and the friendliest servers!!! If you are thinking about it, just do it! YUM :)
Estão simplesmente incríveis! Grande variedade de opções. Mais caro que Krispy Kreme ou Dunkin', mas os donuts são muito mais saborosos. Vá lá!!!
original: So freaking good! Great variety to choose from. More expensive than Krispy Kreme or Dunkin, but the doughnuts are so much better tasting. Go thete!!!

text: Érase una vez, había una panadería francesa que estaba abierta las 24 horas, los 7 días de la semana. ¡Guau, Charlotte, eres increíble! Una panadería, cafetería y tienda de pastelería francesa que funciona las 24 horas, los 7 días. Esto es el sueño de un estudiante de posgrado. Esto es el sueño de un amante de los macarrones. Esto es el paraíso de un adicto al café que no puede dormir. En serio. Visita este lugar. Come aquí. Estudia aquí. Duerme aquí. Sé feliz.
original: once upon a time there was a french bakery open all the time. Wow Charlotte, you are amazing. An amazing bakery, coffee shop, French open 24/7. This is a grad student dream. This is a macaroon lover-dream. This is a coffee drinker insomniac paradise. Seriously. Go here. Eat here. Study here. Sleep here. Be happy.

text: Aquí hay algo que seguramente satisfará el antojo de cualquier persona por los dulces. Helados, maltas, caramelos... ¡lo que se te ocurra!
original: There is something in here that is sure to satisfy anyone's sweet tooth! Ice cream, malts, candy - you name it!

text: Una sola palabra: ¡INCREÍBLE! He probado muchos donuts, pero estos valen la pena el viaje desde Medina.
original: One word.... AMAZING!!! I've tried a lot of donuts - these are worth the trip from Medina!

text: Olha, eu não quero criticar o Amelie's. Já houve muitas noites em que eu estava ansioso para conseguir um brownie de caramelo com sal. Eles sempre estão disponíveis quando você precisa. Literalmente, porque o Amelie's nunca fecha. Está aberto 24 horas por dia, 7 dias por semana. Se há algo que eles fazem muito bem, é isso. No entanto, devo dizer que a qualidade diminuiu. Quando vou agora, não fico surpreso quando recebo um éclair que não está tão fresco ou queimado. Isso faz parte do "Amelie's". E, claro, há todos os "hipster". Você terá que procurar um lugar para sentar, porque esses caras ocuparam todos os assentos do lugar. Pode ser um pouco irritante quando você só precisa de um lugar para estacionar por 10 minutos. Mas não, você precisa saborear seus doces e café e, em seguida, seguir em frente. Eles têm café, chá, sanduíches, sopas e muitos doces. Se você sentir vontade por volta das 18h, espere 5 horas e, em seguida, vá ao Amelie's - menos pessoas para enfrentar e, consequentemente, melhores doces.
original: Look, I don't want to hate on Amelie's. There have been plenty of nights where I couldn't wait to get my hands on a caramel salted brownie. They're always there when you need them. Quite literally, because Amelie's never closes. It's open 24/7. If there were anything they do really well, that would be it. I have to say, however, that the quality has gone down. When I go nowadays, I'm not surprised when I get a not-so-fresh or burned eclair. It's par for the Amelie's course. And then there are all of the hipsters. You'll need to scour the premises for somewhere to sit because these guys have taken up every seat in the place. Can be a little annoying when you just need somewhere to park it for 10 mins. But no, you must inhale your baked good and coffee and then move on with life. They have coffee, tea, sandwiches, soups, and plenty of sweets. If you get a craving around 6pm, wait 5 hours and then go to Amelie's - less people to fight through for mediocre pastries.

text: I stopped in here on a Saturday afternoon since I've been wanting to try this place since it has opened and I was in the area. The staff was very friendly. I took a look at the menu and decided to go with the Mucha Lucha. The only milk options they had that day were almond and whole so I went with almond. The shake was delicious and tasted just like Cinnamon Toast Crunch. I was in a sugar coma the rest of the afternoon!

It's my first time trying the Jack Frost Donuts. The place is a little small but what you expect from donut stores? The lady there was so friendly. She helped us to pick the donuts cause we got overwhelmed by tons of different donuts and flavors! I tried my first sprinkle donut out of a box of dozen I got, and it tasted like heaven! For sure I will come back for more. Even the peanut butter frost was totally mesmerized me! If you're a peanut butter lover then you should totally get the donut with the pb frost. Speaking of frost, the frost they have on the donuts are amazing. They don't get messy in the box even though they get pressed by the top of the box unlike any other soft frost. It's totally worth two hours drive from Columbus. I love Jack Frost Donuts!!!

DONUT have one!!! LOL. Amazing donuts. The crime brÃ»lÃ©e donuts are so fun to crack open, but my fave was the red velvet donut. Worth the Ã¼ber ride to get there. My 2 wishes... Closer to the strip and if they deliver to California.

El segundo mejor lugar en Phoenix para comer helado (después de Novel). Es muy pequeño y puede llenarse mucho los fines de semana por la noche, pero vale la pena esperar. Helado fresco y delicioso, combinaciones de sabores increíbles y, normalmente, siempre tienen opciones sin lácteos. Mi esposo insiste en que el helado de mantequilla de maní es el mejor que ha probado. La comida perfecta para el fin de semana: pedir pizza en Federal, que está justo enfrente, y luego ir a tomar helado. Una tienda muy encantadora y un excelente espacio al aire libre en la parte trasera!
original: Second best place in Phoenix for ice cream (behind novel). It's super small and can get super busy on weekend evenings but it is worth the wait! Fresh and delicious ice cream, awesome flavor combinations and they usually always have yummy dairy free options. My husband swears the peanut butter ice cream is the best he has ever had. The perfect weekend meal: grab pizza at federal across the street then walk over for some ice cream. Very cute store front and great outdoor seating in the back!

text: Fui conhecer este lugar de sobremesas e adorei! Meu grupo pediu tudo do cardápio... biscoito de chocolate, milkshake, porções e iogurte frozen, e tudo estava delicioso!! Tudo estava muito fresco e valeu a pena o preço. Recomendo muito o biscoito de chocolate!
original: Came to check out this dessert place and it hit the spot! My group ordered everything on the menu...a chocolate cookie, milkshake, bites, and frozen yogurt & it was all delicious!! Everything was so fresh and worth the cost. Definitely recommend the chocolate cookie!

text: O próprio "crack pie" e o "crack pie" cremoso com as farinhas de milho adicionadas nunca falham em satisfazer meu desejo por doces da infância. Já visitei a unidade em Nova York, então estava familiarizado com o cardápio. O atendimento foi rápido neste local, e os funcionários foram simpáticos. Também experimentei o "latte" de "crack pie" gelado, que também estava delicioso. Se você ainda não veio aqui, definitivamente vale a pena conhecer este lugar.
original: The crack pie itself and the soft serve crack pie with the added corn flakes never fail to satisfy my childhood sweet tooth dessert cravings. I've been to the one in New York before so I was familiar with the menu offerings. Service was quick at this location and staff were friendly. I had the iced crack pie latte too which was also delicious. If you haven't been here, definitely this place is worth making a visit to.

text: I have found...DONUT NIRVANA! I've seen a lot of pretentious places that claim donut supremacy, but Jack Frost is the HIGH KINGDOM of decadent donut! Salted Caramel, Maple Bacon, and varieties so amazing and diverse, your tastebuds may not survive! Also, I've never been to a donut shop...THAT RAN OUT OF DONUTS BEFORE! I've seen these beauties go so fast, that you have to CALL AHEAD TO RESERVE SOME! The prices are good, the people are nice....and they need to knock down some local buildings for MORE PARKING, but other than that, JACK FROST IS MY KIND OF DONUT SPIRIT, ALL YEAR ROUND!!!
Extremely disappointed! Over priced & over hyped. We tried 4 different cupcakes, each cupcake was very dry and all the frostings were way to sweet. We are far from satisfied.
Tried the Thai tea and the matcha float. So good! Definitely coming back for the butterbeer ice cream.
Este lugar tem o sorvete mais delicioso!!! Eu comi o sorvete junto com esta deliciosa waffle, que estava quente e com uma textura perfeita por fora. Quase chorei quando comi!
original: This place has the best ice cream!!! I got my ice cream in between this delicious waffle that was all warm and perfectly crunchy outside. I almost cried when I bit into it!

text: Adoro este lugar. Doces deliciosos em uma área excelente. A área é realmente interessante, parece que transformaram um bairro, pedindo aos moradores para se mudarem e convertendo as casas em estabelecimentos comerciais. Mas são negócios agradáveis. Tenho certeza de que não é assim, mas é um bairro ótimo. Há muitas opções de sabores deliciosos. Eu sempre escolho o chocolate, que é sempre uma aposta segura. Delicioso. O atendimento foi excelente e o lugar é charmoso. Vale a pena conhecer.
original: Love this place. Great desserts in a great area. The area is really cool, looks like they took a neighborhood, asked the residents to leave and turned the houses into places of business. But nice businesses. I'm sure that's not what happened, but it's a great neighborhood. Lots of different delicious looking flavors. I go with the ever safe chocolate every time. Yummy. Service was great and place was cute. Check it out.

text: É evidente que meu relacionamento com a Milk Bar se encaixa na categoria de complexo. Mas, de verdade, sinto que essa avaliação de quatro estrelas será o resultado final. Voltei várias vezes. Continuo voltando porque o "milk quake" original era tão bom. Ainda sinto falta, então volto na esperança de não ser decepcionado repetidamente. Posso informar com satisfação que nas últimas três vezes que visitei (provavelmente em cerca de seis meses e em diferentes lugares nos EUA), não experimentei o desastre de consistência dos três estrelas. O sorvete ainda não é exatamente o que eu lembro, mas a consistência do "milk quake" tem sido... consistente – bom, denso e com pedaços. Eu detestei escrever essa frase tanto quanto você detestou lê-la. Para o que vale, perguntei a alguém na unidade do East Village por que eu tinha tido experiências tão inconsistentes no passado, e ela disse que isso tinha a ver com o aquecimento das bolinhas de bolo, o que fazia o sorvete derreter. Mas isso não deveria acontecer, então, se isso acontecer, eu deveria devolvê-lo e pedir para eles corrigirem. Obviamente, não é exatamente isso, mas você entendeu a ideia. Resumindo, e para ser mais preciso: se você ama algo, não desista dele. Talvez você deva considerar desistir se ele o decepciona constantemente, mas faça uma pesquisa completa antes. Você pode ficar satisfeito com o resultado. Minha parte está feita.
original: Clearly, my relationship with Milk Bar would fall in the complicated category. But I really, truly, genuinely feel like this four-star review will be where we land. I've been back. I keep going back because the OG milk quake was just.so.good. I still crave it, so I go back hoping that I won't be let down repeatedly. I can happily report that the last three times I've been (in probably about as many months and in locations across the US), I did not experience the soupy disaster of three-star reviews past. The ice cream is still not quiiiiiite what I remember, but the consistency of the quake has been...consistent - good, thick, and chunky. I hated writing that whole sentence as much as you hated reading it. For what it's worth, I asked someone at their East Village location why the heck I had such inconsistent experiences in the past and she said it had something to do with heating up the cake balls which then melt the ice cream but that should never happen so if it does, I should take it back and ask them to fix it. Obviously not verbatim, but you get the gist. Long, very long story short...if you love something, don't give up on it. Maybe consider giving up on it if it consistently disappoints you, but do your research and do it throughly first. You might be pleased with the outcome. My work here is done.

text: He ido a Villani varias veces. Nunca he estado decepcionado en cuanto a la calidad, la cantidad y el servicio. Pruében cualquier plato, seguro que lo disfrutarán.
original: Been at Villani's multiple times. Never disappointed in terms of quality, quantity, and service. Try anything you will enjoy it.

text: Been here a few times and the desserts are definitely good. There's always a crowd and they can run out of some of their more popular desserts. There's a good variety, unique decor, and the line moves pretty fast. If you come during peak hours it can definitely be hard to find a seat and you may have to stand in a line that goes out the door and wraps around the corner. The prices I think are high for Charlotte, they're pretty much what I would pay in LA for the same thing but the desserts are good. And it's one of the few places in Charlotte that's not a bar but open late.

Their croissants are really good. But I tried their carrot cake and it was really tasteless, and the coffee really wasn't good either. Other than the croissants everyone in my group was pretty disappointed

Este lugar prepara un batido sólido, y tiene una decoración que evoca nostalgia si eres como yo, un niño de los 90 (todo, desde Johnny Bravo hasta Pokémon). Compartí un batido de pollo con mi esposa, y estuvo bastante bueno, especialmente por 6 dólares (antes de impuestos). Había una gran variedad de conos de waffle y creo que también había trozos de mantequilla de maní mezclados, ¡lo cual fue genial! Sin embargo, el sabor del helado parecía más similar a un batido de Wendy's con jarabe que a un verdadero batido de helado, pero en general, estuvo bastante bien. Mi recomendación: pedir un batido y luego dar un paseo por la orilla del agua, o alquilar una balsa.
original: This place makes a solid milkshake, and has nostalgia inducing decor if you're a 90s kid like me(everything from Johnny Bravo to Pokemon). I split a drumstick shake with my wife, and it was reasonably good, especially for $6(before tax). There were a ton of waffle cone and I think peanut butter chunks mixed in, which was nice! However the actual I've cream tasted a bit more like a Wendy's frosty with syrup than a true ice cream shake, but all in all pretty decent. My recommendation, grab a shake and then go for a stroll along the water, or jump in a paddle boat.

text: O melhor lugar para relaxar em NODA e no norte de Charlotte. Extremamente autêntico e charmoso. Boa comida simples e doces deliciosos. Adoro o fato de que funciona 24 horas por dia, 7 dias por semana. A única razão pela qual não dei 5 estrelas é porque fica muito, muito cheio. Às vezes, não há lugares para sentar, e em alguns momentos, o servidor de internet está tão cheio de usuários ao mesmo tempo, que a conexão fica ruim, e o computador fica mais lento do que a minha avó Nancy (que descanse em paz). Mas, no entanto, tudo o que é bom vale a pena esperar! Então, Amelie's está fazendo algo certo para atrair tantos clientes. *Duas mãos para o alto e um "pop" para a Amelie!*
original: The best hang out spot in NODA and North East Charlotte. So authentic, and cute as a button. Good simple food, delicious pastries. Love the fact that its 24hrs/7days a week. The only reason why I did not give it a full 5 stars- Is because it gets crazy CROWDED. Sometimes there are no seats, and there are times where the internet server has so many users all at once, that you get a poor signal, and computer move slower then my Grand Ma Nancy (Bless her soul). But then again, All good things are worth waiting for! So Amelie's is doing something right to attracted such a big crowds. *Two hands in the air and a butt pop for Amelies*

text: El mejor helado de hielo raspado que he encontrado hasta ahora en la zona. Ofrecen una gran variedad de sabores, además de helados y otros postres.
original: Best shaved shaved ice in the valley that I have found thus far. Lots of flavors to choose from and they also have ice cream and other treats.

text: Eu já fui à unidade da Sprinkles em Beverly Hills e os cupcakes são incríveis. Já visitei a loja no Linq duas vezes. Em ambas as ocasiões, tive que usar a máquina de cupcakes, pois havia uma longa fila na loja. Não tenho certeza se os cupcakes na máquina são de um dia antes ou se simplesmente não são mantidos tão frescos, pois estão lá. Os cupcakes tinham um gosto seco. Preciso voltar quando a loja estiver menos movimentada e comprar alguns cupcakes dentro da loja.
original: I have been to the Sprinkles in Beverly Hills and the cupcakes are amazing. I have been to the store at the linq twice now. Both of the times i have had to use the cupcake ATM because there has been a long wait for the store. I am not sure if the cupcakes in the ATM are day old or they just aren't kept as fresh because they are in there. The cupcakes tasted dry. I will have to go back when the store is not as busy and get some cupcakes from inside the store.

text: "Churn" es un clásico que todos los estudiantes de la Universidad del Gran Cañón visitan. En esencia, es una especie de prueba de madurez. Es un lugar ideal para ir después de cenar en el restaurante de al lado. El helado está hecho de manera excelente, así que, sin importar el sabor que elijas, casi siempre es delicioso. Puedes sentarte en el patio trasero, bajo los árboles, con tus amigos mientras lo disfrutas (y quizás volver a pedir más).
original: Churn is a classic that every college student at Grand Canyon University goes to. It is basically a rite of passage. It is fun to grab after you get dinner across the street. The ice cream is just made so well, that no matter what flavor you choose, it is almost guaranteed to taste great. You can sit outside in their back patio under the trees with your friends as you eat it all (and maybe go back inside for seconds)

text: We went on a campus tour, they gave us coupons for the Daily Scoop, we went for ice cream. So we paid attention when we got there (before the tour) and learned quickly that the line gets backed up fast. When our tour was over, we belined it to the Daily Scoop and orders some ice cream - chocolate peanut butter to be specific. It was good.

Sooooo many delicious items! I spent $35 myself and I don't regret it. Excellent almond chocolate croissant, very chocolate-forward, which is difficult to achieve at other bakeries. Give me one of the gruyere croissants and the chocolate pecan pie, and I'm in heaven. Subtracting a star for the utterly sullen demeanor of the employees. And the coffee was meh.

El helado es increíble. Pudimos probar 5 sabores diferentes, ¡y nos encantó! El de miel y lavanda fue espectacular. También nos encantó el de "Cookie Monster". ¡El sabor era delicioso! Por cierto, hay poco espacio para aparcar. Es un lugar pequeño con mesas al aire libre, así que ten en cuenta el calor de 104 grados al planificar tu visita. ¡Excelente servicio!
original: Ice cream is amazing! We had the indecisive and was able to try 5 scoops! Honey lavender was aaamazing. Loved the cookie monster. Such good flavor. FYI limited parking. Small venue with outdoor seating, so plan accordingly in 104 degree heat! Great service!

text: I should have known not to get bubble tea at a coffee shop. The taro milk tea didn't have any flavor and the boba was hard. Do not recommend going here for boba.

O Melt oferece uma variedade de sabores de sorvete, incluindo alguns que mudam periodicamente, então pergunte quais são os novos sabores, caso haja. O "Cookie Monster" foi meu favorito, não tenho certeza se ainda o oferecem. Eles servem o sorvete em uma pequena caixa estilo "take-out" chinesa, com um biscoito de sorte saboroso e crocante por cima. Dica: quebre o biscoito de sorte no sorvete (tire a mensagem primeiro, ha!).
original: Melt offers a variety of ice cream flavors, including some that rotate through, so ask what the new flavors are if they have some. Cookie Monster was my jam, not sure if they still have it there. They put your scoops in a little chinese take-out box with a tasty crunchy fortune cookie on top. Pro-tip, break up the fortune cookie into your ice cream (take the fortune out first, ha!).

text: O melhor! Uma sobremesa de creme deliciosa! Sempre com qualidade consistente. O lugar está sempre cheio, mas vale a pena esperar.
original: The best! Excellent custard! Always consistently good. The place is busy but worth the wait.

text: Fila muito longa quando chegamos, mas a equipe é incrivelmente eficiente e conseguiu organizar a fila rapidamente. O café e os sanduíches de café da manhã estavam ótimos! Preços de Las Vegas, com a velocidade de Las Vegas!
original: LONG LINE when we got their, but the staff is incredibly efficient and moved the line very quickly. Coffee and breakfast sandwiches where great! Vegas prices with Vegas speed!

text: my favorite ice cream in Scottsdale! seriously I found this place like a year ago and saved it for our trip with the intention of no way was I skipping this place. I'm lucky we got here before I got my crazy illness otherwise I might have missed it and cried the whole flight home. I didn't and got to taste the deliciousness! if you are in the area do not miss this place.

Un helado increíblemente delicioso, combinado con un propietario de una pequeña empresa que es realmente muy amable. Nos encanta esta pequeña tienda en Grand Ave. Incluso ofrecen conos sin gluten, lo cual es fantástico para nuestro hijo.
original: Unbelievably good ice cream paired with a small business owner who is genuinely very kind. We love this little shop off Grand Ave. They even offer gluten free cones which is so great for our kiddo.

text: Siempre obtengo una excelente relación calidad-precio en Mitchell's. Los sabores siempre son perfectos. El servicio al cliente es siempre excelente. Mi favorito son el limón, el mango y la frambuesa.
original: I always get my monies worth at Mitchell's!!! The Flavors are always on point. Customer service is always great. Key Lime, Mango, Raspberry is my favorite!!!

text: STOP!!! This is what I observed during my visit tonight Saturday March 20, 2021 at 9:15 PM. The same staff member that takes your order and money goes to the dipping case to scoop your ice cream without washing his hands or wearing a pair of gloves. At best, this is not sanitary and worst they could be spreading COVID-19. We all know that money is filthy and we should wash our hands after handling it. The unsafe practices at the establishment should be criminal. God know just how many unsuspecting customers caught the COVID-19 virus from this place.
Learn how to handle queues of more than 5 people. I've never seen a more inefficient selection/checkout process.

Suggested to us by a security guard, a couple blocks of The Fremont Street Experience. You see the picture, delectable. A little pricey, but it is Vegas.... Well worth every penny. Don't often crave a donut, bit glad I did today. Walking distance, close to hotel, perfect. Well worth your text and Penny's, priceless!!!!

Nós visitamos este lugar pela primeira vez e achamos que é um lugar muito charmoso. A decoração e o ambiente criam a sensação de que estamos em uma máquina do tempo, o que é bastante agradável. O sorvete em si é bom. Nada de excepcional para comentar. No geral, tive uma experiência agradável, mas o preço é um pouco elevado. Voltarei, mas não virarei um cliente frequente.
original: We came here for the first time and it's a really cute place. The whole set up makes you feel like u entered a time machine and it's quite charming. The ice cream itself is good. Nothing too crazy to rave about. All in all I had a pleasant experience but it's a little overpriced. I'll be back but I won't be a regular here.

text: Uno de mis lugares favoritos para comprar donuts en Cleveland. Los precios son muy buenos y los donuts son deliciosos. Lo que me gusta de Jack Frost es que los donuts son de un tamaño más pequeño, así que puedo probar muchos sabores diferentes sin sentirme mal después. También tienen una gran variedad de sabores únicos, además de los típicos con glaseado y arce. ¡Recomiendo encarecidamente este lugar a cualquiera que esté en la zona!
original: One of my favorite donut places in Cleveland! Super well priced and so delicious. What I love about Jack Frost is the donuts are on the smaller size so you can try a bunch of different flavors and not feel sick after. They have a bunch of unique flavors as well outside of your typical glazed and maple. Highly recommend this place to anyone in the area!

text: Los postres parecían haber sido preparados por alguien sin experiencia, y los batidos no tenían sabor. Además, la variedad parece ser un poco limitada en comparación con "The Milk Shake Factory" en el sur de la ciudad.
original: The sweets looks like they were made by a rookie and the milkshakes were flavorless. Also, the selection seems a bit short compared to The Milk Shake Factory in the South Side.

text: A avaliação é de 3 estrelas porque o bar em que está localizado é bem legal e o atendimento foi amigável. No entanto, o sorvete em si deixou a desejar. O sabor de morango e café com leite não tinha gosto. Todos os sabores estavam duros devido à formação de cristais de gelo, o que indica que o sorvete foi parcialmente derretido e congelado novamente. Acho que vou voltar a experimentar o Scooptacular e o Novel.
original: It gets 3 stars because the bar it is in is pretty cool and the service was friendly. The ice cream itself left much to be desired. The strawberry and cafe de leche were tasteless. Every flavor was crunchy due to ice crystal formation, which shows that the ice cream has been partially melted and refrozen. I'll stick to Scooptacular and Novel I guess.

text: ¡Increíble! De verdad, los donuts y el helado estaban deliciosos. ¡Volveré!
original: Amazing!!! Seriously the donut and ice cream was delish !!! I will be coming back!!!

text: Um lugar incrível para sobremesas. Se você procura uma sobremesa única e incrivelmente deliciosa, este é o lugar! Eu pedi o copo de biscoito com chocolate de avelã e sorvete de cereja, um macaron de baunilha e marshmallow tostado. Atenção: o copo de biscoito é menor do que nas fotos anteriores. Parece que eles mudaram o tamanho, então você só recebe metade do macaron e 2 bolas de sorvete. O sorvete é delicioso!
original: Super fun dessert place. If you want a unique and super sweet dessert then this is it! I got the cookie cup with hazelnut choc and cherry swirl ice cream, vanilla macaron and toasted marshmallow. Be warned: the cookie cup is smaller than the previous pictures on here. They must have changed the size so you only get one half of the macaron and 2 scoops of ice cream. The gelato is yummy!

text: We love ice cream and this place lived up to our expectations and more so. It was very creamy. The milkshakes were good too.

Talk about paradise. As I walked into Sinful Sweets the displays of fudge led to the rows of truffles and my child-like wonder was in full force as I debated between dark chocolate graham crackers, chocolate smores, and a dark chocolate New York truffle. Needless to say, my wonderment led to me trying all three. The chocolate was so smooth and very rich. I love dark chocolate and the truffle stood out from the crowd. It was delicious. I also tried the chocolate covered bacon which was nothing short of miraculous. But sometimes the food isn't enough for a place to get a good review and Sinful Sweets offers plenty more. The staff working was great. It came up that I am visiting from Raleigh and we began talking about the differences in areas. He was very friendly, personable, and funny. My friends and I were able to sit on the benches in the front of the store and hang out while the shop was slow and talk with the staff. The final perk of Sinful Sweets is the price. They are dirt cheap, I felt. I absolutely intend on visiting this place again whenever I am in town.

Los donuts eran muy bonitos, aunque en general no eran nada especiales. El donut de crème brûlée no cumplió con las expectativas. El donut "Old Fashion" era similar a uno que encontraría en una tienda de conveniencia como 7/11. En general, la tienda es agradable, el café está bueno y el personal es excelente.
original: Doughnuts where very pretty other than that they where adverage at best. The creme brulee donut did not live up to the hype. Theold fashion was equal to one I'd pick up at 7/11. Other than that the shop is nice the coffee was good and the staff was great.

text: I wanted to try the cookies here; the flavors sounded very interesting. I got the blueberry one, the Compost cookie, and the cornflake chocolate chip marshmallow one. I didn't feel like any individual ingredient really popped out when you're eating it, I guess it all blended in well all together. Maybe next time, I'll get a chance to try more off the menu.

Was totally stoked to try this place as I haven't had the chance to go to the NJ original location. I got 2 different pastries - the regular cannoli and the regular "lobster tail". Very creamy and delicious.

¡Guau! No estoy seguro de cómo describirlos. Este no es un panadería común. El pan de galletas de chocolate apenas llegó a la caja. Estoy deseando probar el pan de chocolate con leche. También compramos una tarta y unas "rollitos" de arándanos con queso crema. Me gustaría comerlo todo, pero aún no he cenado. Pensé que solo iba a ser un tentempié. Compré más para mañana. El precio también era razonable. Todo costaba entre 1,50 y 2,00 dólares. Había algunos que eran un poco más caros, pero en general, vale la pena. El personal fue amable y servicial. El aparcamiento es un poco limitado, pero logramos encontrar un lugar. Definitivamente lo recomiendo.
original: Omg! Not sure how to describe them. This is not your ordinary bakery. The chocolate cookie bread barely made it to the register. I can't wait to eat the mocha bread. We also bought a tart and some cranberry with cream cheese roll. I would eat it all but I haven't had dinner. This was supposed to just be a snack. Bought more for tomorrow. Price was reasonable too. Everything is around $1.50 to $2.00. There were some that was a little higher in price but overall it's worth it. Staff was helpful and nice. Parking is a little tight, but we were able to find a spot. Definitely recommend.

text: There's a saying now that we eat with our eyes and this place is a prime example of picture perfect dessert. Not only the dessert is well put together, the interior as well. Now there's a big trend going on with grassy walls with neon signs and there's one implemented here to show off your dessert! These places are definitely a reminder that we're slowly started to get all the "Cali-like" boba/ ice cream places. Phoenix is really needing more places like this and I'm very happy it's in a prime spot. They're located next to Pokitrition, near off the 101 and Ray. The cool thing is that the creators of Pokitrition also made this place too! I didn't get to try the boba just yet but the ice cream is great. While being one of the reasons I don't have a 6 pack yet, this just makes it worse cause I'd probably be craving this place. KITH Treats is also a place that I get reminded of about this concept. This place is going to blow up and be packed. I'll be back for more. CERTIFIED BANGER

Hard to find, tough to beat. Same great flavors and service as the 16th Street location, but without the crowds. There are 2 customer parking spaces on the street level, then a big parking structure. Don't know if the structure parking is free or not.

Ótima sorveteria. Sempre venho aqui pelo sundae com calda de chocolate quente. Por algum motivo, a calda de chocolate desta sorveteria é única. Um sabor de chocolate muito rico e doce. O sorvete também é bom. Outros tipos de chocolate não são tão bons aqui, mas recomendo qualquer um dos produtos de sorvete.
original: Great ice cream shop. Always come here for the sundae with hot fudge. For some reason the hot fudge here is one of a kind. Really rich and sweet chocolate flavor. The ice cream is also good. Other types of chocolates are not as good here but would recommend any of the ice cream items.

text: I had the ice cream a year ago and got turned off by the counter service. They were measuiring out small/medium size by weight on a scale. I have never had that experience before in NYC or Scottsdale. I forgot how the ice cream tasted. I'm happy to hear that they are doing well and I wish them the best.

Sabores deliciosos e porções generosas! Eu pedi uma versão menor do sabor de torta de limão siciliano da estação. Estava delicioso! Acompanhado de pedaços da massa da torta. A sobremesa é servida em um copo, o que facilita o compartilhamento com outras pessoas. Há mesas ao ar livre e um pequeno estacionamento. Não há banheiros. Vale a pena visitar durante uma viagem a CLE!
original: Flavorful & generous serving sizes! I ordered a junior size of the seasonal Key lime pie flavor. So good! Complete with chunks of pie crust. The cone is given in a cup so it can easily be shared with someone. Outdoor seating at benches are available and a small parking lot. No restrooms. Worth a visit on a trip to CLE!

text: Fiquei em Las Vegas por uma noite e queria tomar um café e comer um donut rapidamente antes de voltar para casa. Este lugar foi incrível. Os donuts eram muito originais e deliciosos. Acabamos comendo nossos donuts lá e aproveitando o pequeno espaço com pátio nos fundos. Recomendo que reservem um tempo para visitar! O atendimento foi muito amigável e atencioso.
original: Stayed in Vegas for one night and wanted a quick coffee and doughnut fix before hitting the road again. This place was amazing. The doughnuts were crazy original and yummy. Ended up eating our doughnuts there and enjoying the small patio space they have out back. Would recommend you take the time to visit!! Super friendly and nice.

text: The new oat-based vegan soft serve is amazing (better than the previously offered silk brand dairy free soft serve) ! It's creamy, soft, and moderately sweet. For people have problems with lactose, this is heaven! I will miss Page Dairy Mart when I leave Pittsburgh!

Wasn't a big fan of the creme brÃ»lÃ©e donut as the sugar on top was very thick and hard and the donut was very dense and doughy. Also tried the cinnamon sugar donut cone with the vanilla ice cream in the middle and was also disappointed. The vanilla ice cream was nice and creamy but the cinnamon sugar cone was also hard to bite into and little dry. Bookmarked this place for months and was very disappointed

Me encantan los sprinkles, vivo en California, donde son muy comunes. Este es bastante pequeño, pero es realmente adorable, y el personal fue muy amable. Mi favorito es el red velvet sin azúcar. No soy una gran aficionada de los cupcakes o los dulces, pero cuando se trata de sus cupcakes de red velvet, ¡podría comer diez! El glaseado de queso crema es delicioso. También tienen mini cupcakes, por si quieres probar diferentes sabores.
original: I just adore sprinkles, I live in California where we have them around a lot, this one is pretty small but it's really cute & the staff was very sweet..my favorite is the sugar free red velvet..I am not a cupcake or sweets person but when it comes to their red velvet cupcakes I could eat like 10! The cream cheese frosting is delicious..they also have mini cupcakes in case you want to try a few different kinds
